Abdominal Assault.name: Abdominal Assault
Abdominal Assault.description: Physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Gravity, a TP reset, and Knockback.

Abominable Belch.name: Abominable Belch
Abominable Belch.notes: Nerrivik's Vile Belch is replaced by Abominable Belch once its lanterns are destroyed. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Abominable Belch.description: Belches toxic fumes at targets in an area of effect, inflicting Silence (30~60s), Plague (100 TP & 6 MP per tick, 15~45s) and Paralysis (30~60s).

Abrasive Tantara.name: Abrasive Tantara
Abrasive Tantara.notes: Amnesia lasts 30-60s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them). An imp cannot use this without its horn.

Absolute Terror.name: Absolute Terror
Absolute Terror.notes: Ouryu's and Bahamut's version is AOE. All others are single target.
Absolute Terror.description: Single/multiple target(s) is frozen with fear.

Absorbing Kiss.name: Absorbing Kiss
Absorbing Kiss.notes: Only used by Pepper and Bloodguzzler.

Abyss Blast.name: Abyss Blast
Abyss Blast.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Abyss Blast.description: Deals dark-elemental damage to a single player. Additional effect: Blind (-25 Accuracy, 2 minutes).

Abyssic Buster.name: Abyssic Buster
Abyssic Buster.description: Deals massive damage to targets in a frontal cone.

Accursed Armor.name: Accursed Armor
Accursed Armor.description: Covers the user in cursed spikes. Enemies that hit it become cursed.

Acheron Flame.name: Acheron Flame
Acheron Flame.notes: Enhanced Gates of Hades; Old Shuck under 50% HP.

Acheron Kick.name: Acheron Kick
Acheron Kick.notes: Ixion uses this when target with hate is behind him.
Acheron Kick.description: Physical damage with knockback to nearby targets; used when attacking from behind.

Acid Breath.name: Acid Breath
Acid Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Acid Breath.description: Breath damage in a cone (HP x 0.05, capped at 200). Additional effect: STR Down (-10 STR, decaying 1 per 15 seconds).

Acid Spray.name: Acid Spray
Acid Spray.description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Acrid Stream.name: Acrid Stream
Acrid Stream.description: Deals water damage and lowers the target's Magic Defense by 25.

Actinic Burst.name: Actinic Burst
Actinic Burst.description: Inflicts Flash on targets in an area of effect.

Aegis Schism.name: Aegis Schism
Aegis Schism.description: Deals an armor breaking blow to a single target. Additional effect: Defense Down

Aeolian Void.name: Aeolian Void
Aeolian Void.description: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage plus Blind and Silence.

aerial.name: aerial
aerial.description: Flying trait: cannot be struck by standard melee attacks; only ranged attacks, magic, and certain moves (e.g. Cyclone) connect.

Aerial Blast.name: Aerial Blast
Aerial Blast.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Aerial Blast.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Garuda's ultimate wind attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Aerial Collision.name: Aerial Collision
Aerial Collision.description: Frontal cone. Deals 3 hits of physical damage.

Aerial Wheel.name: Aerial Wheel
Aerial Wheel.description: Deals a ranged attack to a single target. Additional effect: stun

Aetheral Toxin.name: Aetheral Toxin
Aetheral Toxin.notes: Used only by genji armor NMs during Feast of Swords event.
Aetheral Toxin.description: Inflicts Dia on all players in range.

Aetheric Pull.name: Aetheric Pull
Aetheric Pull.notes: On Pakecet it also nullifies one damage type while active and moves another resistance to 115%.
Aetheric Pull.description: Drains MP and grants the user Dread Spikes.

Afflicting Gaze.name: Afflicting Gaze
Afflicting Gaze.notes: Used by most caturae. Inflicts Plague and Bind to anyone within a frontal line of the mobs gaze.
Afflicting Gaze.description: Gaze attack inflicting a strong Plague (150 TP/tick) and Bind on the target.

Agaricus.name: Agaricus
Agaricus.description: Single-target damage. Additional effects: Slow, Plague (~-26 MP/tick), and an enmity reset.

Agaricus (skill).name: Agaricus (skill)
Agaricus (skill).notes: Only used by Toppling Tuber. Used after the Queasyshroom and Numbshroom combo.

Airy Shield.name: Airy Shield
Airy Shield.description: Grants a temporary immunity to ranged attacks (60s).

Amatsu: Hanaikusa.name: Amatsu: Hanaikusa
Amatsu: Hanaikusa.description: Tachi: Kasha variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Kamikaeshi.name: Amatsu: Kamikaeshi
Amatsu: Kamikaeshi.description: Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Kazakiri.name: Amatsu: Kazakiri
Amatsu: Kazakiri.description: Tachi: Jinpu variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Torima.name: Amatsu: Torima
Amatsu: Torima.description: Tachi: Enpi variant. A two-hit attack that inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Tsukikage.name: Amatsu: Tsukikage
Amatsu: Tsukikage.description: Inflicts damage to a single target and closes the Cosmic Elucidation skillchain.

Amatsu: Tsukioboro.name: Amatsu: Tsukioboro
Amatsu: Tsukioboro.description: Tachi: Gekko variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Yukiarashi.name: Amatsu: Yukiarashi
Amatsu: Yukiarashi.description: Tachi: Yukikaze variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amber Scutum.name: Amber Scutum
Amber Scutum.description: Self-buff granting a +20% Defense Bonus (used while curled).

Amnesic Blast.name: Amnesic Blast
Amnesic Blast.description: Deals damage in a cone and inflicts Amnesia. Additional effect: Knockback.

Amon Drive.name: Amon Drive
Amon Drive.description: Unique scythe weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Amorphic Scythe.name: Amorphic Scythe
Amorphic Scythe.notes: Only used by custards and Immortal Flan.

Amorphic Spikes.name: Amorphic Spikes
Amorphic Spikes.notes: Skillchain properties: Gravitation / Transfixion. Weapon-skill attributes are 20% DEX and 20% INT; fTP is 1.0 below 1500 TP and 1.375 from 1500 to 2999. Also a Blue Magic spell, learned from Flan and usable from level 98 for 79 MP and 4 blue magic points, granting INT+5, MND+2 and the Gilfinder trait.
Amorphic Spikes.description: Delivers a fivefold attack. Damage varies with TP.

Ancestral Banishment.name: Ancestral Banishment
Ancestral Banishment.description: Deals damage in an area of effect and dispels multiple status effects.

Angry Seas.name: Angry Seas
Angry Seas.notes: Angry Seas is what SUMMONS its adds: it spawns three to ten Pakecet's Pugils (~4,500 HP each), and the number summoned rises as Pakecet's own HP falls.

Animating Wail.name: Animating Wail
Animating Wail.description: The monster gains Haste (about 30%) for two to three minutes.

Antigravity.name: Antigravity
Antigravity.notes: The potency of the knockback effect varies with the number of gears in the enemy formation. A single gear produces only a slight knockback, whereas triple gears produce a very strong knockback.
Antigravity.description: Deals physical damage and knocks back.

Antimatter.name: Antimatter
Antimatter.notes: Used by Ultima (at very low health) and Proto-Ultima (until last phase). Ignores Utsusemi.
Antimatter.description: Fires its antimatter weaponry to deal damage to a single player.

Antiphase.name: Antiphase
Antiphase.description: 15' radial mist that inflicts Silence on all targets.

Anvil Lightning.name: Anvil Lightning
Anvil Lightning.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Apocalyptic Ray.name: Apocalyptic Ray
Apocalyptic Ray.notes: Inflicts Doom regardless of player facing or position.
Apocalyptic Ray.description: Inflicts Doom in a conal attack.

Aqua Ball.name: Aqua Ball
Aqua Ball.description: Inflicts water damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down (-10, decays 1 per 9 seconds).

Aqua Blast.name: Aqua Blast
Aqua Blast.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.
Aqua Blast.description: Deals water damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback (6).

Aqua Breath.name: Aqua Breath
Aqua Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Aqua Cannon.name: Aqua Cannon
Aqua Cannon.notes: The user gains a 10' Silence aura. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows. Scylla spams this move every 3-4 seconds while its Hydro Wave aura is up.
Aqua Cannon.description: Deals water damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Knockback (10) and Defense Down (-50%, 3 minutes).

Aqua Fortis.name: Aqua Fortis
Aqua Fortis.description: Expels venom at players in an area with additional Knockback and Poison.

Aquatic Lance.name: Aquatic Lance
Aquatic Lance.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Arbor Storm.name: Arbor Storm
Arbor Storm.notes: the MON version does not Gain Stoneskin
Arbor Storm.description: Large-radius (30') AoE damage + knockback. Gains Stoneskin after use. Can be blocked by 3 shadows. Additional effect: Weight

Arcane Stomp.name: Arcane Stomp
Arcane Stomp.range: AoE surrounding Gurfurlur, affects all mobs.
Arcane Stomp.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic. This results in all elemental damage (from spells or weaponskills) healing him. Aspir still works normally. Lasts approximately 5 minutes, cannot be dispelled.
Arcane Stomp.description: Stomps the ground to apply elemental absorption.

Arctic Impact.name: Arctic Impact
Arctic Impact.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Arctic Impact.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect.

Area Bombardment.name: Area Bombardment
Area Bombardment.description: Deals conal fire damage. Additional effects: Flash, multiple Dispel, and hate reset. Used only by the floating head variant.

Arm Cannon.name: Arm Cannon
Arm Cannon.description: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Max HP and Max MP Down (-50%).

Armor Buster.name: Armor Buster
Armor Buster.notes: Used by Proto-Ultima and Arch-Ultima. Can be absorbed by shadows.
Armor Buster.description: Deals damage to players in range. Additional effect: Weight.

Arrogance Incarnate.name: Arrogance Incarnate
Arrogance Incarnate.description: A modified Spirits Within that strikes targets within ~5 yalms.

Arrow Deluge.name: Arrow Deluge
Arrow Deluge.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a bow. If they lost their bow, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.
Arrow Deluge.description: Delivers a threefold ranged attack to targets in an area of effect.

Artificial Gravity.name: Artificial Gravity
Artificial Gravity.notes: The potency of the weight effect varies with the number of gears in the enemy formation. A single gear causes only a slight reduction in movement speed, whereas triple gears cause a very high reduction.
Artificial Gravity.description: Deals physical damage and inflicts Weight.

Ascension.name: Ascension
Ascension.description: AoE damage; switches Arciela to light mode.

Asthenic Fog.name: Asthenic Fog
Asthenic Fog.description: A mist drowns all nearby targets.

Astral Gate.name: Astral Gate
Astral Gate.description: Deals physical damage and knocks back.

Asuran Claws.name: Asuran Claws
Asuran Claws.description: A six-hit physical attack against a single target.

Atomic Ray.name: Atomic Ray
Atomic Ray.notes: Unlocked at mid HP (66%-). Used while its wings are spread.
Atomic Ray.description: AoE magical damage and -50% to all attributes. Prevented by cruor buffs.

Atramentous Libations.name: Atramentous Libations
Atramentous Libations.description: Drains HP from players in an area of effect around the monster. The user gains an intimidation effect.

Atropine Spore.name: Atropine Spore
Atropine Spore.description: Cone-shaped magical damage. Additional effect: Sleep, Paralyze, and Silence.

Auger Smash.name: Auger Smash
Auger Smash.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weakness. Used only by the floating head variant.

Awful Eye.name: Awful Eye
Awful Eye.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12 (and +1 to the per-tick increase). Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Awful Eye.description: Inflicts STR Down on a target with a gaze. Ignores shadows.

Axial Bloom.name: Axial Bloom
Axial Bloom.notes: Bypasses shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Back Heel.name: Back Heel
Back Heel.description: Physical damage to a single target.

Back Swish.name: Back Swish
Back Swish.description: Conal attack with Knockback. Can critical hit.

Backdraft.name: Backdraft
Backdraft.description: Deals fire damage to players in a ~7-9' area with additional Gravity and Burn. Removes all shadows.

Bad Breath.name: Bad Breath
Bad Breath.description: Cone-shaped breath: damage plus Slow, Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Weight, Bind, and Blind.

Bai Wing.name: Bai Wing
Bai Wing.notes: Used only by Ouryu and Cuelebre when in the sky.
Bai Wing.description: A dust storm deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Slow

Baleen Gurge.name: Baleen Gurge
Baleen Gurge.notes: On Pakecet it also grants water spikes, nullifies the damage type it absorbs while active, and moves one resistance to 100%. Shockmaw follows it by switching to its Water casting phase.

Baleful Gaze.name: Baleful Gaze
Baleful Gaze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Area is Gaze.
Baleful Gaze.description: Inflicts Petrifaction (1~2 min) on a single player with a gaze.

Baleful Roar.name: Baleful Roar
Baleful Roar.description: Removes all beneficial effects from targets in an area and resets enmity.

Ballistic Kick.name: Ballistic Kick
Ballistic Kick.range: 20-30' Front and back wide range conal attack
Ballistic Kick.notes: Resets hate and places Encumberance on every alliance member hit by this move. Can be stunned.
Ballistic Kick.description: Deals conal damage (can reduce the target’s HP to ~5% of maximum), resets hate, and inflicts Encumbrance (~30s).

Bane of Tartarus.name: Bane of Tartarus
Bane of Tartarus.description: Dispels all buffs including food; the primary target gains ~60s Weakness.

Banneret Charge.name: Banneret Charge
Banneret Charge.description: Reduces the HP of targets in an area of effect to critical levels and resets enmity.

Barbed Crescent.name: Barbed Crescent
Barbed Crescent.notes: Accuracy is reduced by 100 for 2~3 minutes.
Barbed Crescent.description: Slices a single target from long range with a barbed crescent. Additional effect: Accuracy Down

Barofield.name: Barofield
Barofield.notes: Emitted from the central head. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Barofield.description: Deals wind damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Weight (Gravity).

Barreling Smash.name: Barreling Smash
Barreling Smash.notes: Reduces target to critical HP and resets enmity.
Barreling Smash.description: Reduces the target to critical HP and resets enmity. Similar to Throat Stab.

Barrier Tusk.name: Barrier Tusk
Barrier Tusk.description: Grants the user Defense Bonus (+50%) and resistance to all elements (+120). Undispellable.

Basilisk Cannon.name: Basilisk Cannon
Basilisk Cannon.notes: Fired by a Quadav Turret or Kindred Turret's central cannon.
Basilisk Cannon.description: Fires an explosive artillery shell that blasts targets in an area of effect.

Bastion of Twilight.name: Bastion of Twilight
Bastion of Twilight.notes: Ring beneath the boss glows green while the magic shield is up.
Bastion of Twilight.description: Grants the caster a Magic Shield that nullifies magic damage.

Batholithic Shell.name: Batholithic Shell
Batholithic Shell.description: The user gains Blaze Spikes, Stoneskin, Haste, Attack Bonus, and Magic Attack Bonus (dispellable).

Batterhorn.name: Batterhorn
Batterhorn.notes: Only used on targets in front of it.
Batterhorn.description: Deals physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Knockback. Absorbable by 2-3 shadows.

Battery Charge.name: Battery Charge
Battery Charge.description: Restores MP (about 66, up to doubled by TP).

Battle Dance.name: Battle Dance
Battle Dance.description: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: DEX Down

Battle Stances.name: Battle Stances
Battle Stances.notes: Wings spread: absorbs damage from any source if the hit lands during a TP move or a cast. Wings folded: absorbs nothing, but takes reduced damage from everything. It switches roughly every three minutes while active and always opens the fight with wings spread, however long you wait to engage.
Battle Stances.description: Alternates between spread and folded wings, which changes how it takes damage.

Battle Trance.name: Battle Trance
Battle Trance.description: Summons Velkk adds (7 Velkk and 1 Puk).

Beak Lunge.name: Beak Lunge
Beak Lunge.description: Dives beak-first into a single player. Damage with Knockback.

Beaked Bomber.name: Beaked Bomber
Beaked Bomber.notes: Fired by a Yagudo Turret's central cannon.
Beaked Bomber.description: Fires an explosive artillery shell that blasts targets in an area of effect.

Beastruction.name: Beastruction
Beastruction.notes: Usually used under 35% HP; very long ready time.
Beastruction.description: Self-centered AoE used at low HP: reduces the user’s own remaining HP to 1 while inflicting Gravity, Encumbrance, Weight, and knockback on nearby players.

Beatdown.name: Beatdown
Beatdown.description: Lays the smackdown on a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Beautiful Death.name: Beautiful Death
Beautiful Death.description: 16' area-of-effect Charm with a 9-count Doom; charmed players are transformed into Rafflesia and cannot be Cursna'd, making it effectively a guaranteed K.O. Typically used below 50% HP.

Beclouding Dust.name: Beclouding Dust
Beclouding Dust.description: AoE damage that removes one beneficial effect (Dispel).

Beguiling Gaze.name: Beguiling Gaze
Beguiling Gaze.description: Charms its target with a gaze attack.

Beleaguerment.name: Beleaguerment
Beleaguerment.notes: Below 50% HP also reduces max HP by ~75% and inflicts Zombie.
Beleaguerment.description: Deals damage and inflicts Curse, Gravity, Slow, and a powerful Dia on targets in an area of effect.

Bellatrix of Light.name: Bellatrix of Light
Bellatrix of Light.description: Self-buff: switches Arciela to light mode (higher magic evasion).

Bellatrix of Shadows.name: Bellatrix of Shadows
Bellatrix of Shadows.description: Self-buff: switches Arciela to dark mode (magic accuracy bonus).

Belly Dance.name: Belly Dance
Belly Dance.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Lamia.
Belly Dance.description: Charms players within a gaze area of effect.

Benediction.name: Benediction
Benediction.description: White Mage SP ability: fully restores the user's HP and removes all enfeebling effects.

Benthic Typhoon.name: Benthic Typhoon
Benthic Typhoon.description: Deals damage; additional effect lowers Defense and Magic Defense.

Benumbing Blaze.name: Benumbing Blaze
Benumbing Blaze.notes: Unique to Wamoura NMs; used below 50% HP.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: Grants the user the Berserk effect: Attack +(1 + 116/256), Defense -(150/256), for 2-3 minutes.

Berserk (Doll).name: Berserk (Doll)
Berserk (Doll).notes: Unlike the Warrior's job ability, this expends the mob's TP as a weapon skill rather than function as a job ability, and grants the effect of Warcry, rather than Berserk. It also lasts signifigantly longer than the Warcry job ability.

Berserk-Ruf.name: Berserk-Ruf
Berserk-Ruf.notes: Used only by Volker in Bastok Mission 9-2 and during the Hero's Combat special BCNM. Trust: Volker also uses Berserk-Ruf.

Berserker Dance.name: Berserker Dance
Berserker Dance.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in WOTG areas.

Besieger's Bane.name: Besieger's Bane
Besieger's Bane.description: Inflicts a strong Bio (Attack -15%, ~56 HP/3s), Zombie, and Terror on targets in an area of effect.

Big Horn.name: Big Horn
Big Horn.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback.

Big Scissors.name: Big Scissors
Big Scissors.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that ignores shadows.
Big Scissors.description: Single-hit physical damage to one player.

Bilgestorm.name: Bilgestorm
Bilgestorm.description: AoE physical damage with Defense Down, Attack Down, and Accuracy Down.

Bill Toss.name: Bill Toss
Bill Toss.notes: Only used by Riko Kupenreich. It's possible to turn around or get out of the way while he readies it.
Bill Toss.description: Shocks foes with ridiculous wealth. Additional Effect: Terror

Bilrost Squall.name: Bilrost Squall
Bilrost Squall.notes: Restricted move (Naphula, Fjalar). Removes all shadows.
Bilrost Squall.description: 20’ AoE dealing random-element magical damage plus a matching stat-down and enfeeble (Fire/INT/Amnesia, Ice/AGI/Paralysis, Wind/VIT/Silence, Earth/DEX/Petrify, Lightning/MND/Stun, Water/STR/Poison).

Binary Absorption.name: Binary Absorption
Binary Absorption.description: Drains 200 HP from a single target.

Binary Tap.name: Binary Tap
Binary Tap.notes: Can be any (positive) buff, including food. Will drain up to 200HP if it can't take any buffs (or not enough).
Binary Tap.description: Absorbs two positive status effects from a single target, or otherwise drains HP.

Binding Blast.name: Binding Blast
Binding Blast.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows.

Binding Wave.name: Binding Wave
Binding Wave.description: AoE that inflicts Bind (30~60s); duration scales with TP.

Biotic Boomerang.name: Biotic Boomerang
Biotic Boomerang.description: AoE physical damage. Can critical strike.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.
Bite.description: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Defense Down.

Biting Abrogation.name: Biting Abrogation
Biting Abrogation.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Knockback, Paralysis, and Dispel (up to 4 buffs).

Bitter Elegy.name: Bitter Elegy
Bitter Elegy.description: A single-target wind-based Slow (50%), applied as a song debuff (removed by Erase).

Black Cloud.name: Black Cloud
Black Cloud.notes: Blind is about -20 accuracy for 5-7 minutes. Removes all shadows.
Black Cloud.description: A cloud deals damage to players in range. Additional effect: Blind.

Black Sanctus.name: Black Sanctus
Black Sanctus.description: Instantly KOs any active NPC helpers, and summons a Profane Circle for each helper that falls.

Blackout.name: Blackout
Blackout.description: AoE that inflicts Silence, Paralysis and Blind.

Blastbomb.name: Blastbomb
Blastbomb.description: A frontal attack that deals fire damage with an added Bind effect.

Blaster.name: Blaster
Blaster.description: Inflicts Paralysis on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Blazing Angon.name: Blazing Angon
Blazing Angon.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.
Blazing Angon.description: Deals fire damage to players in an area with Defense Down (-50%) and Knockback. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.

Blazing Bound.name: Blazing Bound
Blazing Bound.description: Deals fire damage and inflicts Burn (-53 INT).

Blessed Radiance (Ability).name: Blessed Radiance (Ability)
Blessed Radiance (Ability).notes: Blessed Radiance is a special attack usable only by your adventuring fellow during and after the quest Mirror Images. It deals substantial light-based damage and grants the NPC fellow an Invincible effect while inflicting Flash on the target enemy.
Blessed Radiance (Ability).description: Invokes the power of the Glass of All-Seeing, dealing elemental damage. Additional effect: Invincible, Flash

Blessing Sync.name: Blessing Sync
Blessing Sync.notes: NM only. Copies even normally non-dispellable buffs (e.g. Dematerialize, Aftermath). Copying many effects grants a strong Damage Taken reduction, up to full immunity; dispel the stolen buffs to remove it. Enfeebling effects on it also count toward the reduction.
Blessing Sync.description: Copies status enhancements from players within ~10'.

Blighted Bouquet.name: Blighted Bouquet
Blighted Bouquet.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Bio (~-50 HP/tick) and Mute. Used only by Mitrastema-type Rafflesia.

Blighted Gloom (ability).name: Blighted Gloom (ability)
Blighted Gloom (ability).notes: Used only by Vassago during the quest Mirror Images. Before he uses it, there will be a dustcloud animation and he will say:
Blighted Gloom (ability).description: Invokes the power of the Mirrror of Blighted Gloom, dealing elemental damage.

Blind Side Barrage.name: Blind Side Barrage
Blind Side Barrage.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 1 shadow. Notorious Monsters use an enhanced conal version.
Blind Side Barrage.description: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: STR Down and VIT Down (-19).

Blind Vortex.name: Blind Vortex
Blind Vortex.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Scratch.
Blind Vortex.description: Twofold damage to a single player.

Blindeye.name: Blindeye
Blindeye.description: Inflicts damage on a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Blinding Fulgor.name: Blinding Fulgor
Blinding Fulgor.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Flash.

Blindside Barrage.name: Blindside Barrage
Blindside Barrage.notes: Used only by birds in CoP and TOAU areas. The Nightmare Raven has an enhanced version that damages in an AoE radius.
Blindside Barrage.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Reduces STR and VIT

Blink of Peril.name: Blink of Peril
Blink of Peril.description: Reduces the target's HP by 95% and resets enmity. Ignores shadows.

Blistering Roar.name: Blistering Roar
Blistering Roar.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with Terror; grants the user Defense Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus plus a flame aura (unlocks fetters).

Blitzstrahl.name: Blitzstrahl
Blitzstrahl.description: Deals lightning damage to a single target.

Blizzard Breath.name: Blizzard Breath
Blizzard Breath.notes: Only used by the Blizzard Wyvern and Simorg.
Blizzard Breath.description: Deals ice breath damage to players in a cone.

Blockhead.name: Blockhead
Blockhead.description: Damages a single target with additional Knockback.

Blood Drain.name: Blood Drain
Blood Drain.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Tiyanak's Blood Drain regularly does 1k to non-tanks.
Blood Drain.description: Drains HP from a single player.

Blood Saber.name: Blood Saber
Blood Saber.description: Drains HP from players in range.

Blood Weapon.name: Blood Weapon
Blood Weapon.description: Self-buff: for its duration the user’s melee hits drain the target’s HP equal to the damage dealt.

Bloodrake.name: Bloodrake
Bloodrake.description: A three-hit attack that drains HP.

Bloody Beak.name: Bloody Beak
Bloody Beak.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Bloody Beak.description: A threefold attack in a 5' frontal cone that absorbs HP from targets.

Bloody Breath.name: Bloody Breath
Bloody Breath.description: Inflicts a 50-count Doom. Removed either by killing the monster or by conventional methods of removing doom such as Cursna.

Bloody Caress.name: Bloody Caress
Bloody Caress.notes: If it previously used Floral Bouquet, it may use it on its own charmed monster.
Bloody Caress.description: Single-target physical attack that drains HP equal to the damage dealt.

Bloody Claw.name: Bloody Claw
Bloody Claw.notes: Despite the attack ignoring Utsusemi, it is physical, and therefore capable of missing entirely.
Bloody Claw.description: Single-target HP drain that also absorbs one of the target's status enhancements; bypasses shadows. Used only while standing.

Bloody Mist.name: Bloody Mist
Bloody Mist.description: Cone-shaped magic damage with Bio; the mosquito gains a dispellable ~5,000 HP/tick regen.

Bloody Quarrel.name: Bloody Quarrel
Bloody Quarrel.notes: Used only by Haja Zhwan during Campaign.
Bloody Quarrel.description: Fires a barrage of life-leeching bolts, draining HP from all enemies within range.

Bloody Tomahawk.name: Bloody Tomahawk
Bloody Tomahawk.notes: Used only by Striking Bull during Campaign.
Bloody Tomahawk.description: Assaults enemies with a deadly throwing axe.

Blow.name: Blow
Blow.description: Lays the smackdown on a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Bludgeon.name: Bludgeon
Bludgeon.description: Deals three-hit damage to a single target.

Body Slam.name: Body Slam
Body Slam.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Body Slam.description: Deals physical damage to enemies in an area of effect. Can critical hit. Damage varies with TP.

Boiling Blood.name: Boiling Blood
Boiling Blood.notes: Combat log will only show haste effect.
Boiling Blood.description: The user gains Haste (+25%) and Berserk (+50%) for 3 minutes.

Boiling Point.name: Boiling Point
Boiling Point.notes: This attack can be extremely dangerous, greatly lowering a player's magic defence; thus causing a flan's spells to become tremendously powerful.
Boiling Point.description: Reduces magic defense in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Bolt of Perdition.name: Bolt of Perdition
Bolt of Perdition.description: Conal lightning damage with knockback; inflicts Mute and Amnesia (~30-40s).

Bomb Toss.name: Bomb Toss
Bomb Toss.notes: Magic accuracy varies with TP. Bypasses shadows. Can backfire — see Bomb Toss (Dropped).
Bomb Toss.description: Hurls an explosive bomb at an area.

Bomb Toss (Dropped).name: Bomb Toss (Dropped)
Bomb Toss (Dropped).notes: Damage equal to 1/3 of the goblin's remaining HP. Bypasses shadows.
Bomb Toss (Dropped).description: A bomb dropped when the goblin dies or its Bomb Toss backfires.

Bombilation.name: Bombilation
Bombilation.description: Removes TP from players in an area of effect, and halves the TP of NPCs.

Bone Crunch.name: Bone Crunch
Bone Crunch.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Plague

Bonebreaking Barrage.name: Bonebreaking Barrage
Bonebreaking Barrage.description: Conal physical barrage inflicting Gravity and Max HP Down (-60%).

Booby Prize.name: Booby Prize
Booby Prize.notes: The roll is one of Defense Down, Magic Defense Down, Attack Down, Magic Attack Down, Blind, Paralysis or Petrify.
Booby Prize.description: Inflicts one randomly chosen debuff on targets in an area of effect.

Booming Bleat.name: Booming Bleat
Booming Bleat.description: Inflicts Max HP Down (-50%) on enemies within an area. Ignores shadows.

Booming Bombination.name: Booming Bombination
Booming Bombination.description: Magical AoE damage with additional Plague, Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Boreas Mantle.name: Boreas Mantle
Boreas Mantle.notes: Only used by the Phantom Puk in ISNM Shadows of the Mind. Instead of merely causing a Blink effect, it creates replicas of itself (500HP each).
Boreas Mantle.description: Creates ghostly copies of the user.

Bowels of Agony.name: Bowels of Agony
Bowels of Agony.notes: Limited-range second-form attack seen on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Brain Crush.name: Brain Crush
Brain Crush.notes: Does Silence actually work as added effect?I did notice Brain Crush is noticeably better versus the Magic Pots.
Brain Crush.description: Damages a single target with additional Silence.

Brain Drain.name: Brain Drain
Brain Drain.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Brain Freeze.name: Brain Freeze
Brain Freeze.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Amnesia.

Brain Spike.name: Brain Spike
Brain Spike.notes: Not used by notorious monsters; see Impalement for the NM variant.
Brain Spike.description: Stabs a single target in the head. Additional effect: Paralysis

Brainjack.name: Brainjack
Brainjack.notes: Only used by Long-Armed Chariot and Long-Horned Chariot. Last roughly 90 seconds; DoT takes about 25HP/tick.
Brainjack.description: Brainjacks a player, charming them and inflicting damage over time.

Brazen Rush.name: Brazen Rush
Brazen Rush.description: A powered rushing attack used by Kalunga at 75% HP.

Brewing Storm.name: Brewing Storm
Brewing Storm.description: Conal damage with Flash, Attack Down, and Magic Attack Down.

Broadside Barrage.name: Broadside Barrage
Broadside Barrage.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 1 shadow. Notorious Monsters use an enhanced conal version.
Broadside Barrage.description: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: INT Down and MND Down (-19).

Brownout.name: Brownout
Brownout.description: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Blind (-50 Accuracy) and Slow.

Bubble Armor.name: Bubble Armor
Bubble Armor.description: Grants the user a dispelable Shell (about -20% magic damage taken).

Bubble Curtain.name: Bubble Curtain
Bubble Curtain.notes: Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that applies a Magic Defense Boost that cannot be dispelled.
Bubble Curtain.description: Grants the crab a Shell effect: -50% magic damage taken, 3 minutes.

Bubble Shower.name: Bubble Shower
Bubble Shower.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. A "Breath Weapon": damage scales with the crab's remaining HP, capped around 200 from standard crabs. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.
Bubble Shower.description: Water-based damage to players around the crab, proportional to its current HP (about HP/16). Additional effect: STR Down (-10 STR, decays 1 per 9s).

Bugle Call.name: Bugle Call
Bugle Call.notes: Vanasarvik uses Bugle Call to summon and resummon its Elder's Imps.
Bugle Call.description: Self-targeted buff — raises a Bio aura around the imp and may grant a secondary buff.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.notes: Used only by Buffalo involved in the Blazing Buffaloes event.

Burning Memories.name: Burning Memories
Burning Memories.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.
Burning Memories.description: Deals fire damage to players in an area with Amnesia and TP Reduction. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.

Burst.name: Burst
Burst.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Burst (Warmachine).name: Burst (Warmachine)
Burst (Warmachine).description: Fires several arrows at a single target.

Cackle.name: Cackle
Cackle.description: AoE that inflicts Magic Attack Down, Magic Defense Down, and Magic Accuracy Down.

Cacodemonia.name: Cacodemonia
Cacodemonia.notes: Used only by some NM versions of Diabolos; it is not available as a Blood Pact.
Cacodemonia.description: An area-of-effect attack that deals dark damage and inflicts Curse.

Cacophony.name: Cacophony
Cacophony.description: Grants the user a Counter boost and the effect of Haste.

Calamitous Wind.name: Calamitous Wind
Calamitous Wind.notes: Removes all shadows. Monster-centred. The dispel takes everything except food.
Calamitous Wind.description: Fourfold wind damage in a 20' area of effect, with a full dispel and Knockback.

Calcifying Claw.name: Calcifying Claw
Calcifying Claw.description: Conal physical attack with knockback and an additional Petrifaction effect.

Calcifying Deluge.name: Calcifying Deluge
Calcifying Deluge.description: Deals damage (~600) and Petrifies targets in a long-range cone.

Calcifying Mist.name: Calcifying Mist
Calcifying Mist.notes: Only used by notorious monsters. Counts down from 20, while gradually reducing movement speed (5% per countdown message). When counter reaches 0, petrification takes effect.
Calcifying Mist.description: Releases a mist; players in the area are petrified after 20 seconds.

Call of the Grave.name: Call of the Grave
Call of the Grave.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Call of the Grave.description: Inflicts INT Down (-10 INT, decaying 1 per 15 seconds) on players in an area of effect.

Call of the Moon.name: Call of the Moon
Call of the Moon.notes: All players and Campaign NPCs will be intimidated for a short time.
Call of the Moon.description: Howls at the moon to intimidate attackers.

Call to Arms (Ulla).name: Call to Arms (Ulla)
Call to Arms (Ulla).notes: Used only by Ulla during campaign battle. Upon using this ability, she will say:
Call to Arms (Ulla).description: Restores allied forces TP within the an area of effect.

Call Wyvern.name: Call Wyvern
Call Wyvern.notes: Absolute Virtue and Warder of Courage summon Aern's Wynavs instead of a normal wyvern.
Call Wyvern.description: Dragoon ability: summons a wyvern pet to fight alongside the user.

Camisado.name: Camisado
Camisado.description: Dark damage; the AoE version deals 500-700 with a 10' knockback.

Cannonball.name: Cannonball
Cannonball.description: Long-range single-target physical damage (used while curled).

Canopierce.name: Canopierce
Canopierce.description: Damage split among targets, plus Rasp.

Carcharian Verve.name: Carcharian Verve
Carcharian Verve.notes: Marine Mayhem is only ever used as the next technique after this. Both buffs should be dispelled immediately (high Magic Accuracy needed). Stunning the move stops the Attack and Magic Attack buffs but the water spear still activates. It opens a Red Stagger Window. Instead paints the row purple (Magical) and puts "Buff" in its Area cell.
Carcharian Verve.description: Self-buff. The user gains Attack Boost and Magic Attack Boost, removes its own negative status effects, and activates a water aura.

Carnal Nightmare.name: Carnal Nightmare
Carnal Nightmare.notes: Reduced effectiveness on pets and Campaign NPCs (only partial loss).
Carnal Nightmare.description: An enervating wave erases all TP in an area of effect.

Carousel.name: Carousel
Carousel.notes: NM only. Used immediately after View Sync as a combo; never used as a stand-alone move.
Carousel.description: Deals physical damage. Additional effect: Knockback.

Cataclysmic Vortex.name: Cataclysmic Vortex
Cataclysmic Vortex.notes: Shell and -MDT% gear both cut the damage. The enmity reset frequently pulls a Draw In straight afterwards, which can interrupt the cures you need right then.
Cataclysmic Vortex.description: AoE magical damage that tries to reduce every target to 1 HP, and resets the enmity of whoever holds the most hate.

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.notes: Used by RNG Gigas as a ranged attack.
Catapult.description: Tosses a boulder at a single target.

Catastrophic Malfunction.name: Catastrophic Malfunction
Catastrophic Malfunction.notes: Arch-Ultima only. Above 50% HP it is followed by a tier-V nuke or Comet; below 50% by a -ja nuke, Banishga IV, or Meteor.
Catastrophic Malfunction.description: Deals damage to players in range and lowers their elemental resistances.

Cathartic Caper.name: Cathartic Caper
Cathartic Caper.description: Cone-shaped magic damage that resets the target's TP.

Cattlepult.name: Cattlepult
Cattlepult.notes: Used only by Buffalo involved in the Blazing Buffaloes event. Inflicts no damage, but warps the target to the closest city (for example, if you are doing the event in Ronfaure and get hit with Cattlepult, you will be warped to San d'Oria).
Cattlepult.description: Launches a target back to the nearest nation.

Caudal Capacitor.name: Caudal Capacitor
Caudal Capacitor.notes: A radial, no-damage Stun centred on the caster. On Pakecet it grants Shock Spikes; Shockmaw follows it by switching to its Lightning casting phase.

Cauterizing Field.name: Cauterizing Field
Cauterizing Field.description: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Burn and Amnesia; the caster gains Enfire and Blaze Spikes. Used only by the floating head variant.

Celling Rupture.name: Celling Rupture
Celling Rupture.description: Conal damage with Bind, Max HP Down, and Knockback.

Cesspool.name: Cesspool
Cesspool.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Plague (-50 TP/-10 MP/tic) and Knockback. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Chains of Apathy.name: Chains of Apathy
Chains of Apathy.notes: Automatically fails and does nothing due to Light of Vahzl.
Chains of Apathy.description: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Arrogance.name: Chains of Arrogance
Chains of Arrogance.notes: Automatically fails and does nothing due to Light of Mea.
Chains of Arrogance.description: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Cowardice.name: Chains of Cowardice
Chains of Cowardice.notes: Automatically fails and does nothing due to Light of Holla.
Chains of Cowardice.description: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Envy.name: Chains of Envy
Chains of Envy.notes: Automatically fails and does nothing due to Light of Dem.
Chains of Envy.description: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Rage.name: Chains of Rage
Chains of Rage.notes: Automatically fails and does nothing due to Light of Al'Taieu.
Chains of Rage.description: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chant du Cygne.name: Chant du Cygne
Chant du Cygne.description: Three-hit sword weapon skill with a high critical-hit rate.

Chaos Blade.name: Chaos Blade
Chaos Blade.notes: Curse: -20% to -50% HP/MP, 1-15 min (varies with NMs). Damage is dealt before the Curse. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Chaos Blade.description: Deals dark damage to players in a cone, with an additional Curse effect.

Chaos Blast.name: Chaos Blast
Chaos Blast.description: Deals frontal area-of-effect damage with knockback.

Chaos Breath.name: Chaos Breath
Chaos Breath.notes: Only used by the Blizzard Wyvern, Cyranuce M Cutauleon, Simorg and Minaruja.
Chaos Breath.description: Deals dark breath damage to players in a cone.

Chaotic Eye.name: Chaotic Eye
Chaotic Eye.description: Inflicts Silence on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Charged Whisker.name: Charged Whisker
Charged Whisker.description: Deals lightning damage to enemies within an area of effect. Removes shadows.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description: Charms a single target, turning it against its allies.

Chastise.name: Chastise
Chastise.description: Inflicts Magic Attack Down and Magic Defense Down on players in an area of effect.

Chemical Bomb.name: Chemical Bomb
Chemical Bomb.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima early on. Slow is equivalent to Slow II, and so erase must be applied twice to remove both effects.
Chemical Bomb.description: Tosses a noxious explosive that inflicts elegy and slow on players in range.

Chilling Roar.name: Chilling Roar
Chilling Roar.notes: On Notorious Monsters, also summons adds and/or raises the monster's level.
Chilling Roar.description: Lets out a roar that inflicts Terror on nearby players.

Choke Breath.name: Choke Breath
Choke Breath.description: Earth-based damage in a frontal area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Paralysis.

Choke Chain.name: Choke Chain
Choke Chain.notes: Used only when the door is closed.

Chokehold.name: Chokehold
Chokehold.description: Wind-based ability that inflicts Silence, Gravity, and Choke and pulls the target in. On the Sortie NMs it instead steals a buff from each party member in range and transfers it to the caster.

Chomp Rush.name: Chomp Rush
Chomp Rush.description: A threefold attack on a single target with additional Slow (-25%).

Chthonian Ray.name: Chthonian Ray
Chthonian Ray.notes: Conal gaze that inflicts Doom. Used by certain Notorious Monster Taurus (e.g. Eldertaur, Mindertaur).
Chthonian Ray.description: Inflicts doom in a wide line gaze attack.

Chupa Blossom.name: Chupa Blossom
Chupa Blossom.description: Area-of-effect HP drain that absorbs multiple beneficial effects and lowers all of the target's stats.

Chymous Reek.name: Chymous Reek
Chymous Reek.notes: The Choke cannot be removed. Removes all shadows.
Chymous Reek.description: Cone-shaped damage plus Stun and a non-removable Choke.

Cimicine Discharge.name: Cimicine Discharge
Cimicine Discharge.description: Earth-based AoE that inflicts Slow on players while the gnat gains Haste.

Circle of Flames.name: Circle of Flames
Circle of Flames.description: Deals two-to-three-hit fire damage (scaling with the number of bombs in the cluster) and Gravity to targets in an area of effect.

Citadel Buster.name: Citadel Buster
Citadel Buster.notes: Used below ~25% HP after a ~30-second charge (up to ~2600 damage); resets hate. Preceded by a warning countdown and mitigated by Sentinel's Scherzo, Migawari: Ichi, or Earthen Armor.
Citadel Buster.description: Charges and unleashes a devastating light blast over a wide radius.

Citadel Siege.name: Citadel Siege
Citadel Siege.notes: Arch-Ultima only, at 49/39/29/19/9% HP. Avoidable by keeping distance; skipped while Arch-Ultima is readying Citadel Buster.

Clarsach Call.name: Clarsach Call
Clarsach Call.description: High wind damage in a wide radius; grants the Siren Attack/Defense/Evasion/Magic Attack/Magic Accuracy/Magic Evasion/Magic Defense bonuses for 3 minutes (each individually dispellable).

Claw Cyclone.name: Claw Cyclone
Claw Cyclone.description: Inflicts damage on enemies in a fan-shaped area.

Claw Storm.name: Claw Storm
Claw Storm.description: Slashes a single target in a threefold attack. Additional effect: Poison

Clobber.name: Clobber
Clobber.notes: Only used when targets behind it gets hate.
Clobber.description: Deals physical damage to players behind it (a tail swipe) with additional Knockback. Absorbable by 2-3 shadows.

Cloudsplitter.name: Cloudsplitter
Cloudsplitter.notes: Favored below 25% HP, alongside Darkness skillchains.
Cloudsplitter.description: Weapon skill dealing damage to a single target.

Cobra Clamp.name: Cobra Clamp
Cobra Clamp.description: Deals damage to targets in a line.

Cocoon.name: Cocoon
Cocoon.description: Grants the crawler a Defense Bonus (+100%).

Cold Breath.name: Cold Breath
Cold Breath.notes: Strength of ability is reliant on the current HP of the mob using it, like most Breath attacks.
Cold Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Bind

Cold Stare.name: Cold Stare
Cold Stare.notes: Only applies when face-to-face with the dhalmel.
Cold Stare.description: Silences enemies in a line area of effect.

Cold Wave.name: Cold Wave
Cold Wave.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Cold Wave.description: Inflicts Frost on targets in an area of effect (AGI -33, HP -14/tick, 15-60s).

Colossal Blow.name: Colossal Blow
Colossal Blow.notes: Used only by Proto-Omega, in its final form. Because of the long time to ready, it can be easily dodged or stunned.
Colossal Blow.description: Strikes a player for massive damage. Additional effect: Enmity reset + Knockback

Colossal Slam.name: Colossal Slam
Colossal Slam.notes: Used by Briareus and Cottus. Zombie effect cannot be removed and must expire normally.
Colossal Slam.description: Deals heavy physical damage in an area of effect, wipes shadows and inflicts Zombie status for a short time.

Coming Through.name: Coming Through
Coming Through.description: Conal damage with knockback. Absorbed by 2 shadows.

Concussive Oscillation.name: Concussive Oscillation
Concussive Oscillation.description: Smacks around all nearby targets. Additional effect: Knockback + Weight

Concussive Shock.name: Concussive Shock
Concussive Shock.description: Lightning damage that inflicts Slow and Stun.

Condemnation.name: Condemnation
Condemnation.notes: Restricted move — used by Dark Kindred (Dynamis, Uleguerand Range, Castle Oztroja [S], Campaign, Voidwatch). Consumes 3 shadows.
Condemnation.description: Threefold physical damage in a frontal cone, with additional Stun.

Consecration.name: Consecration
Consecration.description: Area-of-effect light magic damage. Additional effect: Stun.

Contagion Transfer.name: Contagion Transfer
Contagion Transfer.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Chickcharney's Attack rises with the number of buffs it absorbs with this move.
Contagion Transfer.description: Absorbs positive and negative status effects from targets in a cone.

Contamination.name: Contamination
Contamination.description: Transfers the monster's own debuffs to players in range.

Cordon of Apathy.name: Cordon of Apathy
Cordon of Apathy.description: Damage and multiple dispel. Dark Yggdreant exclusive.

Core Meltdown.name: Core Meltdown
Core Meltdown.description: Reactor core fails and self-destructs, damaging any nearby targets.

Corpse Breath.name: Corpse Breath
Corpse Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Cannered Noz uses it on every spawn except its last, which is how you know the fight is ending.
Corpse Breath.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blind.

Corrosive Ooze.name: Corrosive Ooze
Corrosive Ooze.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Corrosive Ooze.description: Damage in an area of effect around itself. Additional effects: Attack Down (-33%) and Defense Down (-33%).

Cosmic Breath.name: Cosmic Breath
Cosmic Breath.notes: Fires even with nobody in range. Standing to its sides avoids it outright, the same trick that lessens Wyrm breath.
Cosmic Breath.description: Front conal breath for moderate damage with Plague and Attack Down.

Counterspore.name: Counterspore
Counterspore.description: A magical ranged attack with a Knockback effect.

Cranial Thrust.name: Cranial Thrust
Cranial Thrust.description: Deals damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Max HP Down (-25%).

Crashing Thunder.name: Crashing Thunder
Crashing Thunder.notes: Centred on the monster. The aura gives the caster -Damage Taken and inflicts Avoidance Down; earth-based damage removes it.
Crashing Thunder.description: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effect: Knockback. The monster gains the thunder wing aura.

Crepuscular Grasp.name: Crepuscular Grasp
Crepuscular Grasp.description: AoE dark damage with Bind, Bio, and Paralyze.

Crimson Roar.name: Crimson Roar
Crimson Roar.range: Self only; Moblin Fantocciniman and Fantoccini were not affected despite being next to the Fantoccini Avatar when it was used.
Crimson Roar.notes: Used only by some NM versions of Ifrit; it is not available as a Blood Pact. Thus far, Tejas and Fantoccini Avatar have been confirmed to use this.

Crippling Gleam.name: Crippling Gleam
Crippling Gleam.description: Deals damage in an area of effect, dispels multiple status effects, and lowers all of the target’s attributes.

Crippling Rime.name: Crippling Rime
Crippling Rime.description: Conal ice damage that lowers all of the target's attributes (all stats down).

Crippling Slam.name: Crippling Slam
Crippling Slam.notes: Only used by Dea, Nihhus, Sentinel Wivre, and Keratyrannos.
Crippling Slam.description: Deals physical damage to players in a 15' area with potent Paralysis for 30-60 seconds.

Crispy Candle.name: Crispy Candle
Crispy Candle.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).
Crispy Candle.description: Hurls a burning candle at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Critical Bite.name: Critical Bite
Critical Bite.notes: More powerful version of Mandible Bite, used only by King Vinegarroon, Serket, and Nightmare Scorpions.
Critical Bite.description: Deals extreme damage to a single target.

Croctastrophe.name: Croctastrophe
Croctastrophe.description: Damage, Amnesia and knockback in a 30-yalm radius.

Cronos Sling.name: Cronos Sling
Cronos Sling.description: Inflicts damage to enemies in a cone.

Cross Attack.name: Cross Attack
Cross Attack.description: Deals 2-hit damage to a single target. The attack carries a +50% Attack bonus.

Cross Reaver.name: Cross Reaver
Cross Reaver.notes: Special weaponskill unique to Ark Angel HM. Deals ~500-900 damage.
Cross Reaver.description: Cone attack dealing heavy physical damage (~500-900).

Crossthrash.name: Crossthrash
Crossthrash.notes: used by Nightmare Tigers in Dynamis - Qufim and Gerjis in the BCNM 50 called Eye of the Tiger. It is believed to be used by some Tiger's NM aswell.
Crossthrash.description: Damages enemies within area of effect with a twofold attack. Additional effect: Knockback

Crosswind.name: Crosswind
Crosswind.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Crosswind.description: Deals damage (about 1/12 of max HP) to players in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Crowning Flatus.name: Crowning Flatus
Crowning Flatus.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Stun and Knockback.

Cruel Joke.name: Cruel Joke
Cruel Joke.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Skomora's and Triboulex's versions inflict Haunted instead of Doom - a stronger form of Curse - and ignore shadows.
Cruel Joke.description: Inflicts a 10-count Doom on players in an area of effect.

Cruel Riposte.name: Cruel Riposte
Cruel Riposte.notes: Used only by Mieuseloir B Enchelles during Campaign.
Cruel Riposte.description: Drains the life from enemies within range.

Crushing Gaze.name: Crushing Gaze
Crushing Gaze.description: Cone-shaped gaze that inflicts Gravity and Slow.

Cryo Jet.name: Cryo Jet
Cryo Jet.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Cryo Jet.description: Releases a freezing blast that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis

Cryojet.name: Cryojet
Cryojet.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Cryojet.description: Releases a freezing blast that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis

Crystal Bolide.name: Crystal Bolide
Crystal Bolide.description: AoE damage with Terror and Obliviscence (disables sub jobs).

Crystal Rain.name: Crystal Rain
Crystal Rain.description: Invokes the power of a crystal to deal damage to targets in an area of effect.

Crystal Shield.name: Crystal Shield
Crystal Shield.description: Invokes the power of a crystal to grant Protect (+20 Defense, ~5 min).

Crystal Weapon.name: Crystal Weapon
Crystal Weapon.notes: Can be , , , or element. Functions even at a distance (outside of melee range).
Crystal Weapon.description: Invokes the power of a crystal to deal magical damage of a random element to a single target.

Crystaline Cocoon.name: Crystaline Cocoon
Crystaline Cocoon.description: Encases in a crystal to apply Protect & Shell.

Crystalline Flare.name: Crystalline Flare
Crystalline Flare.notes: Only used by Riko Kupenreich. He will Draw In the entire party shortly before using this attack. The stun effect is unusually long.
Crystalline Flare.description: Deals moderate-high damage to opponents within Area of Effect. Additional Effect: Stun + Blind

Crystallite Shower.name: Crystallite Shower
Crystallite Shower.description: AoE damage with Dia, Slow, and Addle.

Curse.name: Curse
Curse.notes: Reduces maximum HP and MP by 25% for 15~38 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Curse.description: Inflicts Curse on all targets within a 15' radius.

Curse (Ghost).name: Curse (Ghost)
Curse (Ghost).notes: Curse has a very long duration.
Curse (Ghost).description: Inflicts a curse on all targets in an area of effect.

Cursed Sphere.name: Cursed Sphere
Cursed Sphere.notes: Water-based only when cast by Blue Mages; dark for the Fly family.
Cursed Sphere.description: Deals dark-based magic damage to players in a 10' area of effect.

Curtain Call.name: Curtain Call
Curtain Call.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bio.

Cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
Cutpurse.notes: If it removes the main weapon, anything in the sub slot is unequipped as well.
Cutpurse.description: Randomly removes one piece of the target's equipment.

Cyclone Wing.name: Cyclone Wing
Cyclone Wing.description: Deals darkness damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep

Cyclonic Blight.name: Cyclonic Blight
Cyclonic Blight.notes: Only used by Fuath, can give her a multitude of beneficial status effects upon use, including Regain (Status Effect), Regen (Status Effect), Protect (Status Effect) and Shell (Status Effect). Will always heal and Erase Fuath even if it misses or is absorbed.
Cyclonic Blight.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep & Stun

Cyclonic Torment.name: Cyclonic Torment
Cyclonic Torment.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback & Dispel

Cyclonic Torrent.name: Cyclonic Torrent
Cyclonic Torrent.notes: Only used by Urd, Verthandi, and Carabosse.
Cyclonic Torrent.description: Area of Effect damage plus Mute to those in range.

Cyclonic Turmoil.name: Cyclonic Turmoil
Cyclonic Turmoil.description: Deals Wind damage + Knockback + Dispel positive status effects.

Cyclotail.name: Cyclotail
Cyclotail.description: Flails around with its tail, dealing damage to targets in an area of effect.

Cytokinesis.name: Cytokinesis
Cytokinesis.notes: Only used by Blobdingnag and Fistule, which also call forth reinforcements with it — Fistule spawns 2 Pustules after using it. Paints the shadow count '3?'.
Cytokinesis.description: Area-of-effect damage with a powerful Gravity and Knockback.

Damnation Dive.name: Damnation Dive
Damnation Dive.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 2-3 shadows. Also reported for Ghrah in "bird" form.
Damnation Dive.description: Twofold damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Stun (up to 15 seconds).

Damning Edict.name: Damning Edict
Damning Edict.notes: Signals a period of physical immunity on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Damsel Memento.name: Damsel Memento
Damsel Memento.description: Restores ~5% HP and removes its status ailments; may boost its magic damage.

Dancing Chains.name: Dancing Chains
Dancing Chains.notes: The damage dealt per tic is 15 HP.
Dancing Chains.description: Underworldly chains twist and drown all targets in an area of effect.

Dancing Fullers.name: Dancing Fullers
Dancing Fullers.notes: Unaffected by Sentinel's Scherzo, One for All, or any Damage Taken reduction. Used at 75/50/25/10% HP.
Dancing Fullers.description: Deals 2,500 damage to each person within 10' of the user, including pets and luopans.

Dancing Tail.name: Dancing Tail
Dancing Tail.description: Conal physical damage from behind, 3-5 hits depending on wing position.

Danse Macabre.name: Danse Macabre
Danse Macabre.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Belphegor gains access to it at about 25% HP - have Fealty ready if you are tanking on PLD. S Charm effect fairly accurate.
Danse Macabre.description: Inflicts Charm on a single player for 60 seconds.

Dark Arrivisme.name: Dark Arrivisme
Dark Arrivisme.notes: Gains a strong Intimidation effect after use.
Dark Arrivisme.description: Deals damage and knockback and dispels up to three beneficial effects from targets in an area of effect; the user then gains Intimidation (75-95%) for one minute.

Dark Burst.name: Dark Burst
Dark Burst.description: Cone lightning magic damage with Stun that resets all of the user’s ability timers, and summons a Thunder Gyve.

Dark Flare.name: Dark Flare
Dark Flare.description: Cone fire magic damage with TP reset and Enmity reduction, and summons a Fire Gyve.

Dark Flood.name: Dark Flood
Dark Flood.description: Cone water magic damage with Encumbrance and Knockback, and summons a Water Gyve.

Dark Freeze.name: Dark Freeze
Dark Freeze.description: Cone ice magic damage with Terror and Enmity reduction, and summons an Ice Gyve.

Dark Invocation.name: Dark Invocation
Dark Invocation.notes: Exact effect(s) of this ability uncertain; used only by certain Campaign leaders and notorious monsters. May rarely be used by ordinary Yagudo populating Campaign areas; one used in West Sarutabaruta by a Yagudo Condottiere did about 400 damage to a 75 RDM/WHM.
Dark Invocation.description: Deals heavy dark damage to a single target. Additional effect: Doom/Death

Dark Matter.name: Dark Matter
Dark Matter.description: 20' AoE magical damage with Terror (15+ seconds).

Dark Mist.name: Dark Mist
Dark Mist.description: AoE Dark magic damage that inflicts Weight (Gravity) and removes shadows. Used only while flying.

Dark Moon.name: Dark Moon
Dark Moon.description: AoE dark magic damage with Weakness, summoning two Dark Gyves. Used below 50% HP.

Dark Nova.name: Dark Nova
Dark Nova.notes: Used during his first phase, in his magic stance.
Dark Nova.description: Dark energy damages targets in an area of effect.

Dark Orb.name: Dark Orb
Dark Orb.description: AoE Dark magic damage; bypasses shadows. Used only while flying.

Dark Quake.name: Dark Quake
Dark Quake.description: AoE earth magic damage with Bind and Amnesia, and summons an Earth Gyve.

Dark Recital.name: Dark Recital
Dark Recital.description: AoE magic damage with a full Dispel and Paralysis.

Dark Sphere.name: Dark Sphere
Dark Sphere.notes: Accuracy -20 for 5 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Dark Sphere.description: Throws an orb of dark energy at a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Dark Spore.name: Dark Spore
Dark Spore.notes: Can be very deadly from higher level funguars. The ability is a Breath attack, and as such is reliant on the current HP of the mob: the more HP, the more damage is dealt.
Dark Spore.description: Fan-shaped breath attack dealing dark damage (scales with the funguar's current HP). Additional effect: Blind.

Dark Star.name: Dark Star
Dark Star.notes: When wings are up, additionally inflicts Defense Down (-25%) and Magic Defense Down.
Dark Star.description: Deals magical damage in an area of effect.

Dark Sun.name: Dark Sun
Dark Sun.description: AoE light magic damage with a chance of Death, summoning two Light Gyves. Used below 50% HP.

Dark Thorn.name: Dark Thorn
Dark Thorn.description: The user gains Dread Spikes and Stoneskin.

Dark Tornado.name: Dark Tornado
Dark Tornado.description: AoE wind magic damage with a full Dispel and Knockback, and summons a Wind Gyve.

Dark Wave.name: Dark Wave
Dark Wave.notes: BG-wiki publishes the Type column for this move as unknown. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Dark Wave.description: Inflicts Bio on targets in an area of effect (-8 HP/tick daytime, -20 HP/tick nighttime).

Darkring Blade.name: Darkring Blade
Darkring Blade.notes: Klara only uses this in the Bonds of Mythril fight.
Darkring Blade.description: Area-of-effect sword weapon skill: heavy damage, knockback and Curse, dropping maximum HP by about half.

Daunting Hurl.name: Daunting Hurl
Daunting Hurl.description: Tosses a boulder at a single target sometimes causing Terror.

Daybreak.name: Daybreak
Daybreak.description: AoE damage; starts the 60-second timer for No Quarter.

Daydream.name: Daydream
Daydream.notes: Used incrementally after Nightmare (once after the first, twice after the second, and so on).

Deadening Haze.name: Deadening Haze
Deadening Haze.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Silence. Gains a poison aura (-13 HP/tick).

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.notes: Only used by Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon and Cookieduster Lipiroon.
Deadeye.description: Lowers the defense and magic defense of players in a frontal cone.

Deadly Dive.name: Deadly Dive
Deadly Dive.description: A powerful single diving physical attack on one target (Notorious Monster version of Deadly Drive).

Deadly Drive.name: Deadly Drive
Deadly Drive.description: A single-hit physical attack on one target.

Deadly Hold.name: Deadly Hold
Deadly Hold.description: Deals critical damage to a single target.

Deafening Tantara.name: Deafening Tantara
Deafening Tantara.notes: Silence lasts 30-60s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them). An imp cannot use this without its horn.

Deal Out.name: Deal Out
Deal Out.description: Deals damage and knockback to targets in a frontal cone.

Death Knell.name: Death Knell
Death Knell.notes: Used only by Zolku-Azolku at low health during Campaign.
Death Knell.description: Pronounces doom on all opponents in range.

Death Prophet.name: Death Prophet
Death Prophet.description: Frontal cone-shaped Death effect (instant K.O.). Usually used below 50% HP; can be stunned.

Death Ray.name: Death Ray
Death Ray.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Death Scissors.name: Death Scissors
Death Scissors.description: Single-target physical damage that can critically strike; grants a large Attack Bonus (+150%).

Death Sentence.name: Death Sentence
Death Sentence.description: Inflicts a 10-count Doom on the player holding significantly higher cumulative enmity than the next player on the hate list.

Death Trap.name: Death Trap
Death Trap.description: Inflicts Stun and Poison (~10 HP/tick for up to 5 minutes) on targets in an area of effect and resets its enmity.

Deathgnash.name: Deathgnash
Deathgnash.notes: Nuhn uses a more powerful version that reduces the target's HP to 1. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Deathgnash.description: Inflicts damage equal to 90% of the target's HP and resets enmity.

Deathly Diminuendo.name: Deathly Diminuendo
Deathly Diminuendo.description: Inflicts Curse (-50% HP and MP) and Bio on targets in an area of effect.

Deathly Glare.name: Deathly Glare
Deathly Glare.description: Conal gaze that inflicts Death on players facing it. Used below 50% HP; targets in range not killed by the gaze take minor damage (~400-500).

Debilitating Drone.name: Debilitating Drone
Debilitating Drone.notes: Used only in Chains of Promathia areas.
Debilitating Drone.description: Inflicts a random attribute reduction on enemies in an area of effect.

Debilitating Spout.name: Debilitating Spout
Debilitating Spout.description: Deals water damage to players in a cone-shaped area with a full Dispel, Knockback, and Zombie.

Debilitating Surge.name: Debilitating Surge
Debilitating Surge.notes: Palila only. Palila summons or resummons its vultures after using it.

Decayed Filament.name: Decayed Filament
Decayed Filament.description: Deals physical damage and Poison to targets in an area of effect.

Decollation.name: Decollation
Decollation.description: Damage to players in a cone. Can critical hit.

Decussate.name: Decussate
Decussate.notes: Only used by Gulool Ja Ja and Stealthlord Haraal Ja when below 35% health.
Decussate.description: Performs a cross attack on nearby targets.

Deep Sea Dirge.name: Deep Sea Dirge
Deep Sea Dirge.notes: The only single-target move in the family's kit.

Delta Thrust.name: Delta Thrust
Delta Thrust.description: A threefold thrust on a single target with additional Plague.

Demonic Flower.name: Demonic Flower
Demonic Flower.description: Sacrifices HP to deal damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weakness (~60s).

Demonic Howl.name: Demonic Howl
Demonic Howl.notes: Slow ~50% for 2-4 min. Lower priority than (blocked/overwritten by) Haste. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).
Demonic Howl.description: AoE attack that inflicts Slow on players in range.

Demoralizing Roar.name: Demoralizing Roar
Demoralizing Roar.description: Inflicts Attack Down (-50%) on players in a 10' area for 30-90 seconds.

Denounce.name: Denounce
Denounce.description: Deals damage proportional to the maximum HP of all players in range and resets enmity. Additional effects: Paralysis, Defense Down, and Magic Defense Down.

Depth Charge.name: Depth Charge
Depth Charge.description: Inflicts damage, shock, and knockback. The user gains Shock Spikes.

Depuration.name: Depuration
Depuration.notes: Erases all negative effects on the mob. Aerns will generally not attempt to use this ability if no erasable effects exist on them.
Depuration.description: Self-buff. Erases all negative status effects from the user.

Deracinator.name: Deracinator
Deracinator.description: Area-of-effect magical damage. Additional effect: Amnesia, Blind, and Muddle.

Dereliction.name: Dereliction
Dereliction.description: Steals HP and MP from enemies within range.

Descension.name: Descension
Descension.description: AoE damage; switches Arciela to dark mode.

Desiccation.name: Desiccation
Desiccation.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Desiccation.description: Frontal cone attack on a player: damage plus Knockback, removes all equipment, and resets all job ability timers to their maximum.

Destitution.name: Destitution
Destitution.description: Conal damage with Max HP Down and Terror.

Detonating Grip.name: Detonating Grip
Detonating Grip.notes: Sacrifices its right arm. Requires a right arm to use. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Detonating Grip.description: Deals heavy damage to targets in an area of effect. Guaranteed hit.

Dexter Wing.name: Dexter Wing
Dexter Wing.description: Right-side conal physical damage with knockback.

Diabolic Claw.name: Diabolic Claw
Diabolic Claw.notes: Used by a few caturae. Can be avoided by running out of melee range.
Diabolic Claw.description: Deals three-hit damage and Magic Defense Down to a single target.

Diamond Shell.name: Diamond Shell
Diamond Shell.notes: Used only by Quadav in WOTG areas.
Diamond Shell.description: Nullifies all physical damage from behind.

Diffractive Break.name: Diffractive Break
Diffractive Break.description: AoE damage with Amnesia, Muddle, and Silence.

Diffusion Ray.name: Diffusion Ray
Diffusion Ray.notes: Only used if person with hate is directly in front.
Diffusion Ray.description: Deals damage and dispels a beneficial effect.

Digest.name: Digest
Digest.description: Drains HP from a single player.

Dignified Awe.name: Dignified Awe
Dignified Awe.description: AoE. Additional effects: Amnesia and Bind.

Diluvial Wake.name: Diluvial Wake
Diluvial Wake.description: AoE water damage; inflicts Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Dimensional Death.name: Dimensional Death
Dimensional Death.notes: Deals hand-to-hand damage. Used exclusively by Shadows, though some Shadow notorious monsters can also use Fomor TP moves.
Dimensional Death.description: Rends the air with a dimension-splitting blow to a single target.

Dire Straight.name: Dire Straight
Dire Straight.notes: Requires a right arm to use. Removes all shadows.
Dire Straight.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Dire Whorl.name: Dire Whorl
Dire Whorl.notes: Used only by King Goldemar's merchandise.
Dire Whorl.description: Spins around, dealing physical damage to targets in a 10' area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Dirty Breath.name: Dirty Breath
Dirty Breath.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Dirty Breath.description: Breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Zombie.

Discharge.name: Discharge
Discharge.description: Releases an discharge at nearby targets. Additional effect: Paralyze

Discharger.name: Discharger
Discharger.notes: Used by Omega at low health (sometimes sooner).

Discoid.name: Discoid
Discoid.notes: Only used by Assailer Chariot, Battleclad Chariot, Battledressed Chariot, and Pandemonium Warden.
Discoid.description: Releases a fragmenting disc that deals fixed magical damage to players in an area of effect.

Discord Gambit.name: Discord Gambit
Discord Gambit.description: Deals dark-elemental damage and resets TP on targets in an area of effect.

Discordant Gambit.name: Discordant Gambit
Discordant Gambit.description: Deals damage, inhibits TP gain, and knocks back targets in an area of effect.

Discordant Note.name: Discordant Note
Discordant Note.notes: Used by the purple variant. Removes all shadows.
Discordant Note.description: Deals damage with knockback. Inflicts Slow, Silence, and a very potent Gravity.

Disembowel.name: Disembowel
Disembowel.description: Physical damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Accuracy Down.

Disgorge.name: Disgorge
Disgorge.description: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage, scaled by the HP absorbed with Gorge as well as by passive damage absorption. The total is split evenly among all targets in front of the caster.

Dismemberment.name: Dismemberment
Dismemberment.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Dismemberment.description: Sacrifices a limb to deal damage to a single target.

Disorienting Waul.name: Disorienting Waul
Disorienting Waul.description: Inflicts Amnesia on enemies in an area of effect.

Dispelling Wind.name: Dispelling Wind
Dispelling Wind.description: Dispels beneficial status effects (2-3) from targets in an area of effect.

Dissipation.name: Dissipation
Dissipation.notes: Full dispel. Can be blocked with Asylum. Used at set HP intervals.
Dissipation.description: Emits a pulse that strips beneficial effects from players in range. Additional effect: Terror + Enmity reset.

Dissolve.name: Dissolve
Dissolve.notes: Removes all shadows. Only used by Blobdingnag, Morbid Molasses, Fistule and Lorbulcrud. The enmity of the NM's target is erased a few seconds after the move executes; peripheral targets that are hit do not have their enmity reset.
Dissolve.description: An enhanced Digest: drains the HP of every target in a frontal cone.

Divesting Gale.name: Divesting Gale
Divesting Gale.description: AoE wind damage; inflicts Encumbrance and Muddle.

Divesting Stampede.name: Divesting Stampede
Divesting Stampede.description: AoE physical charge dealing damage, dispelling buffs, and lowering Defense and Magic Defense, with knockback.

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.notes: Only used by Cait Sith Ceithir.
Divine Favor.description: Removes status ailments from the caster.

Divine Judgment.name: Divine Judgment
Divine Judgment.notes: Used when Alexander is at 50% health, and may use it again when at low health. Can deal over 1000 damage. Used several times like an Astral Flow blood pact, but without regard to time. As he uses this ability, Alexander will announce:
Divine Judgment.description: Deals damage, then applies a full dispel and full MP removal.

Divine Spear.name: Divine Spear
Divine Spear.notes: Only used if player with hate is in front. Sometimes accompanied by the text:
Divine Spear.description: Deals damage with Petrify, Attack Down (-50%), and Magic Attack Down.

Dominion Slash.name: Dominion Slash
Dominion Slash.notes: Absorbable by Utsusemi; can also dispel buffs.
Dominion Slash.description: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Doom (Yagudo).name: Doom (Yagudo)
Doom (Yagudo).notes: Only used by named NM Yagudo in Dynamis, as well as Dee Xalmo the Grim when he's at low health. Unlike Mortal Ray and Eternal Damnation, this is not a gaze attack.
Doom (Yagudo).description: Pronounces Doom upon a single target.

Doomvoid.name: Doomvoid
Doomvoid.notes: Onychophora's version instead K.O.s the entire party, and is used when multiple repeat skillchains are performed on it.
Doomvoid.description: Sends all targets in range to the Ghoyu's Reverie, Everbloom Hollow or Ruhotz Silvermines battlefield.

Double Claw.name: Double Claw
Double Claw.description: A 2-hit physical attack on a single target.

Double Down.name: Double Down
Double Down.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Double Down.description: Deals damage to a single target, resets the user’s enmity, and grants the user a 100% attack boost.

Double Kick.name: Double Kick
Double Kick.notes: Stun may or may not take effect.
Double Kick.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Double Ray.name: Double Ray
Double Ray.description: Deals non-elemental magic damage to a single target.

Double Whammy.name: Double Whammy
Double Whammy.description: Deals two consecutive hits to a single target.

Dragon Breath.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon Breath.notes: Used only by Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Trust: Areuhat. Because of the high damage output from Fafnir/Nidhogg/Wyrm, it is usually avoided by standing on (or near) the wyrm's two front feet. Cynoprosopi's breath attack is much less painful.
Dragon Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Dragonfall.name: Dragonfall
Dragonfall.description: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Drain Whip.name: Drain Whip
Drain Whip.description: Single-target attack that drains HP, MP, or TP.

Drainkiss.name: Drainkiss
Drainkiss.description: Drains HP from a single target.

Draw In.name: Draw In
Draw In.notes: Players who have taken no action are not on its hate list and are not drawn in. It also draws the party in at random while readying a TP move or casting an area spell, so the whole alliance eats the follow-up.
Draw In.description: Pulls its current target, and every party member holding hate, to the user.

Dread Dive.name: Dread Dive
Dread Dive.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Gliding Spike.
Dread Dive.description: Twofold damage to a single player.

Dread Shriek.name: Dread Shriek
Dread Shriek.description: Inflicts Paralysis on players in an area of effect.

Dread Wind.name: Dread Wind
Dread Wind.notes: Terror lasts about 10 seconds. Removes all shadows. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Stormwind.
Dread Wind.description: Damage to players in an area of effect centred on the monster.

Dreaded Shriek.name: Dreaded Shriek
Dreaded Shriek.description: Inflicts a potent Paralysis on players in an area of effect (Notorious Monster version of Dread Shriek).

Dreadstorm.name: Dreadstorm
Dreadstorm.description: Deals AoE damage and inflicts Terror (up to 10 seconds); removes all shadows.

Dream Shroud.name: Dream Shroud
Dream Shroud.description: Grants Diabolos a Magic Attack and Magic Defense boost.

Drill Branch.name: Drill Branch
Drill Branch.description: Drills a single target with a branch.

Drill Claw.name: Drill Claw
Drill Claw.description: A conal attack that deals physical damage with an added Max HP Down (-75%) and Knockback effect.

Droning Whirlwind.name: Droning Whirlwind
Droning Whirlwind.notes: Blink Whirlwind aura removable only by depleting the shadows or dealing ice damage, not by AoE. On Xevioso it opens the !! proc window.
Droning Whirlwind.description: Deals wind damage to enemies in an area with Knockback and multiple Dispel. The Bztavian gains 50 Magic Defense and raises its Blink Whirlwind aura (25 shadows). Used as the first TP move below each 25% HP threshold.

Drop Hammer.name: Drop Hammer
Drop Hammer.description: Drops the hammer. Additional effect: Bind

Dukkeripen.name: Dukkeripen
Dukkeripen.notes: Used only by Corsair Lamia — a random Phantom Roll-like effect.
Dukkeripen.description: Restores HP, grants Utsusemi, or inflicts Paralysis on the Lamia and nearby monsters.

Dunur Strike.name: Dunur Strike
Dunur Strike.description: Conal (15’) physical damage that strips one random equipment slot (no Encumbrance).

Durance Whip.name: Durance Whip
Durance Whip.description: Cone physical damage with additional Bio, Bind, and Amnesia.

Dust Cloud.name: Dust Cloud
Dust Cloud.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Blind.

Dust Storm.name: Dust Storm
Dust Storm.description: Deals damage and inflicts Blindness on targets behind the user.

Dustvoid.name: Dustvoid
Dustvoid.notes: Removes all shadows. Does not inflict Encumbrance, so lost gear can be re-equipped immediately.
Dustvoid.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Knockback, and removes all equipment.

Dynamic Implosion.name: Dynamic Implosion
Dynamic Implosion.description: AoE physical damage with additional Terror.

Dynastic Gravitas.name: Dynastic Gravitas
Dynastic Gravitas.description: AoE physical attack. Additional effect: Amnesia.

Eagle Eye Shot.name: Eagle Eye Shot
