Eagle Eye Shot.description: A ranged attack that is guaranteed to hit.

Earth Blade.name: Earth Blade
Earth Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enstone aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Earth Breath.name: Earth Breath
Earth Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Earth Pounder.name: Earth Pounder
Earth Pounder.description: Deals damage to enemies within area of effect. Additional effect: Dexterity Down

Earth Shock.name: Earth Shock
Earth Shock.description: Creates a seismic wave to damage targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Earthbreaker.name: Earthbreaker
Earthbreaker.notes: Stronger version of Earth Pounder, used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, and Nightmare Scorpions.
Earthbreaker.description: Deals damage to enemies within massive area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Earthen Fury.name: Earthen Fury
Earthen Fury.notes: Once per battle. Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Earthen Fury.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Titan's ultimate earth attack, dealing heavy damage in an area of effect.

Earthen Ward.name: Earthen Ward
Earthen Ward.description: Blood Pact: Ward. Grants a Stoneskin effect.

Earthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Earthshatter.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect.

Earthshock.name: Earthshock
Earthshock.description: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Ebullient Nullification.name: Ebullient Nullification
Ebullient Nullification.notes: Used at 100/75/50/25/10% HP. Does not dispel Aftermath, Dematerialize, runes, or other non-dispellable buffs.
Ebullient Nullification.description: Dispels and absorbs all beneficial effects from players within 20' of the user, gaining Attack and Magic Attack that scale with the number absorbed.

Echolocation.name: Echolocation
Echolocation.notes: Using Echolocation while its Pugils are out makes them change targets at random.

Ecliptic Meteor.name: Ecliptic Meteor
Ecliptic Meteor.description: Summons a meteor to smash the opposition. Additional effect: Paralysis + Bio + Blind

Ectosmash.name: Ectosmash
Ectosmash.notes: Can critical hit. Mob is still set to same spot for attacks and abilities that deal with monster position, such as Sneak Attack and Cover. Monster will always return to this starting position after. Consumes 1 shadow.
Ectosmash.description: Teleports in to smack a single target.

Edge of Death.name: Edge of Death
Edge of Death.notes: Used only by the genji armor NMs during Feast of Swords event.
Edge of Death.description: Reduces HP of all targets to 1.

Efflorescent Foetor.name: Efflorescent Foetor
Efflorescent Foetor.notes: Blind potency -100. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.
Efflorescent Foetor.description: Frontal cone. Inflicts Blind and Silence.

Eldritch Wind.name: Eldritch Wind
Eldritch Wind.description: AoE damage + full Dispel + Addle + Plague.

Electrocharge.name: Electrocharge
Electrocharge.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Electrocharge.description: Deals unaspected magic damage to a single target.

Electromagnetic Field.name: Electromagnetic Field
Electromagnetic Field.notes: Used only in Promathia Mission 6-2. Removes all shadows.
Electromagnetic Field.description: Deals lightning damage and knockback to targets in an area of effect.

Elemental Sforzo.name: Elemental Sforzo
Elemental Sforzo.notes: A Blue Mage job ability the NMs borrow. Procne uses it; Ongo uses it at 75% HP.

Eleventh Dimension.name: Eleventh Dimension
Eleventh Dimension.notes: Used ~1:30 after Target activates on that player.
Eleventh Dimension.description: Inflicts a 3-minute Terror on the player that Target was used on.

Embalming Earth.name: Embalming Earth
Embalming Earth.description: Deals earth damage to enemies in an area with additional Slow. Removes all shadows.

Emetic Discharge.name: Emetic Discharge
Emetic Discharge.notes: Transfers all of the gnat's ailments onto one player; used by Gnat NMs below ~33% HP.
Emetic Discharge.description: Transfers all ailments to another player.

Empty Cutter.name: Empty Cutter
Empty Cutter.description: Deals physical damage to a single target. Can land a critical hit.

Empty Kiss.name: Empty Kiss
Empty Kiss.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison + Plague

Empty Salvation.name: Empty Salvation
Empty Salvation.description: AoE damage (~250) that dispels up to 3 beneficial effects.

Empty Seed.name: Empty Seed
Empty Seed.notes: The knockback can push players very far.
Empty Seed.description: Deals physical damage to targets in a 20' area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback.

Energy Screen.name: Energy Screen
Energy Screen.notes: Cannot be active at the same time as Mana Screen.
Energy Screen.description: Erects a barrier that nullifies physical damage.

Enervating Grasp.name: Enervating Grasp
Enervating Grasp.description: Deals area damage. Additional effects: Paralysis, Bind, and Defense Down.

Enforce.name: Enforce
Enforce.notes: Ambuscade only. The monster recovers more than it takes from each player, and the drain is weaker the less HP a player has. Removes all shadows.
Enforce.description: Drains HP from players within 15 feet, but cannot defeat a player.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description: Attempts to bind a single target with vines. Bypasses shadows.

Enthrall.name: Enthrall
Enthrall.notes: Used only by Rani. Anyone charmed with this ability will also gain the effect of Sippoy Costume.
Enthrall.description: Charms targets in an area of effect and applies a Caturae "Sippoy" costume.

Entomb.name: Entomb
Entomb.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Petrifaction.

Envoutement.name: Envoutement
Envoutement.description: Deals damage to a single player. Additional effect: Curse (-25% HP and MP, 3 minutes).

Epoxy Spread.name: Epoxy Spread
Epoxy Spread.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Epoxy Spread.description: Splashes a binding resin around in a 10' area of effect.

Equalizer.name: Equalizer
Equalizer.description: Deals physical damage to players in range. Additional effect: Knockback.

Equalizer (Ultima).name: Equalizer (Ultima)
Equalizer (Ultima).notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima (after sustaining considerable damage).
Equalizer (Ultima).description: Deals heavy damage to players with a spinning attack.

Eradicator.name: Eradicator
Eradicator.description: Deals magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Weakness.

Erosion Dust.name: Erosion Dust
Erosion Dust.notes: Dia effect is equivalent to Dia III. The damage dealt per tic, however, is 11 damage.
Erosion Dust.description: Spreads eroding dust particles on targets in an area of effect, dealing damage and inflicting Dia.

Erratic Flutter.name: Erratic Flutter
Erratic Flutter.description: AoE fire damage; the target gains Haste.

Essence Devour.name: Essence Devour
Essence Devour.description: Conal attack that drains HP and MP from a player and lowers all attributes for 30 seconds.

Essence Jack.name: Essence Jack
Essence Jack.notes: If the copied player is out of range the Spitewarden breaks off its current target and runs at them to land it. Not a hate reset — the behaviour lasts only until Essence Jack connects.
Essence Jack.description: Used at low health on the player whose gear the Spitewarden copied. Inflicts Terror and lowers all of that player's stats; the Spitewarden's own damage rises sharply, apparently by absorbing what it drains.

Eternal Damnation.name: Eternal Damnation
Eternal Damnation.description: A conal gaze that inflicts Doom.

Eternal Misery.name: Eternal Misery
Eternal Misery.description: Damage, ~5-second Zombie, and an enmity reset.

Euhedral Swat.name: Euhedral Swat
Euhedral Swat.description: High AoE damage and knockback with Attack Down and Defense Down; used when hate is pulled from behind.

Evasion (Scorpion).name: Evasion (Scorpion)
Evasion (Scorpion).notes: Used by Serket and Nightmare Scorpions.

Everyone's Grudge.name: Everyone's Grudge
Everyone's Grudge.notes: Damage scales with how many Tonberries the character has killed; unaffected by magic defense.
Everyone's Grudge.description: Deals magic damage to a single target based on the target's cumulative "Tonberry Hate" (number of Tonberry-family monsters the target has defeated).

Everyone's Grudge (ability).name: Everyone's Grudge (ability)
Everyone's Grudge (ability).notes: Damage is 5x the amount of Tonberries slain in the Elshimo regions.
Everyone's Grudge (ability).description: Invokes collective hatred to spite a single target.

Everyone's Rancor.name: Everyone's Rancor
Everyone's Rancor.notes: Damage is 50x the amount of Tonberries slain. Only used by certain Notorious Monsters, generally only once and when they have reached a certain percentage of HP (usually 25%).
Everyone's Rancor.description: Invokes rancor to spite a single target.

Exorender.name: Exorender
Exorender.description: Frontal cone-shaped damage; the mantid levels up afterward (and kills any assisting flies caught in the cone). Used by Tsui-Goab and Tenodera.

Exponential Burst.name: Exponential Burst
Exponential Burst.description: Deals heavy magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Magic Defense Down.

Expunge.name: Expunge
Expunge.notes: Used after Primordial Surge, below 25% HP.
Expunge.description: AoE damage scaled by the damage absorbed during Primordial Surge, plus a full dispel.

Extirpating Salvo.name: Extirpating Salvo
Extirpating Salvo.description: Physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun.

Extreme Purgation.name: Extreme Purgation
Extreme Purgation.notes: Removes all shadows. Every buff it absorbs has to be dispelled off it individually.
Extreme Purgation.description: Absorbs any status effects from targets in range, including SP abilities and ailments. Food and Reraise are not absorbed.

Extremely Bad Breath.name: Extremely Bad Breath
Extremely Bad Breath.description: A fan-shaped breath that instantly K.O.s players in range.

Exuviation.name: Exuviation
Exuviation.description: Removes the user's negative status effects and restores HP based on the number removed.

Eye Scratch.name: Eye Scratch
Eye Scratch.description: Scratches a single target right in the eyes. Additional effect: Blind

Eyes On Me.name: Eyes On Me
Eyes On Me.description: Single-target magic damage that ignores Magic Damage Taken (but not Magic Defense Bonus) and cannot be resisted.

False Promises.name: False Promises
False Promises.description: Charms targets in an area of effect.

Familiar.name: Familiar
Familiar.notes: A Beastmaster job ability the NM borrows.

Fanatic Dance.name: Fanatic Dance
Fanatic Dance.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Dynamis and Wings of the Goddess areas.
Fanatic Dance.description: Attempts to charm targets in an area of effect.

Fang Rush.name: Fang Rush
Fang Rush.description: Deals major damage with a threefold attack to a single target.

Fantod.name: Fantod
Fantod.description: The monster gains a quadruple damage bonus for its next attack round.

Fatal Allure.name: Fatal Allure
Fatal Allure.description: Cone gaze that Charms and inflicts a 60-second Poison. The charm can be avoided by facing away from the caster. Used while under Trance.

Fatal Scream.name: Fatal Scream
Fatal Scream.notes: Used by Chloris and Pancimanci and Annihilative Adenium.
Fatal Scream.description: Area-of-effect attack that inflicts a 10-second Doom.

Faze.name: Faze
Faze.notes: Sight-based; turning away from the monster negates it.
Faze.description: Inflicts Terror on a single target.

Fear Touch.name: Fear Touch
Fear Touch.notes: Slow 25% for 5 minutes. Can critical hit. Consumes 1 shadow.
Fear Touch.description: Touches a single target. Additional effect: Slow

Feast of Arrows.name: Feast of Arrows
Feast of Arrows.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it also inflicts Bio.
Feast of Arrows.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind.

Feather Barrier.name: Feather Barrier
Feather Barrier.notes: Duration varies with TP (3~10 minutes). Shared by the standard and the enhanced NM sets - it is not swapped out.
Feather Barrier.description: The monster grants itself an Evasion Bonus (+25).

Feather Maelstrom.name: Feather Maelstrom
Feather Maelstrom.notes: Used only by the Seed Yagudo.
Feather Maelstrom.description: Sends a storm of feathers to a single target. Additional effect: Bio & Amnesia

Feather Tickle.name: Feather Tickle
Feather Tickle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Feathered Furore.name: Feathered Furore
Feathered Furore.notes: Used only by Yagudo in WOTG areas. It will randomly remove one piece of visible equipment (i.e. anything other than accessories or ranged/ammo), and will also remove any shield/grip/sub-weapon if the main weapon is knocked off. However, this ability has a chance to miss. It has no effect on pets or NPC defenders.
Feathered Furore.description: Removes one random piece of equipment from players in a fan shaped area.

Feeble Bleat.name: Feeble Bleat
Feeble Bleat.notes: Used only by the Karakul in the Near East.
Feeble Bleat.description: Emits a unnerving bleat that paralyzes all in range.

Feral Peck.name: Feral Peck
Feral Peck.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Feral Peck.description: Reduces the HP of targets in a frontal cone by 90%, and resets the enmity of those hit.

Fetid Eddies.name: Fetid Eddies
Fetid Eddies.description: Cone-shaped attack on a player: damage plus Gravity. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Fevered Pitch.name: Fevered Pitch
Fevered Pitch.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun and Defense Down

Fiery Blast.name: Fiery Blast
Fiery Blast.notes: Ranged Magical Fire Damage. Can be reduced by fire resist set, Carol, Barfira and MDT. Used in flight by Wyrms.

Fiery Breath.name: Fiery Breath
Fiery Breath.description: Deals HP-dependent fire breath damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Ignores shadows.

Filamented Hold.name: Filamented Hold
Filamented Hold.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Filamented Hold.description: Inflicts Slow (~50%) on players in a cone-shaped area.

Final Retribution.name: Final Retribution
Final Retribution.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Final Sting.name: Final Sting
Final Sting.description: A self-sacrificing sting used at low HP. Deals magic damage based on the bee's current HP (~Current HP x .5), then removes the bee's own remaining HP (the bee dies). Bypasses shadows.

Fire Angon.name: Fire Angon
Fire Angon.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.
Fire Angon.description: Deals fire damage to players in an area. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.

Fire Arrow.name: Fire Arrow
Fire Arrow.description: Deals fire damage to a single target.

Fire Arrow (Warmachine).name: Fire Arrow (Warmachine)
Fire Arrow (Warmachine).description: Fires a burning arrow at a single target.

Fire Blade.name: Fire Blade
Fire Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enfire aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Fire Break.name: Fire Break
Fire Break.description: Deals heavy damage to targets in front.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Deals fire damage to players in a 10' area of effect.

Firebomb.name: Firebomb
Firebomb.description: Deals fire damage to players in an area of effect around the target.

Firefly Aura.name: Firefly Aura
Firefly Aura.description: Gains a regen firefly aura and removes status ailments.

Firespit.name: Firespit
Firespit.notes: BLU/BST/DRG/NIN/THF forms are 3-hit physical and consume 3 Utsusemi shadows; BLM/WHM forms are magical and bypass shadows without removing them.
Firespit.description: A fire-based attack. Melee Mamool Ja land a 3-hit physical version; caster Mamool Ja deal single-target fire magic damage.

Flailing Trunk.name: Flailing Trunk
Flailing Trunk.description: Deals damage in a cone; can critical strike. Removes 2-3 shadows.

Flame Armor.name: Flame Armor
Flame Armor.description: Grants the user the effect of Blaze Spikes.

Flame Blast.name: Flame Blast
Flame Blast.notes: Used only by Wyrm when he's in the sky.
Flame Blast.description: A fire storm deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Flame Breath.name: Flame Breath
Flame Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Flame Breath.description: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone. Damage ~ Current HP x 1/10 (cap 400).

Flame Thrower.name: Flame Thrower
Flame Thrower.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Flame Thrower.description: Uses a flamethrower that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Plague

Flank Opening.name: Flank Opening
Flank Opening.description: Deals damage and knockback to targets in an area of effect and applies a -50% Defense Down aura.

Flashflood.name: Flashflood
Flashflood.description: AoE damage that dispels multiple enhancements.

Flesh Syphon.name: Flesh Syphon
Flesh Syphon.description: Physical damage to a single target while absorbing its attributes.

Floodlight.name: Floodlight
Floodlight.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form).
Floodlight.description: Fires a searing light over a large area.

Floral Bouquet.name: Floral Bouquet
Floral Bouquet.notes: Monsters may be charmed by this move.
Floral Bouquet.description: Area-of-effect Sleep; also charms nearby Bees.

Flowerpot (Ability).name: Flowerpot (Ability)
Flowerpot (Ability).notes: Only used by the Henchman Moogles.
Flowerpot (Ability).description: Drops a flowerpot on an enemy, disorientating them. Additional Effect: Blind, Stun, and Amnesia

Fluid Spread.name: Fluid Spread
Fluid Spread.description: Splashes liquid around in a 10' area of effect. Damage with a 50% attack bonus.

Fluid Toss.name: Fluid Toss
Fluid Toss.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Damage appears to vary with TP.
Fluid Toss.description: Lobs a ball of liquid at a single player. Damage with a 100% attack bonus.

Fluorescence.name: Fluorescence
Fluorescence.description: Self-buff. Gains Boost; its next attack deals roughly four times damage.

Flurry of Rage.name: Flurry of Rage
Flurry of Rage.notes: Only used by Eldritch Edge, Malefic Fencer, and Nightmare Weapon.
Flurry of Rage.description: Deals multiple hits to a single target.

Flying Hip Press.name: Flying Hip Press
Flying Hip Press.description: Deals Wind damage to targets in an area of effect.

Forceful Blow.name: Forceful Blow
Forceful Blow.notes: Used by hand-to-hand (H2H) Mamool Ja only.
Forceful Blow.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Formation Attack.name: Formation Attack
Formation Attack.notes: Damage depends on how many individual bombs remain.
Formation Attack.description: Deals two-to-three-hit damage (scaling with the number of bombs in the cluster) to a single target.

Fortifying Wail.name: Fortifying Wail
Fortifying Wail.description: The monster gains a physical damage taken reduction of about 25% for 90 to 120 seconds.

Fossilizing Breath.name: Fossilizing Breath
Fossilizing Breath.description: Frontal cone breath that inflicts Petrifaction.

Foul Breath.name: Foul Breath
Foul Breath.notes: One of the three possible breath moves used by raptors, the other two being Frost Breath and Thunderbolt. Any raptor can only use one of these moves; which breath is used is dependent on the overall climate of the area the raptor is in. Foul Breath is used by raptors in dry desert/mountainous areas, such as Meriphataud Mountains and Cape Teriggan.
Foul Breath.description: Deals fire damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Disease.

Foul Waters.name: Foul Waters
Foul Waters.notes: Removes all shadows. U Bnai's version is single-target and inflicts Blind instead of Gravity/Drown.
Foul Waters.description: Cone-shaped damage plus Gravity and Drown (-41 STR, -14 HP/tick).

Fountain.name: Fountain
Fountain.description: A frontal attack that deals water damage.

Foxfire.name: Foxfire
Foxfire.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a one-handed weapon (principally RDM, THF, PLD, BST, BRD, RNG, NIN, and COR fomors).
Foxfire.description: Strikes frontal targets with a luminous wave. Additional effect: Stun

Fragor Maximus.name: Fragor Maximus
Fragor Maximus.description: AoE damage that applies Weakness; the caster gains a strong Killer (intimidation) effect for a time.

Freeze Rush.name: Freeze Rush
Freeze Rush.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Freeze Rush.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Frenetic Rip.name: Frenetic Rip
Frenetic Rip.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. An imp resorts to this only while its horn is broken.

Frenzy Pollen.name: Frenzy Pollen
Frenzy Pollen.notes: Used only by Nightmare Hornets in Dynamis - Tavnazia and the Chasmic Hornet in Abyssea - La Theine.

Frightful Roar.name: Frightful Roar
Frightful Roar.notes: Defense Down (Defense x199/256, 2-3 min). Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Frightful Roar.description: Inflicts Defense Down in an area of effect.

Frigid Shuffle.name: Frigid Shuffle
Frigid Shuffle.notes: A GAZE attack — bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Ironbeak Inguza's version also resets enmity on all affected party members; turning your back to it avoids the reset.
Frigid Shuffle.description: An icy waltz that paralyzes targets who see it.

Frog Cheer.name: Frog Cheer
Frog Cheer.notes: Elemental Seal effect wears off after one spell is cast.

Frog Chorus.name: Frog Chorus
Frog Chorus.description: Attempts to charm targets in an area of effect.

Frog Song.name: Frog Song
Frog Song.notes: Grants a poroggo costume while charmed.
Frog Song.description: Attempts to charm a single target.

From the Skies.name: From the Skies
From the Skies.description: Damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Encumbrance (~10 seconds), Choke (19 HP/tick) and Knockback.

Frond Fatale.name: Frond Fatale
Frond Fatale.description: Cone-shaped Charm. Vir'ava also uses it to summon its Rafflesia adds.

Frost Blade.name: Frost Blade
Frost Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enblizzard aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Frost Breath.name: Frost Breath
Frost Breath.description: Deals ice damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Paralysis.

Frozen Mist.name: Frozen Mist
Frozen Mist.notes: The user also gains an ice aura and absorbs Ice damage for its duration; the aura remains until enough physical damage is dealt or about 3 minutes pass. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.
Frozen Mist.description: Inflicts Terror (20s) and grants the user a unique Stoneskin that absorbs only 1,500 physical damage.

Frypan.name: Frypan
Frypan.notes: Damage and Stun (5-15s), 10' radius. Consumes 2-3 shadows. A Moblin TP move.
Frypan.description: Smashes the area with a frying pan.

Full Bloom.name: Full Bloom
Full Bloom.description: Sacrifices a nearby pet/Rafflesia to restore roughly 10% HP and erase negative status effects. Additional effect: Stoneskin. Instantly K.O.s a charmed player if used on one.

Full-force Blow.name: Full-force Blow
Full-force Blow.description: Damage with Knockback to a single player. Can critical hit. Has a 50% attack bonus.

Full-Force Blow.name: Full-Force Blow
Full-Force Blow.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback.

Fulmination.name: Fulmination
Fulmination.notes: Uses only when Khimaira is at 35% health or less. Tyger will use under 50% health or less.
Fulmination.description: Massive AoE Lightning (Thunder) damage (600-1100) with Stun and potent Paralysis.

Fulminous Smash.name: Fulminous Smash
Fulminous Smash.description: AoE damage with Stun and Knockback.

Furious Flurry.name: Furious Flurry
Furious Flurry.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.
Furious Flurry.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weight and Silence

Fuscous Ooze.name: Fuscous Ooze
Fuscous Ooze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Prevents equipment from being changed; it used to also strip equipment from the target, which was removed in the October 7th 2014 update because losing iLvl gear was too powerful.
Fuscous Ooze.description: Damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Weight and Encumbrance (30~45s).

Gaea Stream.name: Gaea Stream
Gaea Stream.description: Inflicts damage to a single target.

Gagnrath.name: Gagnrath
Gagnrath.notes: Odin will say a random speech before using this move.
Gagnrath.description: Conal physical damage that inflicts Terror.

Gala Macabre.name: Gala Macabre
Gala Macabre.notes: The AoE version of Danse Macabre; bypasses shadows without removing them. Giltine uses it after Memento Mori, occasionally with a spell in between - stunning Memento Mori or that spell stops it.
Gala Macabre.description: Inflicts Charm on players in an area of effect for 60 seconds.

Galumph.name: Galumph
Galumph.description: Damage, Stun and Attack Down in a 15-yalm radius.

Gardez.name: Gardez
Gardez.notes: Can be fully resisted with sufficient magic evasion.
Gardez.description: Inflicts Terror for 3-10 seconds on targets within 20' of the user.

Gas Shell.name: Gas Shell
Gas Shell.notes: Poison ticks for 26 HP and lasts 30~90 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. It is the family's shell-mode retaliation - the mob uses it when physically attacked while inside its shell.
Gas Shell.description: Inflicts Poison on players in an area of effect.

Gastric Bomb.name: Gastric Bomb
Gastric Bomb.description: Lobs a long-range acid bomb at a single player. Damage and Attack Down (-50% attack, 2~3 min).

Gates of Hades.name: Gates of Hades
Gates of Hades.description: Deals fire damage to enemies within an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn and INT Down.

Geirrothr.name: Geirrothr
Geirrothr.description: Area damage scaled by difficulty and divided among the players in range. Additional effect: Bind.

Geirrothr (ability).name: Geirrothr (ability)
Geirrothr (ability).notes: Odin uses this ability every time he loses 25% of health. Equivalent of 10000 Needles. Before using this move, he has a monologue: "The true power of Gungnir cometh not from the blade herself, but from the countless souls it hath sent to the corpse-halls of the Underworld!"
Geirrothr (ability).description: Damages fixed damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind + Stun

Geist Wall.name: Geist Wall
Geist Wall.description: Dispels one positive status effect from targets in an area. Removes all shadows.

Gen'ei Ryodan.name: Gen'ei Ryodan
Gen'ei Ryodan.notes: Used only by notorious monsters. Removes all shadows.
Gen'ei Ryodan.description: Damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Stun and multiple Dispels.

Geocrush.name: Geocrush
Geocrush.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Earth damage that inflicts Stun and ignores shadows.

Geotic Breath.name: Geotic Breath
Geotic Breath.notes: Used only by Earth Wyrms such as Ouryu and Dragua when they are on the ground.
Geotic Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Gerjis' Grip.name: Gerjis' Grip
Gerjis' Grip.description: Stuns a single target with a menacing gaze.

Giga Scream.name: Giga Scream
Giga Scream.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Triple Attack.
Giga Scream.description: Three-hit damage to a single player.

Giga Slash.name: Giga Slash
Giga Slash.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Gigaflare.name: Gigaflare
Gigaflare.notes: Used by Bahamut when down to 10% of health instead of Megaflare during Storms of Fate event. In The Wyrmking Descends, he uses this starting from 60%. Makes a statement before using this move, depending on version:
Gigaflare.description: Deals massive damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Glacial Breath.name: Glacial Breath
Glacial Breath.notes: Used only by Jormungand when he's on the ground.
Glacial Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Glacial Tomb.name: Glacial Tomb
Glacial Tomb.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind and Encumbrance (locks gear swaps rather than stripping equipment).

Glassy Nova.name: Glassy Nova
Glassy Nova.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: full Dispel (removes all buffs, including food) and all stats down (-78).

Gliding Spike.name: Gliding Spike
Gliding Spike.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NMs and Gaganas use Dread Dive instead.

Gloeosuccus.name: Gloeosuccus
Gloeosuccus.description: Cone-shaped earth-based magic. Additional effect: Slow (~35%).

Gloom Phantom Rush.name: Gloom Phantom Rush
Gloom Phantom Rush.notes: Likely very similar to Goblin Rush, just used by and named for a specific type of Goblin.

Gnash.name: Gnash
Gnash.description: Inflicts damage equal to 45%~55% of the target's HP.

Gnash 'n Guttle.name: Gnash 'n Guttle
Gnash 'n Guttle.description: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts Max HP Down (-50%).

Goblin Dice.name: Goblin Dice
Goblin Dice.notes: Causes a completely random effect on players: Sleep, Slow, Dispel, Disease, Stun, Poison, damage, drop TP to 0, Benediction, or recharge abilities. Used only by Vanguard goblins in Dynamis, the Moblin Fantocciniman or the summoned goblin Choplix.
Goblin Dice.description: Deals a random effect based on the roll of the dice.

Goblin Rush.name: Goblin Rush
Goblin Rush.description: Rushes forward with a three-hit melee strike.

Goddess's Shield.name: Goddess's Shield
Goddess's Shield.notes: Used by Campaign physician units under correct conditions; this allows them to cast self-targeting spells like Blink and Phalanx on allied targets.
Goddess's Shield.description: Enables self-target spells to be cast on players and allies.

Gorge.name: Gorge
Gorge.notes: Removes all shadows. Usually followed by Disgorge, which spends the absorbed HP as damage.
Gorge.description: Absorbs HP from targets in range. The absorption is divided among them.

Gorgon Dance.name: Gorgon Dance
Gorgon Dance.description: Petrifies players within a sight-based gaze area (~20 yalms).

Gospel of the Lost.name: Gospel of the Lost
Gospel of the Lost.notes: Used in response to any debuff being applied.
Gospel of the Lost.description: Recovers HP, removes all debuffs, and grants a powerful, unremovable Stoneskin.

Grace of Hera.name: Grace of Hera
Grace of Hera.notes: Used by Auroral Alicorn. The Regen effect is 25 HP/tick.
Grace of Hera.description: Restores ~5% HP, removes its status ailments, and grants itself Regen.

Grand Fall.name: Grand Fall
Grand Fall.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A water-based attack that ignores shadows.

Granite Skin.name: Granite Skin
Granite Skin.description: The user gains an undispellable shield that nullifies frontal physical damage for 60 seconds (no effect on Ranged or Magical attacks).

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: Deals physical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from pet.

Grating Tantara.name: Grating Tantara
Grating Tantara.description: AoE magic damage that also inflicts Amnesia.

Grave Reel.name: Grave Reel
Grave Reel.description: Steals HP from all targets in an area of effect.

Gravitic Horn.name: Gravitic Horn
Gravitic Horn.notes: Used by Antlion NMs; the frontal cone reaches unusually far.
Gravitic Horn.description: Very long frontal AoE dealing percentage-based damage. Not blocked by Fanatic’s Drink.

Graviton Crux.name: Graviton Crux
Graviton Crux.description: AoE HP drain with random attribute absorb and a partial draw-in; the caster gains temporary Damage Spikes.

Gravity Field.name: Gravity Field
Gravity Field.description: Inflicts Slow (-45%) on targets in an area of effect. Does not override Haste.

Gravity Wheel.name: Gravity Wheel
Gravity Wheel.description: Deals high AoE damage. Additional effect: Gravity. Used only in Polearm Form.

Great Bleat.name: Great Bleat
Great Bleat.description: Lowers maximum HP of targets in an area of effect.

Great Sandstorm.name: Great Sandstorm
Great Sandstorm.description: Deals damage to single target. Additional effect: Blind

Great Wheel.name: Great Wheel
Great Wheel.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut and Trust: Mildaurion.
Great Wheel.description: Area attack that resets enmity on those it hits.

Great Whirlwind.name: Great Whirlwind
Great Whirlwind.description: Deals damage to targets in front. Additional effect: Choke

Gregale Wing.name: Gregale Wing
Gregale Wing.notes: Used only by Jormungand in the air and on the ground and by Isgebind.
Gregale Wing.description: An icy wind deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Paralyze

Grim Glower.name: Grim Glower
Grim Glower.dispel: Only with Blind or Blind II.
Grim Glower.notes: The peiste eyes will be brightly glowing while this is in effect. Anyone facing it will be petrified until it ends or it turns away. (Petrify may wear off before the Peiste's eyes stop glowing; you will have a second or so to quickly turn your back.)
Grim Glower.description: While its eyes glow, petrifies any player who faces its gaze. Blind prevents its use.

Grim Halo.name: Grim Halo
Grim Halo.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a two-handed weapon (principally WAR, BLM, DRK, SAM, DRG, and SMN fomors).
Grim Halo.description: Deals heavy damage to all targets with a circular strike. Additional effect: Knockback

Grim Reaper.name: Grim Reaper
Grim Reaper.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Lamia.
Grim Reaper.description: Deals physical damage and inflicts Doom on players in a fan-shaped area.

Groundburst.name: Groundburst
Groundburst.notes: Used by Notorious Monster Mamool Ja only.
Groundburst.description: Deals fire damage to players in an area of effect.

Guided Missile.name: Guided Missile
Guided Missile.description: Targets players within an area of effect with a missile. Additional effect: Bind

Guided Missile II.name: Guided Missile II
Guided Missile II.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form). Ignores shadows.
Guided Missile II.description: Targets players around its current target with a missile. Additional effect: Bind.

Guiding Light.name: Guiding Light
Guiding Light.description: Grants Arciela and Ygnas Magic Defense Boost, Magic Attack Boost, Attack Boost, and Defense Boost.

Guilded Torpor.name: Guilded Torpor
Guilded Torpor.description: Inflicts Sleep on targets in an area of effect.

Gush o' Goo.name: Gush o' Goo
Gush o' Goo.notes: Encumbrance lasts roughly 60 seconds. A Flan-type move; often paired with the Xenoglossia trait, which grants the monster an instant cast on its next spell.
Gush o' Goo.description: Deals magic damage in an area around the monster and inflicts Encumbrance, which unequips all gear and blocks equipment changes.

Gust Breath.name: Gust Breath
Gust Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Gust Breath.description: Deals wind breath damage to players in a cone.

Gusting Gouge.name: Gusting Gouge
Gusting Gouge.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a one-handed weapon. If they lost their weapon, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.
Gusting Gouge.description: Deals damage in a threefold attack to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Gyre Charge.name: Gyre Charge
Gyre Charge.description: AoE physical damage with Paralysis and knockback.

Hadal Summons.name: Hadal Summons
Hadal Summons.notes: Powerful AoE Physical AND Fire damage with a potent Burn; Giltine's calls it large AoE fire damage with a strong DoT Burn.
Hadal Summons.description: Deals heavy fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn.

Hammer Beak.name: Hammer Beak
Hammer Beak.description: Threefold damage to a single player.

Hammer-Go-Round.name: Hammer-Go-Round
Hammer-Go-Round.description: Damages nearby targets with a hammer carousel. Additional effect: Knockback

Hammerblow.name: Hammerblow
Hammerblow.description: Swings the hammer right at a single target.

Hane Fubuki.name: Hane Fubuki
Hane Fubuki.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Feather Storm. Also used by Trust: Gessho. Hane Fubuki is literally translated as "feather blizzard," possibly a pun on hanafubuki.
Hane Fubuki.description: Single-target physical damage with an additional Poison effect.

Happobarai.name: Happobarai
Happobarai.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Sweep. Also used by Trust: Gessho.
Happobarai.description: AoE physical damage with an additional Stun effect.

Havoc Spiral.name: Havoc Spiral
Havoc Spiral.description: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Haymaker.name: Haymaker
Haymaker.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing.
Haymaker.description: Punches the daylights out of all targets in front. Additional effect: Amnesia

Head Butt.name: Head Butt
Head Butt.description: Deals single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Stun and Knockback.

Head Butt (Adamantoise).name: Head Butt (Adamantoise)
Head Butt (Adamantoise).notes: This is not the learnable Blue Mage spell Head Butt. The correct version is used by Quadav enemies.
Head Butt (Adamantoise).description: Deals damage to single target. Additional effects: Accuracy Down and large knockback

Head Snatch.name: Head Snatch
Head Snatch.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing. Reduces HP to 10%.

Healing Breeze.name: Healing Breeze
Healing Breeze.description: Restores the user's HP within an area of effect.

Healing Stomp.name: Healing Stomp
Healing Stomp.description: Stomps the ground to apply regeneration.

Heartfelt Aura.name: Heartfelt Aura
Heartfelt Aura.description: Grants itself undispellable temporary Protect, Shell, Haste, Regen, and Regain.

Heat Barrier.name: Heat Barrier
Heat Barrier.dispel: Can be Dispelled with Geist Wall
Heat Barrier.notes: Blaze Spikes can inflict 50-67 damage from Wamoura Prince. In Bhaflau Remnants Salvage, the Wamouracampas' Blaze Spikes effect is far less powerful.
Heat Barrier.description: Self-buff granting Blaze Spikes and Enfire.

Heat Breath.name: Heat Breath
Heat Breath.notes: HP-dependent damage; follows Riddle. Ignores shadows.
Heat Breath.description: Deals HP-dependent fire damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Heat Wave.name: Heat Wave
Heat Wave.notes: Used only in CoP and ToAU areas. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Heat Wave.description: Inflicts Burn on targets in an area of effect (INT -33, HP -40/tick, 15-60s).

Heaven's Grace.name: Heaven's Grace
Heaven's Grace.description: Restores the caster’s HP and removes multiple debuffs.

Heavenly Strike.name: Heavenly Strike
Heavenly Strike.description: Deals ice damage in an area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Heavy Artillery.name: Heavy Artillery
Heavy Artillery.notes: Fired by an Orcish Turret's central cannon.
Heavy Artillery.description: Fires an explosive artillery shell that blasts targets in an area of effect.

Heavy Bellow.name: Heavy Bellow
Heavy Bellow.description: Inflicts Stun on enemies in a cone-shaped area. Ignores shadows.

Heavy Blow.name: Heavy Blow
Heavy Blow.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Heavy Stomp.name: Heavy Stomp
Heavy Stomp.notes: Paralysis has a very long duration (up to ~16 min).
Heavy Stomp.description: Deals physical damage to enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis. Damage varies with TP.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: Deals physical damage to a single target with knockback; can land a critical hit.

Heavy Whisk.name: Heavy Whisk
Heavy Whisk.description: Deals physical damage in a cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Hecatomb Wave.name: Hecatomb Wave
Hecatomb Wave.notes: Blind lowers accuracy ~30 for 60-120s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).
Hecatomb Wave.description: Conal Wind breath damage (HP x 1/21, max 260) with additional Blind.

Heliovoid.name: Heliovoid
Heliovoid.description: Absorbs one positive status effect from each target in range, including food.

Hell Scissors.name: Hell Scissors
Hell Scissors.notes: TP move similar to Throat Stab. Used only by Khadem Quemquoma, Vaa Oozu's Scolopendrid, Centipedal Centruroides, Hedetet, Hedjedjet and Transcendent Scorpion. Has a longer readying time than Death Scissors, and can be outran.
Hell Scissors.description: Deals extreme damage to a single target. Additional Effect: Hate Reset

Hell Slash.name: Hell Slash
Hell Slash.description: Single target damage. Can critical hit.

Hellborn Yawp.name: Hellborn Yawp
Hellborn Yawp.notes: Restricted move — used by Shadowsoul, Abununnu, and Count Bifrons.
Hellborn Yawp.description: AoE Dark damage with additional Blind and Dispel.

Hellclap.name: Hellclap
Hellclap.description: Conal physical damage with Knockback and Gravity.

Helldive.name: Helldive
Helldive.description: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: Knockback.

Hellfire Arrow.name: Hellfire Arrow
Hellfire Arrow.description: Conal fire attack dealing damage with Burn and knockback. Used only by Red Yztargs.

Hellish Crescendo.name: Hellish Crescendo
Hellish Crescendo.description: Deals magic damage and Paralysis to targets in an area of effect.

Hellstorm.name: Hellstorm
Hellstorm.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP * 1/2, capped at 1,300).

Hemorrhaze.name: Hemorrhaze
Hemorrhaze.notes: Used by Yecuex. Removes all shadows.
Hemorrhaze.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Paralyze and Poison.

Hex Eye.name: Hex Eye
Hex Eye.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Hex Eye.description: Gaze that inflicts Paralysis on players facing the enemy, in a cone.

Hex Palm.name: Hex Palm
Hex Palm.notes: Only used while fighting hand-to-hand. Removes all shadows.
Hex Palm.description: Drains HP from players in a cone. The amount drained is roughly twice the monster's level.

Hexidiscs.name: Hexidiscs
Hexidiscs.description: A sixfold attack damages targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Hi-Freq Field.name: Hi-Freq Field
Hi-Freq Field.description: Lowers the evasion of enemies in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Hiden Sokyaku.name: Hiden Sokyaku
Hiden Sokyaku.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Double Kick.
Hiden Sokyaku.description: Single-target physical damage with an additional Stun effect.

Hiemal Storm.name: Hiemal Storm
Hiemal Storm.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Hiemal Storm.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP * 1/2, capped at 1,300).

High-Tension Discharger.name: High-Tension Discharger
High-Tension Discharger.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
High-Tension Discharger.description: Discharges a powerful current that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Holy Mist.name: Holy Mist
Holy Mist.notes: Carbuncle Prime ★ uses an AoE version.
Holy Mist.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A light-based attack that also lowers the target's Defense.

Homing Missile.name: Homing Missile
Homing Missile.notes: Only used by certain Notorious Monsters. Target must be in front.
Homing Missile.description: Deals damage equal to roughly 90% of the target's current HP and removes enmity.

Hoof Volley.name: Hoof Volley
Hoof Volley.notes: May follow immediately after another TP move.
Hoof Volley.description: Critical damage to a single target. Resets enmity and causes knockback.

Horrible Roar.name: Horrible Roar
Horrible Roar.notes: Used by Bahamut during The Wyrmking Descends BCNM. Dispels up to 4 effects, including food.
Horrible Roar.description: Removes several beneficial effects from players in an area of effect.

Horrid Roar.name: Horrid Roar
Horrid Roar.notes: The effect varies slightly depending on which wyrm uses it.
Horrid Roar.description: Dispels a single target's beneficial effects, removes its enmity and wipes its shadows.

Horror Cloud.name: Horror Cloud
Horror Cloud.notes: Slow is 50%. Blocked by and overwritten by Haste. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Horror Cloud.description: Inflicts Slow on a single target.

Howl.name: Howl
Howl.range: Self and nearby mobs of same family and/or force up to 20'.
Howl.notes: Unlike the Warrior's job ability, this expends the mob's TP as a weapon skill rather than function as a job ability. Much like the job ability, this applies to all nearby members of the same family, and any other mobs linked with it (e.g. warmachines). In Campaign Battles, it applies to all members of the Beastmen Confederate in its range.
Howl.description: Grants the effect of Warcry to user and any linked allies.

Howling.name: Howling
Howling.notes: 30~40% proc rate, 60 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Howling.description: Howls, inflicting Paralysis on players in an area of effect centred on the monster.

Howling Gust.name: Howling Gust
Howling Gust.description: AoE wind damage. Additional effects: Knockback, Silence, and Choke.

Howling Moon.name: Howling Moon
Howling Moon.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit (used by the ★ version).
Howling Moon.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A dark-based area attack.

HP Cloak.name: HP Cloak
HP Cloak.notes: Certain TP moves make the bar briefly visible — that is the only read you get on its HP.
HP Cloak.description: Its health bar stays hidden for the whole fight.

Hungry Crunch.name: Hungry Crunch
Hungry Crunch.description: Drains HP from a single target, removes its food effect, and resets its TP.

Hurricane Breath.name: Hurricane Breath
Hurricane Breath.description: Deals heavy wind breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Knockback and removes one piece of equipment.

Hurricane Wing.name: Hurricane Wing
Hurricane Wing.notes: Used only by Dragua, Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Odzmanouk. The blinding effect does not last long but is very harsh. The attack is wide enough to generally hit an entire alliance.
Hurricane Wing.description: Deals hurricane-force damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Blind

Hydro Ball.name: Hydro Ball
Hydro Ball.description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down

Hydro Blast.name: Hydro Blast
Hydro Blast.description: Fires a blast of , dealing damage in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Magic Shield on self

Hydro Breath.name: Hydro Breath
Hydro Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Hydro Breath.description: Deals water breath damage to players in a cone.

Hydro Cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
Hydro Cannon.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Hydro Cannon.description: Sprays a torrential aqua jet that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Hydro Canon.name: Hydro Canon
Hydro Canon.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Hydro Canon.description: Sprays a torrential aqua jet that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Hydro Shot.name: Hydro Shot
Hydro Shot.description: Deals ranged physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback and Enmity reset.

Hydro Wave.name: Hydro Wave
Hydro Wave.notes: The user also gains a water aura and absorbs Water damage for its duration; the aura remains until enough magic damage is dealt or about 3 minutes pass. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.
Hydro Wave.description: Deals damage, removes one piece of equipment, and grants the user a unique Stoneskin that absorbs only 1,500 magical/breath/non-elemental damage.

Hydroball.name: Hydroball
Hydroball.notes: STR Down potency scales with the target's level.
Hydroball.description: Deals Water damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down.

Hyper Pulse.name: Hyper Pulse
Hyper Pulse.notes: Used by Omega, Proto-Omega and Pantokrator. Bind effect has a very short duration. Proto-Omega and Pantokrator inflict Weight.
Hyper Pulse.description: Deals damage to players within an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind + Weight

Hypnic Lamp.name: Hypnic Lamp
Hypnic Lamp.notes: Condition: lanterns attached to the Orobon. Bypasses shadows without removing them. Destroying the lanterns locks access to it (Nerrivik).
Hypnic Lamp.description: Inflicts Sleep (2~3 min) on targets facing the user. The enhanced version used by NMs inflicts nightmare sleep.

Hypnogenesis.name: Hypnogenesis
Hypnogenesis.description: Deals dark damage (a large single-target hit, or an AoE Throat Stab depending on the caster).

Hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
Hypnosis.notes: Players must be facing the Ahriman to be affected by the gaze attack.

Hypnotic Sway.name: Hypnotic Sway
Hypnotic Sway.notes: Used only by Lamia (not Merrow). A single-target gaze.
Hypnotic Sway.description: Inflicts Amnesia on a single target with a gaze attack.

Hypothermal Combustion.name: Hypothermal Combustion
Hypothermal Combustion.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Hypothermal Combustion.description: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.

Hysteric Assault.name: Hysteric Assault
Hysteric Assault.description: A fivefold physical attack that also drains HP proportional to the damage dealt.

Hysteric Barrage.name: Hysteric Barrage
Hysteric Barrage.notes: Used when the Lamia's main weapon is broken (in place of its weapon TP move). Consumes 5 shadows.
Hysteric Barrage.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Iainuki.name: Iainuki
Iainuki.notes: Used only by Kurt during Campaign & Trust: Gilgamesh. Causes a knockback effect on all enemies hit.
Iainuki.description: Blows enemies away with a powerful blade slash.

Ice Break.name: Ice Break
Ice Break.description: Deals ice damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind (2-3 min).

Ice Guillotine.name: Ice Guillotine
Ice Guillotine.notes: The user gains a 10' Paralysis aura. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows. Scylla spams this move every 3-4 seconds while its Frozen Mist aura is up.
Ice Guillotine.description: Inflicts Max HP Down (-50%, 3 minutes) and Amnesia (45~60s) in a frontal cone.

Ice Roar.name: Ice Roar
Ice Roar.notes: Used only by Gigas in the Northlands, campaign battles, and in Limbus.
Ice Roar.description: Emits a wintry roar, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Ichor Stream.name: Ichor Stream
Ichor Stream.description: Spews venomous ichor at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Icy Grasp.name: Icy Grasp
Icy Grasp.description: Conal damage with Paralysis and Terror.

Ill Wind.name: Ill Wind
Ill Wind.notes: Dispel is darkness-based. Removes all shadows. Used by Mamook Puks and Notorious Monsters only.
Ill Wind.description: Deals wind damage in an area of effect and dispels one beneficial status effect.

Illustrious Aid.name: Illustrious Aid
Illustrious Aid.description: Restores about 1200 HP to Arciela and Ygnas.

Immolating Claw.name: Immolating Claw
Immolating Claw.description: Cone-shaped physical damage with Plague (cannot be removed).

Immortal Anathema.name: Immortal Anathema
Immortal Anathema.description: AoE that inflicts Curse (-20% to -30% HP/MP, ~30s).

Immortal Mind.name: Immortal Mind
Immortal Mind.description: Gains Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.

Immortal Shield.name: Immortal Shield
Immortal Shield.notes: On some NMs the shield reduces melee damage ~90% and nullifies magic until broken (roughly 3,000 non-elemental damage removes it).
Immortal Shield.description: Gains a Rampart-style magic shield (a magic-based Stoneskin) that absorbs magic damage before breaking — about 1,000 on ordinary Soulflayers, far more on NMs.

Impact Roar.name: Impact Roar
Impact Roar.description: Emits the roar of an impact event, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Impairing Glister.name: Impairing Glister
Impairing Glister.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Dia, Flash, and resets the target's TP.

Impale.name: Impale
Impale.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Impalement.name: Impalement
Impalement.notes: Inflicts damage similarly to the Tonberry attack Throat Stab; as such, it will normally never inflict a K.O. on its target, but generally leaves it at approximately 5% remaining HP. Only used by Craver NMs. Similar to Murk, Slow effect has low priority can be overwritten/blocked by Haste.Yearner and Usurper can occasionally score greatly increased damage with this attack, causing an immediate K.O. without adequate physical damage reduction.
Impalement.description: Impales a single target, leaving it near death. Additional effect: Slow + resets enmity

Impenetrable Carapace.name: Impenetrable Carapace
Impenetrable Carapace.notes: On Faded Craklaw it instead provides short-term MAGICAL DAMAGE IMMUNITY and cannot be dispelled.
Impenetrable Carapace.description: Gains a Defense Boost and a Magic Evasion boost.

Implosion.name: Implosion
Implosion.notes: Only uses this ability during his second phase, every 10 seconds. Heralded by a distinct sound & visual effect, it will hit almost everyone in the battlefield due to large range. Removes Utsusemi.
Implosion.description: Channels a wave of negative energy, damaging all targets in very wide area of effect.

Impudence.name: Impudence
Impudence.notes: Used above 90% HP (the boss uses only this until 90%).
Impudence.description: Conal damage, ~5-second Zombie, and an enmity reset.

Impulsion.name: Impulsion
Impulsion.notes: Used by Bahamut during The Wyrmking Descends BCNM.
Impulsion.description: Deals heavy magical damage to enemies within an area of effect. Additional effects: Petrification, Blind, and Knockback

Incensed Pummel.name: Incensed Pummel
Incensed Pummel.description: Single-target physical strike with an additional stat-down effect. Used only by Red Yztargs.

Incessant Fists.name: Incessant Fists
Incessant Fists.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic.
Incessant Fists.description: Delivers a fivefold punching attack to a single target.

Incessant Void.name: Incessant Void
Incessant Void.notes: Used at 50% HP or below. On Hades it grants a Magic Barrier that a stagger removes.

Incinerate.name: Incinerate
Incinerate.notes: Used by Eruca-type crawlers in place of Poison Breath.
Incinerate.description: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone-shaped area (~Current HP x 13.75%, cap 700).

Incinerating Lahar.name: Incinerating Lahar
Incinerating Lahar.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in a ~10' area with Weakness (~20 sec) and knockback; used below 50% HP or with an active aura. Removes all shadows.

Incinerator.name: Incinerator
Incinerator.description: Deals conal fire damage. Additional effect: Burn.

Incisive Apotheosis.name: Incisive Apotheosis
Incisive Apotheosis.description: Severe wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with a brief Weakness and an Enmity reset. Used below 25% HP or while the Blink Whirlwind aura is active.

Incisive Denouement.name: Incisive Denouement
Incisive Denouement.description: Severe wind damage to a single target with an Enmity reset and all stats down. Used below 50% HP.

Inertia Stream.name: Inertia Stream
Inertia Stream.description: Directs an energy force at nearby targets. Additional effect: Bind

Infaunal Flop.name: Infaunal Flop
Infaunal Flop.notes: Raskovniche's version is -50% HP Down / -50% MP Down / -50% Slow. Morseiu's potency is based somewhat on its endrain potency.
Infaunal Flop.description: Conal debuff attack. Inflicts damage plus Slow, Gravity, and HP and MP Down.

Infected Illusion.name: Infected Illusion
Infected Illusion.description: AoE Charm. Only used after Dryad's Kiss.

Infected Leech.name: Infected Leech
Infected Leech.description: Cone-shaped magic damage with Plague (~-50 HP/tick).

Infernal Bulwark.name: Infernal Bulwark
Infernal Bulwark.notes: Dispel it if you can - Gogmagog's page recommends it specifically.
Infernal Bulwark.description: Self-buff. Grants Haste, Stoneskin, Attack Boost, Defense Boost, Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.

Infernal Deliverance.name: Infernal Deliverance
Infernal Deliverance.description: AoE damage plus Stun. Ignores Utsusemi.

Infernal Pestilence.name: Infernal Pestilence
Infernal Pestilence.notes: Used only by certain Notorious Monsters. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Infernal Pestilence.description: Breath damage in a cone (HP x 0.05, capped at 200). Additional effect: Plague (-50 TP and -3 MP per tick, 13 minutes).

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Inferno.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Ifrit's ultimate fire attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Inferno Blast.name: Inferno Blast
Inferno Blast.description: A fire storm deals damage to enemies in a 30’ area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Infinite Terror.notes: * Used by Azdaja in Abyssea - Grauberg. * Seems to last between 10-30 seconds and may possibly break upon taking damage.
Infinite Terror.name: Infinite Terror

Infrasonics.name: Infrasonics
Infrasonics.description: Inflicts Evasion Down on players in a cone-shaped area.

Ink Cloud.name: Ink Cloud
Ink Cloud.description: AoE. Inflicts Blind and grants the user an Evasion Bonus.

Ink Jet.name: Ink Jet
Ink Jet.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Ink Jet.description: Deals dark damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blind (-80 Accuracy, 30~120s).

Insipid Nip.name: Insipid Nip
Insipid Nip.description: Single-target physical damage that absorbs a random attribute from the target.

Interference.name: Interference
Interference.description: Deals magic damage and dispels one beneficial effect from targets in an area of effect.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.notes: Lower priority than Haste. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Intimidate.description: Inflicts Slow (25%, 2~4 min) on targets in a frontal cone.

Intimidate (Pugil).name: Intimidate (Pugil)
Intimidate (Pugil).description: Reduces attack speed in a fan-shaped line of sight.

Invincible.name: Invincible
Invincible.description: Reduces physical damage taken to zero for a short time.

Ion Efflux.name: Ion Efflux
Ion Efflux.description: An ion outflow damages players in front. Additional effects: Paralysis

Ion Shower.name: Ion Shower
Ion Shower.description: Calls forth an ion storm, dealing damage to all nearby targets. Additional effect: Stun

Jamming Wave.name: Jamming Wave
Jamming Wave.notes: Unusually high accuracy. Generally cannot be fully resisted without some form of Resist Silence.
Jamming Wave.description: A jamming signal silences targets in an area of effect.

Jet Stream.name: Jet Stream
Jet Stream.description: Three-hit damage to a single player.

Jettatura.name: Jettatura
Jettatura.notes: Avoidable by facing away. Kotan-kor Kamuy's terror lasts 15 seconds and it always follows this with Hoof Volley.
Jettatura.description: Terrorizes players in a frontal gaze.

Judgment Bolt.name: Judgment Bolt
Judgment Bolt.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Judgment Bolt.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Ramuh's ultimate lightning attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Jumping Thrust.name: Jumping Thrust
Jumping Thrust.notes: Functionally similar to Jump. This is only used by Dragoon sahagins.

Jungle Hoodoo.name: Jungle Hoodoo
Jungle Hoodoo.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Mage-type Velkk.
Jungle Hoodoo.description: AoE magic damage plus Paralyze, Plague, and Curse (-50%).

Jungle Wallop.name: Jungle Wallop
Jungle Wallop.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Warrior-type Velkk.
Jungle Wallop.description: AoE physical damage plus Silence, Bind, and Amnesia.

Just Desserts.name: Just Desserts
Just Desserts.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Stun and Drown (-38 HP/tick).

Ka-thwack.name: Ka-thwack
Ka-thwack.notes: Used at 100%, 69%, 39% and 9% HP. It also grants the user an aura whose debuffs depend on its remaining HP: none above 69%, Avoidance Down and Muddle between 69% and 9%, and potent Plague plus Avoidance Down and Muddle below 9%. Enough damage of the correct element removes the aura.
Ka-thwack.description: Instantly KOs every player and pet in range. A player in range who has Reraise has it dispelled and takes severe dark damage instead.

Kagedourou.name: Kagedourou
Kagedourou.description: Summons multiple clones of the user. The clones depop once enough damage is dealt to the caster and can also be defeated individually. Used above 50% HP.

Kaleidoscopic Fury.name: Kaleidoscopic Fury
Kaleidoscopic Fury.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Resets every job ability timer, and inflicts Dia (20-80 HP per tick) and -60 to all attributes.

Kamaitachi.name: Kamaitachi
Kamaitachi.notes: Used by Tzee Xicu the Manifest (A Malicious Manifest), Soo Luma the Ascended, and Laa Vaqu the Sutler.
Kamaitachi.description: AoE physical damage with major Knockback and a full Dispel. The dispel can be avoided by a shield block or Utsusemi. Used below 50% HP.

Karakuridourou.name: Karakuridourou
Karakuridourou.description: Summons multiple clones below 50% HP. Every clone (and the caster) is masked and invulnerable except one “correct” clone; deal enough damage to the correct clone and the rest depop, resuming the fight.

Kartstrahl.name: Kartstrahl
Kartstrahl.description: Deals ice damage to a single target.

Kibosh.name: Kibosh
Kibosh.description: Inflicts Amnesia on a single target.

Kick Back.name: Kick Back
Kick Back.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Kick Out.name: Kick Out
Kick Out.description: Deals damage to targets in a cone behind the user.

Knife Edge Circle.name: Knife Edge Circle
Knife Edge Circle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. NOT part of the standard family kit. Used by Tres Duendes in its third form.
Knife Edge Circle.description: Conal damage with Poison (-20 HP/tick, 1~2 min) and Stun (5~15s).

Kurnugi Collapse.name: Kurnugi Collapse
Kurnugi Collapse.description: AoE earth damage; inflicts Accuracy Down and Magic Accuracy Down.

Lamb Chop.name: Lamb Chop
Lamb Chop.notes: When performed by a Beastmaster with Ready, it carries skillchain attributes.
Lamb Chop.description: Deals critical damage to a single target.

Lamentation.name: Lamentation
Lamentation.notes: Dia is equivalent to Dia II.
Lamentation.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and inflicts Dia (Defense Down, roughly 8 HP per tick).

Landfall.name: Landfall
Landfall.description: Area-of-effect damage that knocks players back.

Larceny.name: Larceny
Larceny.notes: Steals a beneficial effect from the target; used to counter SP-ability use.

Laser Shower.name: Laser Shower
Laser Shower.description: Rains laser fire on players in a fan-shaped area.

Last Laugh.name: Last Laugh
Last Laugh.notes: Rare on Skomora, but it can be used.
Last Laugh.description: Deals critical damage to a single player and drains the HP dealt. Additional effect: Hate Reset.

Lateral Slash.name: Lateral Slash
Lateral Slash.notes: Reduces defense by 75%. Can be removed with Monk Job Ability Counterstance.
Lateral Slash.description: Laterally slashes a single target. Additional effect: Defense Down

Lava Spit.name: Lava Spit
Lava Spit.description: Deals damage to enemies within an area of effect.

Lead Breath.name: Lead Breath
Lead Breath.description: A heavy breath striking players in a cone. Additional effect: Weight.

Leaf Dagger.name: Leaf Dagger
Leaf Dagger.notes: On higher level Madragoras (Korrigans for example) the poision is 5hp/tick for about 5-6 ticks, damaging a total of 25-30 HP.
Leaf Dagger.description: Single-target piercing damage. Additional effect: Poison (potency scales with level).

Leaping Cleave.name: Leaping Cleave
Leaping Cleave.notes: Only used while wielding a primary or secondary weapon. Consumes 1 shadow.
Leaping Cleave.description: Single-hit damage to one player. Additional effect: Stun for 15 to 30 seconds.

Leeching Current.name: Leeching Current
Leeching Current.description: Deals damage divided by the number of players hit and recovers the user's HP.

Leeching Vines.name: Leeching Vines
Leeching Vines.description: Absorbs adjacent black Rafflesia; triggers a !! proc, after which Vir'ava's magical and physical evasion are significantly lowered.

Leonine Legflail.name: Leonine Legflail
Leonine Legflail.notes: Used only by Mikhe Aryohcha during Campaign.
Leonine Legflail.description: Violently thrashes with roundhouse kicks at opponents in front. Additional effect: Knockback

Lethal Triclip.name: Lethal Triclip
Lethal Triclip.notes: Only used by Megalotaur, Torvotaur, Tikbalang, Shadowclaw and Bukhis.
Lethal Triclip.description: Deals damage in a threefold attack to all players in range. Additional effect: Max HP Down

Lethe Arrows.name: Lethe Arrows
Lethe Arrows.description: Deals physical damage + Knockback + Bind + Amnesia.

Level 3 Petrify.name: Level 3 Petrify
Level 3 Petrify.notes: Only affects targets whose level is a multiple of three; on a valid target it cannot be resisted.
Level 3 Petrify.description: Inflicts Petrifaction on all targets whose level is a multiple of 3 (15~60s); duration scales with TP.

Level 5 Petrify.name: Level 5 Petrify
Level 5 Petrify.notes: This ability will only affect those whose level is a multiple of 5 (e.g. 65, 70, 75). It has no effect on anything else. If a target's level is a multiple of 5, petrification will always occur. It cannot ever be resisted naturally, nor will Resist Petrify be able to occasionally block it.
Level 5 Petrify.description: Inflicts petrification on all targets with a level at a multiple of 5.

Light Blade.name: Light Blade
Light Blade.notes: Damage scales with distance closed; can be mitigated by kiting.
Light Blade.description: Three-hit sword strike dealing severe physical damage to a single target.

Lightning Blade.name: Lightning Blade
Lightning Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enthunder aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Lightning Breath.name: Lightning Breath
Lightning Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Lightning Breath.description: Deals lightning breath damage to players in a cone.

Lightning Roar.name: Lightning Roar
Lightning Roar.notes: Used by the regular Gigas found in Delkfutt's Tower and Tavnazia. Cannot be evaded.
Lightning Roar.description: Emits a roar of thunder, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Lightning Spear.name: Lightning Spear
Lightning Spear.notes: Dark Ixion will charge up his horn prior to using it, giving players time to get out of the way. Amnesia can last up to 2 minutes. Damage reported to range 700-1400. The damage taken can be reduced heavily with Shell and Magic Damage Taken equipment (and by extension, Magic Defense Bonus equipment). Damage can be 2000 without Shell. Karkadann is able to 'charge' multiple times to increase the damage dealt.
Lightning Spear.description: Thunder-based breath damage in a cone. Removes shadows.

Lithic Breath.name: Lithic Breath
Lithic Breath.notes: **Only used by Khrysokhimairas, and only if they are facing their target. Tank from the side to prevent this ability.
Lithic Breath.description: Frontal cone breath inflicting Petrifaction and Weakness. Used by Khrysokhimairas.

Lithic Ray.name: Lithic Ray
Lithic Ray.notes: Only seen used by Shadowclaw, Bukhis and Bata.
Lithic Ray.description: Inflicts Dia and Petrifaction in a conal area gaze attack.

Lodesong.name: Lodesong
Lodesong.notes: Gravity: -75% movement speed, ~30s. A song - not used while silenced. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Lodesong.description: Inflicts Gravity on players in an area of effect.

Louring Skies.name: Louring Skies
Louring Skies.description: Deals damage in a 20' radius. Additional effect: Paralysis and Bind.

Lowing.name: Lowing
Lowing.description: Inflicts Plague on targets in an area of effect.

Luminous Drape.name: Luminous Drape
Luminous Drape.description: A glowing curtain charms all nearby targets.

Luminous Lance.name: Luminous Lance
Luminous Lance.notes: Used by Selh'teus during Dawn battle. Stuns Promathia for a very long time (25 seconds). When using this, Selh'teus will say:
Luminous Lance.description: Throws a luminous spear at Promathia. Additional effect: Stun

Lunar Roar.name: Lunar Roar
Lunar Roar.description: Removes up to ten beneficial effects from targets in a 30' area of effect.

Maat's Bash.name: Maat's Bash
Maat's Bash.notes: Only used by Maat during PLD and DRK Maat fight. It can be used multiple times during the fight, and it can miss.
Maat's Bash.description: '''Deals damage and Stuns target for a short duration.

Macerating Bile.name: Macerating Bile
Macerating Bile.description: AoE that inflicts Bio (~-50 HP/tick) and lowers all attributes (~-22).

Maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
Maelstrom.notes: Removes all shadows. Iku-Turso gains a Silence aura after using it, and Bakunawa uses it the moment it spawns to summon its two Kanavid adds.
Maelstrom.description: Deals water damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down (-10, decays).

Magic Barrier.name: Magic Barrier
Magic Barrier.description: Grants a temporary immunity to magic (60s).

Magic Fruit.name: Magic Fruit
Magic Fruit.description: Restores over 3,000 HP to the user, erases its status ailments, and resets the enmity of the player holding the most hate.

Magic Hammer.name: Magic Hammer
Magic Hammer.description: Deals magic damage to a single target. Additional effect: MP Drain

Magma Fan.name: Magma Fan
Magma Fan.description: Expels a blast of at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Magma Hoplon.name: Magma Hoplon
Magma Hoplon.notes: The Blaze Spikes can be dispelled, the Stoneskin (Status Effect) cannot.
Magma Hoplon.description: Covers the user in and absorbs damage. Enemies that hit it take fire damage.

Magnetite Cloud.name: Magnetite Cloud
Magnetite Cloud.description: Breath damage to targets in a cone. Additional effect: Weight.

Malediction.name: Malediction
Malediction.notes: Used only by Draugar. A stronger form of Blood Saber. Removes all shadows.
Malediction.description: Drains HP from players in range. Damage scales with the monster's level.

Malevolent Blessing.name: Malevolent Blessing
Malevolent Blessing.description: Cone attack (400-500 damage) with an additional Curse effect.

Malign Invocation.name: Malign Invocation
Malign Invocation.description: Deals magic damage and inflicts Amnesia on targets in an area of effect.

Mana Screen.name: Mana Screen
Mana Screen.notes: Cannot be active at the same time as Energy Screen.
Mana Screen.description: Erects a barrier that nullifies magical damage.

Mana Storm.name: Mana Storm
Mana Storm.description: Steals MP from players within range.

Mandible Bite.name: Mandible Bite
Mandible Bite.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Mandible Massacre.name: Mandible Massacre
Mandible Massacre.description: Physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Paralysis and Doom.

Mandibular Bite.name: Mandibular Bite
Mandibular Bite.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Mandibular Lashing.name: Mandibular Lashing
Mandibular Lashing.description: Deals wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Stun.

Mangle.name: Mangle
Mangle.notes: Only used while wielding a primary or secondary weapon. Consumes 3 shadows.
Mangle.description: Three-hit damage to players in a cone.

Mantle Pierce.name: Mantle Pierce
Mantle Pierce.description: Single-target physical damage. Can critically hit.

Marine Mayhem.name: Marine Mayhem
Marine Mayhem.notes: Condition: below 25% HP or during the water aura, and only ever used as the next technique after Carcharian Verve.
Marine Mayhem.description: Instant KO to targets between 5' and 20' away; water damage to targets within 5'.

Marrow Drain.name: Marrow Drain
Marrow Drain.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Marrow Drain.description: Drains MP from a single player.

Matriarchal Fiat.name: Matriarchal Fiat
Matriarchal Fiat.description: High AoE damage. Only used after Dryad's Kiss.

Mayhem Lantern.name: Mayhem Lantern
Mayhem Lantern.notes: Not a gaze attack - it still hits players who have turned around, and the Shock DoT prevents charmed players from being slept (Kamohoalii). Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Mayhem Lantern.description: Deals damage and charms players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Shock and Attack Boost on those charmed.

Medusa Javelin.name: Medusa Javelin
Medusa Javelin.notes: High damage (up to ~2000). Used when wielding a Polearm.

Meeble Warble.name: Meeble Warble
Meeble Warble.notes: Calls nearby awake Meebles to link (see General Notes).
Meeble Warble.description: An area-of-effect call that deals damage and inflicts Silence; any awake Meebles within range are drawn in to link and assist.

Mega Holy.name: Mega Holy
Mega Holy.description: Deals damage to both HP and MP in an area of effect.

Mega Scissors.name: Mega Scissors
Mega Scissors.notes: Removes all shadows. Not a "throat stab" skill — the damage can kill the target. Karkinos (at low HP), Krabimanjaro, Krabkatoa. A frontal cone with high damage and a hate reset.
Mega Scissors.description: Conal physical damage dealing 50% of the target's maximum HP, and resets enmity.

Megaflare.name: Megaflare
Megaflare.notes: Used every time he loses 10% of his health, and will attempt to use it again if he is stunned. When he uses this move, he taunts players: "Children of Vana'diel, what do you think to accomplish by fighting for your lives?"
Megaflare.description: Deals heavy damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Megalith Throw.name: Megalith Throw
Megalith Throw.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A stronger ranged attack with an additional Slow effect.

Meltdown.name: Meltdown
Meltdown.notes: When it is about to use this move it curls up and levitates; it can be stunned.
Meltdown.description: Reactor failure triggers a self-destruct, dealing magic damage based on the doll's remaining HP (HP x 1/2) to targets in an area of effect; the doll then falls to the ground.

Memento Mori.name: Memento Mori
Memento Mori.notes: Giltine follows Memento Mori with Gala Macabre; stunning Memento Mori prevents it.
Memento Mori.description: Self-buff. Gains Magic Attack Bonus (+25 Magic Attack Bonus, 30 seconds).

Memory of Element.name: Memory of Element
Memory of Element.notes: The ability lists the associated element as it is used (e.g. Memory of Fire). The mob will then absorb (be healed by) elemental damage of that type.
Memory of Element.description: Invokes a memory of an element, inflicting magical damage on nearby targets.

Merciless Mauling.name: Merciless Mauling
Merciless Mauling.notes: The weapon-removal effect does not occur when used by the Bozzetto Regent.
Merciless Mauling.description: Conal damage that removes the target's weapon. Absorbed by 2 shadows.

Mercurial Strike.name: Mercurial Strike
Mercurial Strike.notes: Used by Briareus and Cottus. Damage is fixed by a repeating pattern (e.g. 111), and determines which ability Briareus uses next.
Mercurial Strike.description: Swings at an enemy dealing fixed damage in an area attack.

Metallic Body.name: Metallic Body
Metallic Body.notes: NMs using it have a greatly enhanced potency.
Metallic Body.description: Grants the crab a weak Stoneskin effect (about 25 HP).

Metamorphic Blast.name: Metamorphic Blast
Metamorphic Blast.description: Delivers a frontal (conal) area attack with knockback. Additional effect: Rasp.

Meteor Strike.name: Meteor Strike
Meteor Strike.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A fire-based attack that ignores shadows.

Meteorite.name: Meteorite
Meteorite.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Deals area damage.

Methane Breath.name: Methane Breath
Methane Breath.notes: Damage is current HP x 1/16, capped at 400. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Miasma.name: Miasma
Miasma.notes: Only used by Gulool Ja Ja.
Miasma.description: Releases a toxic cloud on nearby targets. Additional effects: Slow + Poison + Plague

Microquake.name: Microquake
Microquake.description: Deals high single-target damage. Used only in Polearm Form.

Microspores.name: Microspores
Microspores.notes: Only used by Goldcap and Morille Mortelle.
Microspores.description: Transfers all ailments to every player in range.

Mighty Guard.name: Mighty Guard
Mighty Guard.notes: The shield completely nullifies spell damage and standard melee hits; weapon skills and the occasional critical hit punch through it. The Regain can be dispelled, the shield cannot. With its wings spread it will still absorb damage from attacks landed while it is casting or using TP, shield or no shield.
Mighty Guard.description: Restores roughly 15% of its own HP and raises two separate buffs: a one-minute damage shield and a dispellable 10 TP/tick Regain.

Mighty Snort.name: Mighty Snort
Mighty Snort.notes: Only used by Apis, Chichevache and Audumbla, Audumbla's version increases in damage as it's HP decreases.
Mighty Snort.description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Hate reset

Mijin Gakure.name: Mijin Gakure
Mijin Gakure.description: Ninja SP ability: the user self-destructs, dealing damage based on remaining HP. The user is KO’d.

Minax Glare.name: Minax Glare
Minax Glare.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Minax Glare.description: A gaze that inflicts Terror and Defense Down.

Mind Blast.name: Mind Blast
Mind Blast.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Mind Blast.description: Conal magic damage with a potent Paralysis (15-45s); duration scales with TP.

Mind Break.name: Mind Break
Mind Break.notes: Players must be facing the Ahriman to be affected by the gaze attack.
Mind Break.description: Gaze attack that lowers maximum MP (Max MP x 128/256, 10s).

Mind Drain.name: Mind Drain
Mind Drain.description: Absorbs the target's MND (-14, decaying over time).

Mind Purge.name: Mind Purge
Mind Purge.notes: Takes food as well. There is a chance that not ALL buffs will be wiped.
Mind Purge.description: Single-target Dispel that removes all beneficial status effects, including food.

Mind Wall.name: Mind Wall
Mind Wall.notes: All magical damage will heal the Mammet while this is in effect. Only used in "staff" form. Lasts around 30 seconds. Does not protect against Astral Flow or elemental weaponskills.
Mind Wall.description: Special magic-shield effect: for ~30 seconds it absorbs and regains HP from all offensive magic used against it (does not protect against Astral Flow or elemental weapon skills). Used only in Staff Form.

Mine Blast.name: Mine Blast
Mine Blast.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows
Mine Blast.notes: Mines will despawn upon using this ability.
Mine Blast.description: Deals fire damage to targets within Area of Effect

Mog Bomb.name: Mog Bomb
Mog Bomb.notes: Only used by the Henchman Moogles.
Mog Bomb.description: Throws a concussive grenade at foes, dealing damage. Additional Effect: Knockback

Mog Shrapnel.name: Mog Shrapnel
