Mog Shrapnel.notes: Only used by the Henchman Moogles.
Mog Shrapnel.description: Tosses gil at foes within a fan-shaped area.

Molluscous Mutation.name: Molluscous Mutation
Molluscous Mutation.description: Self-buff. Gains a large Defense Bonus (+75%).

Molting Burst.name: Molting Burst
Molting Burst.notes: Used by Limules affiliated with light element.
Molting Burst.description: Deals damage and drains HP. Transfers any negative status effects to the target.

Molting Plumage.name: Molting Plumage
Molting Plumage.description: Wind-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Dispel and Knockback.

Monocular Scowl.name: Monocular Scowl
Monocular Scowl.notes: Used only by Pyracmon in the Harvest Festival 2008 and Harvest Festival 2009 events; removes the Enlight effect bestowed by the moogle needed to harm him.
Monocular Scowl.description: Stares at a player with a vicious scowl.

Moonlight Veil.name: Moonlight Veil
Moonlight Veil.description: AoE dark magic damage with Terror. Spawns a Dark Gyve. On the ★ battlefield it also inflicts Magic Defense Down.

Moribound Hack.name: Moribound Hack
Moribound Hack.range: 10' Radial (unknown if centered around target or itself)
Moribound Hack.description: Deals critical damage within area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Moribund Hack.name: Moribund Hack
Moribund Hack.range: Small radius (10 yalms max) originating from the target. Damage seems to decrease the farther you are from the main target.
Moribund Hack.description: Slams a massive ice boulder onto players. Additional effect: Paralyze and Enmity Reset

Morning Glory.name: Morning Glory
Morning Glory.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.
Morning Glory.description: AoE physical damage. Can critical strike.

Mortal Blast.name: Mortal Blast
Mortal Blast.notes: Gaze/conal instant KO — avoid by turning.
Mortal Blast.description: Inflicts instant Death on a single target.

Mortal Ray.name: Mortal Ray
Mortal Ray.notes: Ordinary Taurus use it only once per fight. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Mortal Revolution.name: Mortal Revolution
Mortal Revolution.notes: Only used by Armored Chariot, Shielded Chariot, and Impervious Chariot. Stun can last 3-5 seconds.
Mortal Revolution.description: Performs a spinning attack on all nearby targets. Additional effect: Knockback + Stun

Mountain Buster.name: Mountain Buster
Mountain Buster.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Stronger blunt damage that inflicts Bind.

Mow.name: Mow
Mow.notes: Poison (~10-25 HP/tick, 30s). Can critical hit. Consumes 2-3 shadows.
Mow.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

MP Absorption.name: MP Absorption
MP Absorption.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
MP Absorption.description: Drains MP from a single player.

MP Drainkiss.name: MP Drainkiss
MP Drainkiss.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
MP Drainkiss.description: Drains MP from a single target.

Mucilaginous Ooze.name: Mucilaginous Ooze
Mucilaginous Ooze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The Encumbrance used to also strip equipment from the target, which was removed in the October 7th 2014 update because losing iLvl gear was too powerful.
Mucilaginous Ooze.description: Inflicts Slow and a long Encumbrance (60~90s) in an area of effect.

Mucus Spread.name: Mucus Spread
Mucus Spread.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Mucus Spread.description: Splashes a slowing mucus around in a 10' area of effect.

Mud Stream.name: Mud Stream
Mud Stream.description: High area-of-effect damage with Magic Defense Down, Slow, Bind, Rasp and a draw-in.

Murk.name: Murk
Murk.description: Weighs down nearby targets with an oppressive gloom. Additional effect: Weight + Slow.

Mysterious Light.name: Mysterious Light
Mysterious Light.description: AoE magic damage with Weight (-75% movement speed, ~2 min); damage varies with TP.

Naakual's Vengeance.name: Naakual's Vengeance
Naakual's Vengeance.notes: Achuka → Incinerating Lahar; Colkhab → Incisive Apotheosis; Tchakka → Marine Mayhem; Yumcax → Tiiimbeeer; Hurkan → Static Prison; Kumhau → Glassy Nova.
Naakual's Vengeance.description: Summons one of the six Naakuals to use a single ability.

Napalm Tomahawk.name: Napalm Tomahawk
Napalm Tomahawk.range: Ranged AoE centered around the target
Napalm Tomahawk.notes: Used only by Invincible Shield (S) during Campaign.
Napalm Tomahawk.description: Throws an axe infused with explosive napalm.

Nature's Meditation.name: Nature's Meditation
Nature's Meditation.notes: Separates the Chapuli's two TP-move modes.
Nature's Meditation.description: Grants an undispellable attack bonus that decays over time, plus a brief window of damage immunity.

Necrobane.name: Necrobane
Necrobane.description: AoE that inflicts Paralysis and Curse.

Necropurge.name: Necropurge
Necropurge.notes: Knockback. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).
Necropurge.description: AoE physical damage with Curse and Knockback.

Necrotic Brume.name: Necrotic Brume
Necrotic Brume.description: AoE dark damage with Blind, Curse, and Paralyze.

Negative Whirl.name: Negative Whirl
Negative Whirl.description: Dark winds damages targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Slow

Nepentheam Hum.name: Nepentheam Hum
Nepentheam Hum.notes: Costs 200% TP to use. Used by Ladybug (MON).
Nepentheam Hum.description: A noxious powder makes enemies amnesic in an area of effect.

Nepenthean Hum.name: Nepenthean Hum
Nepenthean Hum.description: AoE that inflicts Amnesia. Used only during daytime.

Nerve Gas.name: Nerve Gas
Nerve Gas.notes: Used only while all three heads are alive. Removes all shadows.
Nerve Gas.description: Deals damage in an area of effect with an additional Curse (HP/MP -50%) and Poison (~20 HP/tick).

Nether Tempest.name: Nether Tempest
Nether Tempest.notes: Used only by Diabolos Spade in Dynamis - Tavnazia instead of Nether Blast.

Netherspikes.name: Netherspikes
Netherspikes.description: Projects shadow spikes towards the front at a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Night Stalker.name: Night Stalker
Night Stalker.description: Cone-shaped damage that resets the target's TP to 0.

Nightmare.name: Nightmare
Nightmare.description: Puts targets in an area into a deep (hyper) sleep.

Nihility Song.name: Nihility Song
Nihility Song.description: A song that dispels ONE positive effect from players in an area of effect.

Nimble Snap.name: Nimble Snap
Nimble Snap.notes: Nightmare Efts and Splacknuck use an enhanced version that hits three times.

No Quarter.name: No Quarter
No Quarter.notes: Avoid by standing far from August, or by stunning No Quarter. If he is stunned at the 60-second mark he must recast Daybreak to reset the timer.
No Quarter.description: Frontal line dealing up to 9999 damage, distributed among those hit. Used 60 seconds after Daybreak.

Noahionto.name: Noahionto
Noahionto.notes: Removes all shadows. Capable of one-shotting a party. Lux Valiance and Holy Circle reduce its damage; Migawari: Ichi negates it entirely.
Noahionto.description: Deals significant dark-elemental damage to players in an area of effect, scaled to the damage the monster has already taken.

Nobless Oblige.name: Nobless Oblige
Nobless Oblige.notes: Bozzetto Regent only. Triggered by defeating a Bozzetto Servitor, or by dealing 25,000+ damage including skillchains — 40,000+ once a Servitor has been defeated.
Nobless Oblige.description: Levels up, restores 15% HP and resets enmity; every other Velkk levels up and uses its one-hour ability.

Nocturnal Combustion.name: Nocturnal Combustion
Nocturnal Combustion.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Nocturnal Combustion.description: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.

Nocturnal Servitude.name: Nocturnal Servitude
Nocturnal Servitude.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Nocturnal Servitude.description: A conal Charm that dresses the target in a bat costume.

Noisome Powder.name: Noisome Powder
Noisome Powder.notes: Only used during the daytime. Attack is reduced by 40%.
Noisome Powder.description: AoE that inflicts Attack Down (~-40%). Used only during daytime.

Norn Arrow.name: Norn Arrow
Norn Arrow.notes: NM-only Pixie TP move (Belphoebe, Bhishani). Fanatic's Drink blocks the damage but not the Encumbrance.
Norn Arrow.description: Heavy AoE damage (~1000, 20' radius) + Encumbrance (~1 min).

Norn Arrows.name: Norn Arrows
Norn Arrows.notes: **The range of this spell seems to be greater then 20.0.
Norn Arrows.description: Delivers a ranged attack to target.

Nosferatu's Kiss.name: Nosferatu's Kiss
Nosferatu's Kiss.description: Drains HP, MP and TP from players in range. HP drained scales with the monster's level.

Nox Blast.name: Nox Blast
Nox Blast.description: A dark blast hits targets in front. Additional effect: Knockback and resets TP

Noxious Spray.name: Noxious Spray
Noxious Spray.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows
Noxious Spray.notes: Only Used by Effluvial Grenade, Virulent Flask, and Bhogbigg's Vial which despawn after using this ability.

Noyade.name: Noyade
Noyade.description: Damage plus Silence. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Nuclear Waste.name: Nuclear Waste
Nuclear Waste.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima. Follows this ability with one of the following moves: Flame Thrower, Cryojet, High-Tension Discharger, Smoke Discharger, Hydro Cannon, or Turbofan.
Nuclear Waste.description: Reduces elemental resistances by 50 to players in range.

Nucleic Implosion.name: Nucleic Implosion
Nucleic Implosion.description: Absorbs HP, fully dispels the target, and resets its job ability recast timers.

Nullifying Rain.name: Nullifying Rain
Nullifying Rain.description: Area-of-effect damage plus multiple Dispel and Max HP Down (-25%).

Nullsong.name: Nullsong
Nullsong.notes: Used by the Dahak (red) variant. A song - not used while silenced. Removes all shadows.
Nullsong.description: Dispels all status effects and deals 117 damage per status enhancement removed.

Numbing Breath.name: Numbing Breath
Numbing Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis

Numbing Glare.name: Numbing Glare
Numbing Glare.notes: Used by Orc-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away.
Numbing Glare.description: A paralyzing gaze at a player in front.

Numbing Noise.name: Numbing Noise
Numbing Noise.notes: Nightmare Efts use an enhanced version that works in an AoE radial.
Numbing Noise.description: Creates an unsettling sound. Additional effect: Stun

Numbshroom.name: Numbshroom
Numbshroom.notes: Not used until after the Queasyshroom has been fired.
Numbshroom.description: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Paralysis and Stun. Used after Queasyshroom.

Nutrient Absorption.name: Nutrient Absorption
Nutrient Absorption.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Obfuscate.name: Obfuscate
Obfuscate.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Obfuscate.description: Inflicts Flash on players in an area of effect.

Oblivion's Mantle.name: Oblivion's Mantle
Oblivion's Mantle.description: 20’ AoE dark damage that inflicts Weakness (60s) and a 10-count Doom; players killed by the Doom return with double weakness. During some NMs’ Chainspell it inflicts Zombie instead of Doom.

Occultation.name: Occultation
Occultation.description: The user gains the Blink status.

Ocher Blast.name: Ocher Blast
Ocher Blast.notes: Used by earth wyrms while airborne.
Ocher Blast.description: An earth storm deals damage to enemies in a 30' area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Ochre Blast.name: Ochre Blast
Ochre Blast.notes: Used only by Ouryu and Cuelebre when in the sky.
Ochre Blast.description: A dust storm deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Ofnir.name: Ofnir
Ofnir.notes: Odin will say a random speech before using this move.
Ofnir.description: Deals damage with Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Oisoya.name: Oisoya
Oisoya.description: Namas Arrow variant. A ranged attack that inflicts high damage to a single target.

Omega Javelin.name: Omega Javelin
Omega Javelin.description: Inflicts damage and petrification to a single target.

Onrush.name: Onrush
Onrush.description: Single-target damage that can critical strike.

Oppressive Gaze.name: Oppressive Gaze
Oppressive Gaze.description: Stares with blue glowing eyes that inflicts Terror and Zombie on any target that makes eye contact.

Oppressive Glare.name: Oppressive Glare
Oppressive Glare.description: While its eyes glow, inflicts Terror and Zombie on any player who faces its gaze. Blind prevents its use.

Oppressive Yawp.name: Oppressive Yawp
Oppressive Yawp.notes: Some listings give this move as inflicting Terror instead.
Oppressive Yawp.description: Very wide area-of-effect dispel. Removes everything except Reraise, Afterglow and signet-like effects.

Optic Induration.name: Optic Induration
Optic Induration.description: Conal physical attack that Petrifies targets. ~15 yalm range.

Orbital Earthrend.name: Orbital Earthrend
Orbital Earthrend.notes: Used only by Zazarg during A Nation on the Brink.
Orbital Earthrend.description: Unleashes a spinning barrage with fists.

Orcish Counterstance.name: Orcish Counterstance
Orcish Counterstance.notes: Only used in Wings of the Goddess (Shadowreign) areas.
Orcish Counterstance.description: Grants the user the effect of Counterstance.

Ore Lob.name: Ore Lob
Ore Lob.notes: Used by Stronghold Notorious Monsters and Campaign leaders Di'Dha Adamantfist and Ga'Dho Softstep (the latter summons Gu'Dho Staggershell to use the ability simultaneously). Also used by Mu'Nhi Thimbletail, Va'Gho Bloodbasked and by most NM Quadavs in Beadeaux (S)
Ore Lob.description: Deals very high damage with a ranged attack to enemies in an area of effect.

Ore Toss.name: Ore Toss
Ore Toss.notes: This ability has somewhat low accuracy. Deals increased damage the further away the target is.
Ore Toss.description: Deals high damage in a ranged attack.

Orogenesis.name: Orogenesis
Orogenesis.description: AoE damage with Weight, Choke, and Evasion Down.

Orogenic Storm.name: Orogenic Storm
Orogenic Storm.description: Deals earth damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence, Slow, Blindness, and Evasion Down.

Orthopterror.name: Orthopterror
Orthopterror.notes: Supernal Chapuli 'Mode 2' unique move; also used by Aristaeus.
Orthopterror.description: High physical damage in a cone-shaped area with Knockback and Terror.

Osmosis.name: Osmosis
Osmosis.description: Absorbs the target's HP and one beneficial effect.

Overthrow.name: Overthrow
Overthrow.notes: Moving to the side will avoid attack.

Pain Sync.name: Pain Sync
Pain Sync.description: Deals breath damage equal to 40% of the damage inflicted to the user while it readies this move, in a 20' area of effect.

Painful Whip.name: Painful Whip
Painful Whip.notes: Consumes one shadow. On Amphitrite it triggers the switch to absorbing magical damage, after a delay.
Painful Whip.description: Deals threefold damage to a single target. Can critical hit.

Palsinixis.notes: * Used exclusively by Amphitrite. * Use of the ability indicates Amphitrite's switch to magic casting mode.Physical damage during this time will cure it.
Palsinixis.name: Palsinixis

Palsy Pollen.name: Palsy Pollen
Palsy Pollen.description: Single-target ice-based magic. Additional effect: Paralysis. Bypasses Utsusemi.

Palsynyxis.name: Palsynyxis
Palsynyxis.notes: Paralysis lasts 30~60 seconds. Consumes one shadow. On Amphitrite it triggers the switch to absorbing physical damage, after a delay.
Palsynyxis.description: Deals one-and-a-half-fold damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Pandemic Nip.name: Pandemic Nip
Pandemic Nip.notes: Transfers debuffs to the target player (maximum 5). Includes Dancer's Quickstep's Evasion Down and Box Step's Defense Down.
Pandemic Nip.description: Single-target physical damage; transfers up to five of the gnat's negative status effects onto the target player.

Pandora's Curse.name: Pandora's Curse
Pandora's Curse.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Drains roughly 700 HP per tick and lasts about 45 seconds; healers can remove the Bio component but not the attribute reduction.
Pandora's Curse.description: Inflicts Bio II and sets all of the target's attributes to 1 on targets in an area of effect.

Pandora's Gift.name: Pandora's Gift
Pandora's Gift.description: Restores a moderate amount of HP to all players in range.

Panzerfaust.name: Panzerfaust
Panzerfaust.notes: Some Notorious Monsters add a Knockback effect.
Panzerfaust.description: Strikes a target twice with an armored fist.

Panzerschreck.name: Panzerschreck
Panzerschreck.description: Strikes a single target with a ranged attack; can critical hit.

Paralysis Shower.name: Paralysis Shower
Paralysis Shower.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).
Paralysis Shower.description: Releases paralyzing confetti in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Paralyzing Blast.name: Paralyzing Blast
Paralyzing Blast.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows.

Paralyzing Triad.name: Paralyzing Triad
Paralyzing Triad.description: Conal physical damage with a potent Paralyze.

Parry (Yagudo).name: Parry (Yagudo)
Parry (Yagudo).notes: Increases defense by 15% for 900 seconds. In Dynamis, this ability is enhanced to grant Evasion Boost instead.

Pawn's Penumbra.name: Pawn's Penumbra
Pawn's Penumbra.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and resets all of their job abilities.

Pecking Flurry.name: Pecking Flurry
Pecking Flurry.notes: Consumes 4 shadows. Can deal high damage.
Pecking Flurry.description: Four-hit damage to a single player.

Pelagic Cleaver.name: Pelagic Cleaver
Pelagic Cleaver.description: Deals damage in a 10' area of effect. Additional effect: Max HP Down.

Pelagic Tempest.name: Pelagic Tempest
Pelagic Tempest.notes: Used by Murex affiliated with lightning element. Shock effect is fairly strong (28/tick).
Pelagic Tempest.description: Deals damage with an additional Terror effect.

Pentapeck.name: Pentapeck
Pentapeck.description: Five-hit physical damage to a single player. Additional effect: Amnesia (~5 seconds).

Penumbral Impact.name: Penumbral Impact
Penumbral Impact.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Penumbral Impact.description: Deals damage to a single target. Potency increases by 50% at night.

Percussive Foin.name: Percussive Foin
Percussive Foin.description: Deals directional (conal) area damage. Used only in Polearm Form.

Perdition.name: Perdition
Perdition.notes: Used only by bhoots. Has a five second readying time. Requires equipment or a status boost to block. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Perfect Defense.name: Perfect Defense
Perfect Defense.notes: Triggered by receiving five skillchains; may also follow every third Gospel of the Lost.
Perfect Defense.description: Grants complete damage immunity for 30 seconds.

Permafrost Requiem.name: Permafrost Requiem
Permafrost Requiem.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror.

Pestilent Penance.name: Pestilent Penance
Pestilent Penance.description: Cone attack (~400 damage) with an additional Plague effect.

Pestilent Plume.name: Pestilent Plume
Pestilent Plume.description: Cone-shaped damage plus Plague (-50 TP/tick, -8 MP/tick), Blind (-50), and Magic Defense Down (-25).

Petalback Spin.name: Petalback Spin
Petalback Spin.notes: Only used by Gancanagh, Nightshade and Bugul Noz.
Petalback Spin.description: Area-of-effect attack that inflicts Poison, Paralyze, Blind, Silence, Plague and Amnesia, and resets the target's hate.

Petaline Tempest.name: Petaline Tempest
Petaline Tempest.description: AoE magic damage that lowers Max HP, MP, and TP (up to 1,000).

Petribreath.name: Petribreath
Petribreath.range: Unknown cone, Seen up to 15' distance.
Petribreath.description: Petrifies targets within a fan-shaped area.

Petrifactive Breath.name: Petrifactive Breath
Petrifactive Breath.notes: Used in CoP areas or by NMs.
Petrifactive Breath.description: Inflicts Petrifaction on enemies within a fan-shaped area. Ignores shadows.

Petro Eyes.name: Petro Eyes
Petro Eyes.notes: Inflicts Petrifaction (4-7 min). Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Petro Eyes.description: Petrifies players with a gaze in a cone-shaped area.

Petro Gaze.name: Petro Gaze
Petro Gaze.notes: CoP areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Petro Gaze.description: Gaze that inflicts Petrifaction on players facing the enemy, in a cone.

Phaeosynthesis.name: Phaeosynthesis
Phaeosynthesis.description: Self-buff: gains Regen, Regain, Multistrikes and Evasion Boost. Night only.

Phantasmal Dance.name: Phantasmal Dance
Phantasmal Dance.notes: Used only by the Seed Orc. Knockback can push players to the walls.
Phantasmal Dance.description: Deals damage to nearby players with a surreal dance. Additional effect: Knockback & Bind

Phantom Whorl.name: Phantom Whorl
Phantom Whorl.description: Very high single-hit damage to one player.

Phase Shift.name: Phase Shift
Phase Shift.notes: Used by Eald'narche in his first form at 66%, 33%, and 1% HP, and by his Exoplates as a 33%-HP reaction; damage escalates each use (~600-1300).
Phase Shift.description: A shockwave deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun + Bind

Phason Beam.name: Phason Beam
Phason Beam.description: AoE damage and Magic Defense Down.

Phlegm Expulsion.name: Phlegm Expulsion
Phlegm Expulsion.description: AoE that inflicts Slow, Silence and Amnesia for ~2 minutes.

Photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
Photosynthesis.description: Self-buff: gains Regen (potency scales with level). Daytime only.

Phototrophic Blessing.name: Phototrophic Blessing
Phototrophic Blessing.description: Self-buff: recovers HP and grants Regen, Defense Boost, and Magic Defense Boost.

Phototrophic Wrath.name: Phototrophic Wrath
Phototrophic Wrath.description: Self-buff: grants Attack Boost, Magic Attack Boost, Haste, and Enlight.

Pile Pitch.name: Pile Pitch
Pile Pitch.notes: Used by Omega, Proto-Omega and Pantokrator. Reduces target's HP to 5% of its maximum value. Cannot K.O. target.
Pile Pitch.description: Stabs a player for massive damage. Additional effect: Enmity reset + Bind

Pinecone Bomb.name: Pinecone Bomb
Pinecone Bomb.description: Lobs a pinecone at a single target.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: Deals moderate ranged damage to targets in an area of effect.

Pit Ambush.name: Pit Ambush
Pit Ambush.notes: Triggered when a player steps over a burrowed Pit-type Antlion without Sneak.
Pit Ambush.description: A surprise physical attack from underground, used only from a burrowed/hidden state. Removes all shadows.

Plague Breath.name: Plague Breath
Plague Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Plague Swipe.name: Plague Swipe
Plague Swipe.notes: Used only when a target with hate is behind them.
Plague Swipe.description: Frontal cone dealing damage with Plague and Bio; enmity is drawn from the rear.

Plaguebreath.name: Plaguebreath
Plaguebreath.description: Deals damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Poison.

Pleiades Ray.name: Pleiades Ray
Pleiades Ray.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing with health below 20%.
Pleiades Ray.description: Fires a magical ray at nearby targets. Additional effects: Paralysis + Blind + Poison + Plague + Bind + Silence + Slow

Plenilune Embrace.name: Plenilune Embrace
Plenilune Embrace.notes: Recovers significant HP; prevent with Silence.
Plenilune Embrace.description: Recovers HP and removes 0-3 status ailments, then grants Attack Bonus and Magic Attack Bonus. Potency varies with the moon phase.

Pod Ejection.name: Pod Ejection
Pod Ejection.notes: Used periodically by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega. Gunpods self-destruct with Electrocharge for severe AoE damage if not defeated quickly.
Pod Ejection.description: Ejects and deploys a Gunpod to assist it.

Poison Breath.name: Poison Breath
Poison Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Poison Breath.description: Deals water breath damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Poison (~1 HP/tick). Damage ~Current HP x 10.3% (cap 405).

Poison Breath (Crawler).name: Poison Breath (Crawler)
Poison Breath (Crawler).notes: *: Seems to deal more damage at higher HP
Poison Breath (Crawler).description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional Effect: Poison

Poison Breath (Dragon).name: Poison Breath (Dragon)
Poison Breath (Dragon).notes: *: Seems to deal more damage at higher HP
Poison Breath (Dragon).description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional Effect: Poison

Poison Pick.name: Poison Pick
Poison Pick.description: Damage and Poison (-5 HP/tick, 3 min) to a single player. The poison ticks 1 HP harder for every foe level past 56 (e.g. -6/tick at 57, -24/tick at 75).

Poison Sting.name: Poison Sting
Poison Sting.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Polar Blast.name: Polar Blast
Polar Blast.notes: Used while the left head is alive. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Polar Blast.description: Deals ice breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Polar Bulwark.name: Polar Bulwark
Polar Bulwark.notes: Used while the left head is alive (right head in Nyzul, where the bulwarks are reversed).
Polar Bulwark.description: Grants the monster an undispelable Physical Shield (~60s).

Polar Roar.name: Polar Roar
Polar Roar.description: Deals ice damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind and Knockback; the user gains an aura.

Pole Swing.name: Pole Swing
Pole Swing.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a staff. If they lost their staff, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.
Pole Swing.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Pollen.name: Pollen
Pollen.description: Restores the bee's own HP (~Max HP x 147/1024, about 14%).

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Power Attack.name: Power Attack
Power Attack.description: Deals physical damage to a single target with a 100% Attack bonus.

Power Attack (Gigas).name: Power Attack (Gigas)
Power Attack (Gigas).description: Executes a hammerblow on a single target.

Predatory Glare.name: Predatory Glare
Predatory Glare.notes: Only used by Nightmare Tigers in Dynamis - Qufim and Saehrimnir in Einherjar.
Predatory Glare.description: Glares at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect, leaving them stunned.

Preternatural Gleam.name: Preternatural Gleam
Preternatural Gleam.description: Deals light damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis, Mute, and enmity reset.

Preying Posture.name: Preying Posture
Preying Posture.description: Self-buff granting Attack Boost, Accuracy Boost, Magic Attack Boost and Intension. Takes four dispels to fully remove.

Primal Drill.name: Primal Drill
Primal Drill.description: Drills into nearby targets with appendages. Additional effect: Bind

Primordial Surge.name: Primordial Surge
Primordial Surge.notes: Head gem glows red while absorbing; deal no damage. Ends with Waning Vigor or Expunge.
Primordial Surge.description: AoE that drains HP from all players, then absorbs incoming damage until its next TP move.

Prismatic Breath.name: Prismatic Breath
Prismatic Breath.description: AoE conal damage plus Inhibit TP (Store TP reduction).

Proboscis.name: Proboscis
Proboscis.notes: Damage shown in chat log is done to MP instead of HP.
Proboscis.description: Steals MP and dispels one beneficial status effect from targets in front.

Proboscis Shower.name: Proboscis Shower
Proboscis Shower.notes: Used by Hildesvini. Restores a large amount of HP; can be stunned. Also used by Iriz Ima, healed about 200-300 HP.

Prominence.name: Prominence
Prominence.notes: Used only by Ashmea B Greinner during Campaign.
Prominence.description: Deals elemental damage to opponents in a sweeping arc.

Promyvion Brume.name: Promyvion Brume
Promyvion Brume.notes: Damage element is based on the mob's Core. Enmity is reset on certain Cravers.
Promyvion Brume.description: A fog deals area damage. Additional effect: Poison (9/tick).

Prophylaxis.name: Prophylaxis
Prophylaxis.description: Immediately restores the user's HP to 22%, then to 100% after 30 seconds unless the user is defeated in that window.

Protolithic Puncture.name: Protolithic Puncture
Protolithic Puncture.description: Deals severe damage to a single target and resets enmity.

Protostar.name: Protostar
Protostar.notes: Unlocked at low HP (33%-). Used while its wings are spread, and it may also reset its current target's hate.
Protostar.description: 20' AoE magical damage that resets every ready job ability on its targets to full recast — a whole-party ability wipe, not a self-buff.

Providence.name: Providence
Providence.notes: After Providence the Poroggo can cast Breakga, Graviga, Slowga, Bindga, and Death.
Providence.description: Grants the user Haste and unlocks casting of Breakga, Graviga, Slowga, Bindga, and Death.

Psyche Absorption.name: Psyche Absorption
Psyche Absorption.notes: The attribute down is not erasable. Removes all shadows.
Psyche Absorption.description: Frontal cone area-of-effect: absorbs HP and randomly 1-300+ of each attribute from players in range for 60 seconds.

Psychokinesis.name: Psychokinesis
Psychokinesis.notes: Only used by Blobdingnag. Summons 6 Septic Boils.

Psychomancy.name: Psychomancy
Psychomancy.notes: Only used in "staff" form. Takes ~80MP from affected players.
Psychomancy.description: AoE Aspir that drains 80+ MP from everyone in range. Used only in Staff Form.

Pull In.name: Pull In
Pull In.description: Draws in the target from a very large range.

Puncturing Frenzy.name: Puncturing Frenzy
Puncturing Frenzy.notes: Used by Notorious Monster Meebles only.
Puncturing Frenzy.description: A conal attack that deals physical damage.

Purulent Ooze.name: Purulent Ooze
Purulent Ooze.notes: Removes all shadows. The Bio component is roughly equivalent to Bio II.
Purulent Ooze.description: Damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Bio (-15 HP/tick, -10% attack) and Max HP Down (-10%).

Pyric Blast.name: Pyric Blast
Pyric Blast.notes: Used while the right/middle head is alive. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Pyric Blast.description: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Plague.

Pyric Bulwark.name: Pyric Bulwark
Pyric Bulwark.notes: Used while the right head is alive (left head in Nyzul, where the bulwarks are reversed).
Pyric Bulwark.description: Grants the monster an undispelable Magical Shield (~60s).

Pyroclastic Surge.name: Pyroclastic Surge
Pyroclastic Surge.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with additional Addle.

Quadrastrike.name: Quadrastrike
Quadrastrike.notes: Restricted move. Consumes 4 shadows (one per hit).
Quadrastrike.description: Four-hit physical attack with a 25% attack bonus.

Quadratic Continuum.name: Quadratic Continuum
Quadratic Continuum.description: Four-hit physical attack; inflicts a -20% Attack penalty on itself afterward.

Quake Blast.name: Quake Blast
Quake Blast.description: High AoE damage that also strips buffs.

Quake Stomp.name: Quake Stomp
Quake Stomp.description: Stomps the ground to boost next attack.

Queasyshroom.name: Queasyshroom
Queasyshroom.description: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Poison. First of the Queasyshroom->Numbshroom->Shakeshroom sequence; requires a full mushroom cap.

Quenching Hammer.name: Quenching Hammer
Quenching Hammer.notes: Ambuscade only. Buff count includes Runes and Geomancer spells; excludes food, Maneuvers, and SP abilities.
Quenching Hammer.description: Deals magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel (all) and Aspir. Damage rises with the number of buffs on the target.

Rabid Dance.name: Rabid Dance
Rabid Dance.description: Grants the user the effect of Evasion Bonus.

Radiant Breath.name: Radiant Breath
Radiant Breath.notes: Can deal upwards of 700 damage from Notorious Monsters.
Radiant Breath.description: Deals light breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Slow and Silence.

Radiant Sacrament.name: Radiant Sacrament
Radiant Sacrament.notes: Alexander generally used this on targets out of his melee range. Sometimes accompanied by the text:
Radiant Sacrament.description: Deals damage with Silence, Defense Down (-50%), and Magic Defense Down.

Rage.name: Rage
Rage.description: The user gains the Berserk effect, increasing attack.

Rail Cannon.name: Rail Cannon
Rail Cannon.notes: Area depends on the number of linked Gears.
Rail Cannon.description: Deals damage; the area scales with the number of linked Gears (3 Gears = AoE, 2 Gears = frontal cone, 1 Gear = single target).

Raksha Stance.name: Raksha Stance
Raksha Stance.notes: Dispels up to three status enhancements from players. Not every Naraka gains the damage reduction. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Raksha Stance.description: The monster enters Raksha Stance, gaining -50% magic damage taken and erasing its own status ailments. Unlocks the Raksha TP moves.

Raksha: Illusion.name: Raksha: Illusion
Raksha: Illusion.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. The Curse halves maximum HP and MP. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Raksha: Illusion.description: Long conal magic damage. Additional effect: Paralysis and Curse.

Raksha: Judgement.name: Raksha: Judgement
Raksha: Judgement.notes: Used by Hahava & Tapana while in Raksha Stance.
Raksha: Judgement.description: Deals area of effect damage. Additional effect: Amnesia, Bind, and Silence.

Raksha: Judgment.name: Raksha: Judgment
Raksha: Judgment.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Raksha: Judgment.description: Magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence, Amnesia and Bind.

Raksha: Vengeance.name: Raksha: Vengeance
Raksha: Vengeance.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. Weakness lasts one minute and is applied before the damage. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Raksha: Vengeance.description: Heavy magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Muddle and Weakness.

Rampant Gnaw.name: Rampant Gnaw
Rampant Gnaw.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis

Rampant Stance.name: Rampant Stance
Rampant Stance.notes: Takes roughly three seconds to charge the TP move up, enough time for anyone within range to easily back out and run back in directly after the animation begins.
Rampant Stance.description: Physical damage to nearby targets. Additional effect: Stun.

Rancid Breath.name: Rancid Breath
Rancid Breath.notes: Sandy will attempt to ready it and follow with an "Out of Range" message.
Rancid Breath.description: Used by Sensual Sandy in retaliation to skillchains.

Rancid Reflux.name: Rancid Reflux
Rancid Reflux.notes: Botulus Rex's version is conal and inflicts Max HP Down instead of plain damage.
Rancid Reflux.description: Area-of-effect damage plus Gravity and Knockback.

Random Kiss.name: Random Kiss
Random Kiss.description: Randomly steals an enemy's HP, MP, or TP.

Rapid Molt.name: Rapid Molt
Rapid Molt.notes: Doesn't use this unless there's something to Erase.
Rapid Molt.description: Sheds skin to erase negative debuffs. Additional effect: Regen

Raptorial Claw.name: Raptorial Claw
Raptorial Claw.description: AoE physical damage with Knockback and Magic Defense Down.

Ravenous Wail.name: Ravenous Wail
Ravenous Wail.description: Wind-based breath damage in an area of effect that also drains MP. Additional effects: Silence and Stun.

Razor Fang.name: Razor Fang
Razor Fang.description: Bites a single target in a twofold attack.

Reactive Shield.name: Reactive Shield
Reactive Shield.description: Grants the user Shock Spikes for 3 minutes.

Reactive Shield (Spheroid).name: Reactive Shield (Spheroid)
Reactive Shield (Spheroid).notes: Only used by Warders Agalaia, Euphrosyne, and Thalia simultaneously when all are awake.

Reactor Cool.name: Reactor Cool
Reactor Cool.description: Grants the Zdei a Defense Bonus and Ice Spikes (with a potent Paralyze effect).

Reactor Overload.name: Reactor Overload
Reactor Overload.description: Deals physical damage and Silence to targets in an area of effect.

Rear Lasers.name: Rear Lasers
Rear Lasers.notes: Only used when hate is pulled from the rear.
Rear Lasers.description: Fires lasers to the rear at players holding hate from behind. Additional effect: Petrifaction.

Reaving Wind.name: Reaving Wind
Reaving Wind.notes: Monster-centred. The Amphiptere attacks slower while the aura is up. Erinys also gains a DoT with the aura, and drops it after using Calamitous Wind.
Reaving Wind.description: Resets the mob's TP to 0 and creates a wind aura that periodically knocks back players within range.

Recoil Dive.name: Recoil Dive
Recoil Dive.utsusemi: Goes through and removes blink : 1 shadow?
Recoil Dive.description: Deals twofold damage to targets in a frontal cone. Can critical hit.

Redemption (Ability).name: Redemption (Ability)
Redemption (Ability).notes: Used by Selh'teus during Dawn battle when he's at low health. This restores all HP & MP and grants 300% TP to everyone in range. When using this, Selh'teus will say:
Redemption (Ability).description: Invokes the power of Phoenix to restore allies.

Refueling.name: Refueling
Refueling.description: Grants the user Haste (20% for 3 minutes).

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.notes: Restores 5~8 HP per tick for about 5 minutes.

Regurgitated Swarm.name: Regurgitated Swarm
Regurgitated Swarm.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it also sets TP to 0 - an AoE TP wipe.
Regurgitated Swarm.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Regurgitation.name: Regurgitation
Regurgitation.description: Damages a single target with additional Knockback and Bind.

Reinforcements.name: Reinforcements
Reinforcements.notes: The monsters summoned vary by rampart; see Salvage pages for specifics.

Rending Blow.name: Rending Blow
Rending Blow.description: A conal physical attack that dispels up to four beneficial effects (light-based).

Rending Deluge.name: Rending Deluge
Rending Deluge.notes: Removes all shadows. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.
Rending Deluge.description: Water-based AoE damage, and dispels 2-3 status enhancements.

Repelling Shout.name: Repelling Shout
Repelling Shout.description: An area-of-effect ability; full effect not documented.

Reprobation.name: Reprobation
Reprobation.notes: Restricted move — ordinary Soulflayers gain access to it only at low HP; NMs use it freely.
Reprobation.description: AoE Dispel that removes all beneficial status effects, including food.

Restoral.name: Restoral
Restoral.notes: Heals around 1300 HP. For gear clusters, this is generally enough to restore a gear to the cluster.

Retinal Glare.name: Retinal Glare
Retinal Glare.description: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts damage and Flash.

Retinal Glare (Blue Magic).name: Retinal Glare (Blue Magic)
Retinal Glare (Blue Magic).description: Grants the Job Trait Conserve MP when set.

Revelation.name: Revelation
Revelation.notes: Used by Selh'teus during Dawn battle. Also used by Trust: Selh'teus.

Reverberating Cry.name: Reverberating Cry
Reverberating Cry.notes: Centred on the monster. Palila resummons its vultures after using it.
Reverberating Cry.description: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effects: Magic Defense Down and Magic Evasion Down.

Reverie Frolic.name: Reverie Frolic
Reverie Frolic.notes: Used only by Sonia during Campaign.
Reverie Frolic.description: A playful dance inflicts Dia, Accuracy Down, and Magic Accuracy Down.

Reverse Current.name: Reverse Current
Reverse Current.notes: Centred on a player. Ongo's table calls the damage low.
Reverse Current.description: Lightning-based magic damage in an area of effect centred on a player. Additional effect: Stun.

Reviviscence.name: Reviviscence
Reviviscence.notes: This ability is currently only used by Ferreous Coffin.

Rhino Attack.name: Rhino Attack
Rhino Attack.description: Deals physical damage to a single target with Knockback and a 100% Attack bonus.

Rhinowrecker.name: Rhinowrecker
Rhinowrecker.notes: Unique Beetle-NM move. Gulltop gains access to it below 25% HP; keep it pointed away from weaker party members.
Rhinowrecker.description: High conal physical damage with knockback.

Riddle.name: Riddle
Riddle.dispel: N/A - See Max MP Down for how to remove
Riddle.notes: Retaliation to magic damage; locks MP.
Riddle.description: Reduces maximum MP in an area of effect.

Righteous Rasp.name: Righteous Rasp
Righteous Rasp.description: Frontal cone. Additional effects: Magic Defense Down and Defense Down.

Rime Spray.name: Rime Spray
Rime Spray.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area, inflicting them with Frost and All statuses down.

Rinpyotosha.name: Rinpyotosha
Rinpyotosha.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Howl. Also used by Trust: Gessho.

Ripper Fang.name: Ripper Fang
Ripper Fang.description: Damages a single target with additional Slow.

Riptide Eupnea.name: Riptide Eupnea
Riptide Eupnea.notes: On Marmorkrebs its Max HP Down followed by Sundering Snip is a guaranteed KO on the tank if the Max HP Down lands.
Riptide Eupnea.description: AoE damage. Additional effects: Max HP Down, Encumbrance and Bind.

Rising Swell.name: Rising Swell
Rising Swell.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Merrow.
Rising Swell.description: Removes all equipment from nearby players.

Ritual Bind.name: Ritual Bind
Ritual Bind.notes: Used by Bloodeye Vileberry and Murk-Veined Baneberry. After using, will teleport to the character with the most hate, using Throat Stab several times in a row.
Ritual Bind.description: Area of Effect Bind and Paralyze.

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.description: Paralyzes targets in an area of effect.

Rock Buster.name: Rock Buster
Rock Buster.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Blunt damage that inflicts Bind.

Rock Smash.name: Rock Smash
Rock Smash.description: Damages a single target. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Rock Throw.name: Rock Throw
Rock Throw.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A ranged attack with an additional Slow effect.

Roller Chain.name: Roller Chain
Roller Chain.notes: Used only when the door is closed.
Roller Chain.description: Deals physical damage and inflicts Bind.

Root of the Problem.name: Root of the Problem
Root of the Problem.description: Absorbs buffs and TP from a single target.

Rot Gas.name: Rot Gas
Rot Gas.notes: Disease blocks HP and MP recovery for 6 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Rot Gas.description: Releases a rotting gas in an area of effect centred on the monster.

Rotten Stench.name: Rotten Stench
Rotten Stench.description: Area-of-effect Magic Accuracy Down and Accuracy Down.

Royal Bash.name: Royal Bash
Royal Bash.notes: Used only by Trion during the Hero's Combat BCNM. Trust: Trion also uses this job ability.
Royal Bash.description: An enhanced Shield Bash: single-target damage and Stun.

Royal Decree.name: Royal Decree
Royal Decree.notes: Used only by Raja. Effect lasts approximately 5 minutes. Kills Avatars, deals damage occasionally and death. Players may not receive experience until the Obliviscence effect wears off. There is no icon for this effect.
Royal Decree.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and temporarily restricts their support job abilities.

Royal Savior.name: Royal Savior
Royal Savior.notes: Used only by Trion during the Hero's Combat special BCNM. Trust: Trion also uses this job ability.
Royal Savior.description: Grants Protect effect to target only.

Ruinous Omen.name: Ruinous Omen
Ruinous Omen.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Ruinous Omen.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Halves the current HP of enemies in an area of effect.

Ruinous Scythe.name: Ruinous Scythe
Ruinous Scythe.description: Deals damage in a quadruple attack to targetted player in range. Additional effect: Max HP Down

Rumble.name: Rumble
Rumble.description: A disorienting vibration lowers evasion of targets in an area of effect.

Rushing Drub.name: Rushing Drub
Rushing Drub.notes: Used by WHM/BLM Mamool Ja only.
Rushing Drub.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Rushing Slash.name: Rushing Slash
Rushing Slash.notes: Used by BST Mamool Ja only.
Rushing Slash.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Rushing Stab.name: Rushing Stab
Rushing Stab.notes: Used by DRG Mamool Ja only.
Rushing Stab.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
Ruthlessness.description: Frontal cone: drains about 1500 HP and inflicts Amnesia.

Sable Breath.name: Sable Breath
Sable Breath.notes: Used only by Vrtra and Azdaja.
Sable Breath.description: Deals darkness damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Sacred Caper.name: Sacred Caper
Sacred Caper.description: Area-of-effect light magic damage. Additional effect: Rasp and Terror.

Sakra Storm.name: Sakra Storm
Sakra Storm.notes: Used only by Uptala and Vinipata. Uptala uses it below 50% HP. Removes all shadows.
Sakra Storm.description: Moderate damage to players in an area of effect, with a hate reset. Additional effect: Zombie, Paralysis and Muddle.

Saline Coat.name: Saline Coat
Saline Coat.description: Self-buff. Gains a large Magic Defense Bonus (+100).

Sanative Shadow.name: Sanative Shadow
Sanative Shadow.description: Restores the user to full HP once its HP bar becomes shrouded.

Sand Breath.name: Sand Breath
Sand Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Sand Shield.name: Sand Shield
Sand Shield.description: Applies a sand barrier to increase defense.

Sand Trap.name: Sand Trap
Sand Trap.notes: Can be stunned; petrification typically has a very short duration, similar to Stun
Sand Trap.description: Petrifies targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Hate reset

Sand Veil.name: Sand Veil
Sand Veil.description: Applies a sand shroud to increase evasion.

Sandblast.name: Sandblast
Sandblast.description: Inflicts Blind on enemies in an area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Sandpit.name: Sandpit
Sandpit.description: Inflicts Bind on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Sandspin.name: Sandspin
Sandspin.description: Area-of-effect damage and Accuracy Down (-25 accuracy, 3 min).

Sandspray.name: Sandspray
Sandspray.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Sandspray.description: Deals damage to players in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blindness and Accuracy Down (-100).

Sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
Sandstorm.description: Kicks up a sandstorm, inflicting Blindness on targets in an area of effect.

Sandstorm (Antica).name: Sandstorm (Antica)
Sandstorm (Antica).description: Kicks up a blinding dust cloud on targets in an area of effect.

Sanguinary Slash.name: Sanguinary Slash
Sanguinary Slash.description: Physical damage to a single target with Knockback and Max HP Down (~10%).

Sanguine Slash.name: Sanguine Slash
Sanguine Slash.description: '''Deals physical damage and inflicts Max HP Down.

Sanngetall.name: Sanngetall
Sanngetall.notes: Odin will say a random speech before using this move.
Sanngetall.description: Dispels all songs and rolls from targets in a 15' area of effect.

Saucepan.name: Saucepan
Saucepan.notes: Used only by the Seed Goblin. Gives players a food effect that lowers attributes by up to -15, replacing any food already consumed (for 30 minutes).

Saurian Slide.name: Saurian Slide
Saurian Slide.description: Physical damage that strips the target's main and sub weapons (temporary weapon Encumbrance) and knocks them back.

Saurian Swamp.name: Saurian Swamp
Saurian Swamp.description: AoE magic damage plus Bind and Slow.

Savage Swordhand.name: Savage Swordhand
Savage Swordhand.range: Area of Effect, 15' in all directions
Savage Swordhand.notes: *Unique Fomor NM weapon skill, used by Haudrale in the fight Darkness Descends.

Scalding Breath.name: Scalding Breath
Scalding Breath.description: Deals water damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Burn (~30/tic), Knockback, and a TP reset. Removes all shadows.

Scapula Beam.name: Scapula Beam
Scapula Beam.description: Deals magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: All Stats Down (-80%). Removes all shadows.

Scatter Shell.name: Scatter Shell
Scatter Shell.notes: Certain Notorious Monster only; long cast time (~3-4s).
Scatter Shell.description: An area-of-effect attack dealing roughly 1000 physical damage divided equally among all targets.

Scintillant Lance.name: Scintillant Lance
Scintillant Lance.notes: Used by Auroral Alicorn, Veiled Alicorn.
Scintillant Lance.description: High light-based magical damage in a frontal cone (~160°). Removes shadows.

Scission Thrust.name: Scission Thrust
Scission Thrust.description: Deals directional (conal) area damage. Used only in Sword Form.

Scissor Guard.name: Scissor Guard
Scissor Guard.notes: Overwrites any existing Defense Down (e.g. Acid Bolts) and is likewise overwritten by a new Defense Down. Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that directly reduces physical damage by ~90% and cannot be dispelled.
Scissor Guard.description: Grants the crab a Defense Bonus: base defense x2 for 1 minute.

Scorching Lash.name: Scorching Lash
Scorching Lash.description: Deals heavy damage to targets behind user.

Scorching Luminescence.name: Scorching Luminescence
Scorching Luminescence.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effects: Dia and Knockback.

Scouring Bubbles.name: Scouring Bubbles
Scouring Bubbles.notes: Mihli Aliapoh's signature weapon skill; she prefers it over other WS.

Scouring Spate.name: Scouring Spate
Scouring Spate.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Attack Down.

Scratch.name: Scratch
Scratch.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NMs and Gaganas use Blind Vortex instead.

Scream.name: Scream
Scream.notes: In Dynamis - Buburimu, the Nightmare Mandragora's Scream is enhanced to also inflict Terror.
Scream.description: Area-of-effect MND Down (~-25%, decays over 3 min). Additional effect: Terror.

Screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
Screwdriver.description: Inflicts damage on a single target. Can critical hit.

Scurvy.name: Scurvy
Scurvy.description: Inflicts Plague on targets in an area of effect.

Scythe Tail.name: Scythe Tail
Scythe Tail.description: Damages a single target with additional Stun and Knockback.

Seal of Quiescence.name: Seal of Quiescence
Seal of Quiescence.notes: Only used during his second form. Mute cannot be removed by Silena or Erase, and must wear off on its own (usually 75 seconds).
Seal of Quiescence.description: AoE Mute lasting up to 75 seconds. Cannot be removed with Silena or Echo Drops.

Searing Effulgence.name: Searing Effulgence
Searing Effulgence.description: AoE light damage with Knockback and a strong Dia III (~-24% defense, 15-60s).

Searing Halitus.name: Searing Halitus
Searing Halitus.description: Conal fire damage with a strong Burn damage-over-time (~38 HP/tick).

Searing Serration.name: Searing Serration
Searing Serration.description: A four-fold hybrid attack on a single target with all attributes down (~200 each, ~1 min).

Searing Tempest.name: Searing Tempest
Searing Tempest.description: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn.

Seaspray.name: Seaspray
Seaspray.notes: Slow effect is equivalent to Slow II. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
Seaspray.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP x 0.125, capped at 500 damage for non-NMs). Additional effect: Slow (35%, 30~60s).

Seed of Deception.name: Seed of Deception
Seed of Deception.description: Clones the targeted player as a 'Seed Thrall' that attacks whoever currently holds hate.

Seed of Deference.name: Seed of Deference
Seed of Deference.range: *Notes: Anyone who is effected by this weaponskill will have their MP restored to full once the Charm effect wears off.
Seed of Deference.description: Charms players in range, dressing any charmed player in a Mandragora costume.

Seed of Judgement.name: Seed of Judgement
Seed of Judgement.notes: Used by Seed Crystal only below 50% HP.
Seed of Judgement.description: A high-damage knockback blast over an area.

Seed of Judgment.name: Seed of Judgment
Seed of Judgment.utsusemi: Utsusemi blocks damage, but not knockback effect.
Seed of Judgment.notes: ~700-1300 damage. Seed Crystal begins using this move once it falls below 50% HP.
Seed of Judgment.description: Heavy AoE damage + all 7 Attributes Down + knockback.

Seed of Nihility.name: Seed of Nihility
Seed of Nihility.range: *Notes: Sets all Job Abilities (including 2hrs) that are ready for use to the maximum recast, as if they had been used. Only affects job abilities that are currently ready for use and are not waiting on their recast timer.
Seed of Nihility.description: Deals minor damage to players in range and resets every party member's job-ability recast timers to maximum, including two-hour abilities.

Seedspray.name: Seedspray
Seedspray.description: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Defense Down (~-33%).

Seismic Impact.name: Seismic Impact
Seismic Impact.description: Deals earth damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: extremely potent Slow, Terror, and hate reset.

Seismic Tail.name: Seismic Tail
Seismic Tail.description: Deals damage and knockback to targets in a 10' area of effect. Can critical hit.

Seismohammer.name: Seismohammer
Seismohammer.description: Swings the hammer right at a single target. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Seismostomp.name: Seismostomp
Seismostomp.notes: Used by all Replicas. Absorbed by Utsusemi. As a Replica's HP falls its regain intensifies, so it uses Seismostomp more often and can chain it back-to-back when fed TP by incoming damage.
Seismostomp.description: A stomping shockwave that damages nearby players. Additional effect: Stun.

Self-Destruct.name: Self-Destruct
Self-Destruct.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Self-Destruct.description: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.

Self-Destruct (Cluster).name: Self-Destruct (Cluster)
Self-Destruct (Cluster).notes: Only used below 50% health. Normally only detonates one of the bombs in the cluster, but if its used below 20%, there's a chance all bombs will explode.
Self-Destruct (Cluster).description: Detonates one (or all) of its bombs, inflicting .

Sensilla Blades.name: Sensilla Blades
Sensilla Blades.description: Deals physical damage to players in a narrow cone-shaped area with Knockback.

Sensual Dance.name: Sensual Dance
Sensual Dance.description: A dance that increases Attack and Magic Attack and gives Attack Down, and Magic Attack Down to foes.

Serpentine Tail.name: Serpentine Tail
Serpentine Tail.notes: Used only when the hate-holder is behind the Hydra.
Serpentine Tail.description: Deals physical damage to a player holding hate from behind.

Setting the Stage.name: Setting the Stage
Setting the Stage.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it is an AoE instead, dealing roughly 30,000 damage divided by the number of targets in range, used about every three minutes. It bypasses Scherzo and Migawari but is survivable with Mana Wall, Perfect Defense, or an Annuls Damage proc.
Setting the Stage.description: Deals damage to a single player. Additional effects: Slow and Amnesia.

Severing Fang.name: Severing Fang
Severing Fang.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Consumes 2 shadows.
Severing Fang.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down.

Shackled Fists.name: Shackled Fists
Shackled Fists.notes: Only used by Fomors using hand-to-hand combat (monks).
Shackled Fists.description: Cursed fists deals damage in a fivefold attack to a single target.

Shadow Burst.name: Shadow Burst
Shadow Burst.notes: NMs only; becomes available below 50% HP.
Shadow Burst.description: AoE Dark magic damage that inflicts Curse (halves max HP and MP) and removes shadows.

Shadow Claw.name: Shadow Claw
Shadow Claw.description: Claws a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Shadow Spread.name: Shadow Spread
Shadow Spread.description: A dark shroud renders any nearby targets blinded, asleep, and cursed.

Shadow Thrust.name: Shadow Thrust
Shadow Thrust.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Shadow Wreck.name: Shadow Wreck
Shadow Wreck.description: Deals damage and -50% Defense Down to targets in an area of effect.

Shah Mat.name: Shah Mat
Shah Mat.description: Gaze attack inflicting Terror and Doom; the gaze lingers briefly like an aura after use.

Shakeshroom.name: Shakeshroom
Shakeshroom.notes: Not used until after the Queasyshroom and Numbshroom have been fired.
Shakeshroom.description: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Disease. Used after Queasyshroom and Numbshroom.

Sharp Sting.name: Sharp Sting
Sharp Sting.description: Deals high damage to target in a ranged attack.

Sharp Strike.name: Sharp Strike
Sharp Strike.notes: Grants 50% boost to attack for about 4 minutes, 15 seconds.

Shearing Undulation.name: Shearing Undulation
Shearing Undulation.description: AoE damage with Defense Down and Magic Defense Down (60s each).

Sheep Bleat.name: Sheep Bleat
Sheep Bleat.notes: Used only by the Nightmare Sheep in Dynamis - Valkurm. The slow effect can be overwritten by Haste.
Sheep Bleat.description: Emits a unnerving bleat that slows down players in range.

Sheep Charge.name: Sheep Charge
Sheep Charge.notes: When performed by a Beastmaster with Ready, it carries skillchain attributes.
Sheep Charge.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback

Sheep Song.name: Sheep Song
Sheep Song.description: Puts all players within range to sleep.

Shell Bash.name: Shell Bash
Shell Bash.notes: Does not knockback like Head Butt does, but is readied much faster.

Shell Charge.name: Shell Charge
Shell Charge.notes: Used only by Ga'Lhu Nevermolt, and very rarely Di'Dha Adamantfist. Attacking from the side may prevent you from getting hit.
Shell Charge.description: Deals damage in a fan-shaped area around the target, causing knockback. Additional effect: Amnesia. Amount of damage varies by TP.

Shibaraku.name: Shibaraku
Shibaraku.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless. Can be extremely deadly when used by the latter during campaign battles (can reach up to 2000 damage). Also used by Trust: Gessho.
Shibaraku.description: AoE physical damage with additional Knockback and Stun.

Shield Strike.name: Shield Strike
Shield Strike.notes: Knockback may be absorbed by shadows; reduced by Repulse Mantle.
Shield Strike.description: Cone attack dealing ~100 damage with a knockback.

Shiko no Mitate.name: Shiko no Mitate
Shiko no Mitate.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Parry. Also used by Trust: Gessho.

Shirahadori.name: Shirahadori
Shirahadori.notes: Used by Yagudo Genja, Maa Illmu the Bestower, and Soo Luma the Ascended.
Shirahadori.description: Pins down a single target with feathers. Additional effect: Knockback and Bind.

Shock Wave.name: Shock Wave
Shock Wave.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Shoulder Attack.name: Shoulder Attack
Shoulder Attack.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: knockback

Shoulder Charge.name: Shoulder Charge
Shoulder Charge.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Wings of the Goddess areas.
Shoulder Charge.description: Deals physical damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down

Shoulder Slam.name: Shoulder Slam
Shoulder Slam.description: Body slams into a single target. Additional effect: Knockback

Shrieking Gale.name: Shrieking Gale
Shrieking Gale.description: Damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel.

Shuffle.name: Shuffle
Shuffle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Shuffle.description: Dispels one beneficial status effect from targets in a frontal cone.

Sideswipe.name: Sideswipe
Sideswipe.notes: Removes the user's own enmity. Used when wielding Hand-to-Hand.

Sigh (Tonberry).name: Sigh (Tonberry)
Sigh (Tonberry).description: Takes a deep sigh and increases evasion.

Silence Gas.name: Silence Gas
Silence Gas.notes: Can be very deadly from higher level funguars. Damage varies depending on HP.
Silence Gas.description: Fan-shaped breath attack dealing damage (scales with current HP). Additional effect: Silence.

Silence Seal.name: Silence Seal
Silence Seal.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Silence Seal.description: Inflicts Silence on players in an area of effect for 2 minutes.

Silencing Blast.name: Silencing Blast
Silencing Blast.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows

Silent Storm.name: Silent Storm
Silent Storm.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence.

Sinister Wing.name: Sinister Wing
Sinister Wing.description: Left-side conal physical damage with knockback.

Sinker Drill.name: Sinker Drill
Sinker Drill.notes: Deals piercing damage. Requires a left arm to use. Consumes 5 shadows.
Sinker Drill.description: Deals five-hit damage to a single target.

Sinuate Rush.name: Sinuate Rush
Sinuate Rush.notes: Only used when the caster is not enfeebled.
Sinuate Rush.description: Damages nearby targets with an undulating attack.

Siphon Discharge.name: Siphon Discharge
Siphon Discharge.description: Frontal cone water damage equal to 10% of the user’s current HP.

Skull Smash.name: Skull Smash
Skull Smash.notes: Used only by Khroma Quadav, Ra'Dha Scarscute, Ru'Bha Stonewall, and Za'Dha Adamantking.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Slam Dunk.name: Slam Dunk
Slam Dunk.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: bind

Slaverous Gale.name: Slaverous Gale
Slaverous Gale.description: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage plus Slow and Plague.

Sledgehammer.name: Sledgehammer
Sledgehammer.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic.
Sledgehammer.description: Delivers a sledgehammer blow to all targets in front. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Sleet Blast.name: Sleet Blast
Sleet Blast.notes: Used only by Jormungand when he's in the sky.
Sleet Blast.description: A sleet storm deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Slicing Sickle.name: Slicing Sickle
Slicing Sickle.description: Cone-shaped physical damage with Knockback and Defense Down.

Slimy Proposal.name: Slimy Proposal
Slimy Proposal.description: Area-of-effect Charm (~30 seconds) plus Dia (-38/tick). Clears negative status ailments from the user.

Sling Bomb.name: Sling Bomb
Sling Bomb.description: Deals ranged damage to a single target.

Slipstream.name: Slipstream
Slipstream.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Slipstream.description: Inflicts Accuracy Down and Ranged Accuracy Down (-25, 2~3 min) on players in an area of effect.

Sloughy Sputum.name: Sloughy Sputum
Sloughy Sputum.description: Cone-shaped damage plus Gravity, Drown, and Knockback.

Slumber Powder.name: Slumber Powder
Slumber Powder.utsusemi: Goes through Utsusemi, does not wipe Effect.

Smite of Fury.name: Smite of Fury
Smite of Fury.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.
Smite of Fury.description: Deals critical damage to a single target.

Smite of Rage.name: Smite of Rage
Smite of Rage.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Smoke Discharger.name: Smoke Discharger
Smoke Discharger.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Smoke Discharger.description: Sprays a cloud of smoke that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Smokebomb.name: Smokebomb
Smokebomb.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).
Smokebomb.description: Throws a blinding smoke bomb at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Snatch Morsel.name: Snatch Morsel
Snatch Morsel.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Resistible with magic evasion AND fire resistance+ — you need a fire resistance value greater than 0, no matter your magic evasion level. Yalungur spawns a Predatory Colibri with each use and levels up if it stole food.

Snort.name: Snort
Snort.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Snow Cloud.name: Snow Cloud
Snow Cloud.notes: Used only by the white rabbits inhabiting snowy areas (namely Uleguerand Range), instead of Dust Cloud.
Snow Cloud.description: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralyze

Snowball.name: Snowball
Snowball.description: Deals ice damage to players in a 10' area of effect.

Snowball (ability).name: Snowball (ability)
Snowball (ability).notes: Only used by lizards in Pso'Xja and some Notorious Monsters.
Snowball (ability).description: Deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Somersault.name: Somersault
Somersault.notes: Used only in Chains of Promathia areas.

Somersault Kick.name: Somersault Kick
Somersault Kick.description: Deals physical damage to a single target with an added Knockback effect.

Somnial Durance.name: Somnial Durance
Somnial Durance.notes: Used by Sarimanok when below 50% HP.
Somnial Durance.description: Inflicts Sleep on players in an area of effect.

Sonic Blade.name: Sonic Blade
Sonic Blade.description: Deals heavy damage to targets in an area of effect. Used only in Sword Form.

Sonic Boom.name: Sonic Boom
Sonic Boom.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Sonic Boom.description: Inflicts Attack Down (-25%, 2~3 min) on players in an area of effect centred on the monster.

Sonic Buffet.name: Sonic Buffet
Sonic Buffet.description: Wind-based conal attack that dispels 2-3 beneficial effects.

Sonic Wave.name: Sonic Wave
Sonic Wave.description: Reduces defense of enemies in an area of effect.

Soothing Aroma.name: Soothing Aroma
Soothing Aroma.notes: Only used by Kirtimukha and Raskovnik.

Soporific.name: Soporific
Soporific.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.
Soporific.description: 10' area-of-effect dark-based magic. Additional effect: Sleep. Bypasses Utsusemi.

Soul Accretion.name: Soul Accretion
Soul Accretion.utsusemi: Bypasses shadows and is able to remove them.
Soul Accretion.notes: Goes through shadows — bypasses them, but does not remove them. Tiyanak uses it almost exclusively below 25% HP.
Soul Accretion.description: Absorbs one buff at random from a single player.

Soul Douse.name: Soul Douse
Soul Douse.notes: Frontal target only. Doom count is 5 when wings are up, 10 when down.
Soul Douse.description: Frontal conal breath damage with an additional Doom effect.

Soul Drain.name: Soul Drain
Soul Drain.description: Single-target unaspected physical damage that drains the target’s HP.

Soul Enslavement.name: Soul Enslavement
Soul Enslavement.notes: While it is active, Lumber Jill loses her Enstun effect.
Soul Enslavement.description: Dark Knight SP ability used by some Beetle NMs.

Soul Infusion.name: Soul Infusion
Soul Infusion.description: Transfers the attributes drained by Soul Vacuum to Cait Sith Ceithir.

Soul Vacuum.name: Soul Vacuum
Soul Vacuum.notes: Used by Atomos, immediately followed by Soul Infusion.
Soul Vacuum.description: Drains attributes from all players within range, reducing each stat by roughly 50 points.

Soul Voice.name: Soul Voice
Soul Voice.description: Bard SP ability: doubles the potency of the user's songs for its duration.

Soulfetter Arrow.name: Soulfetter Arrow
Soulfetter Arrow.notes: Used only by Vhino Delkahngo during Campaign.
Soulfetter Arrow.description: Fires a barrage of light enchanted arrows. Additional effect: Knockback

Soulshattering Roar.name: Soulshattering Roar
Soulshattering Roar.description: AoE roar dealing damage and Terror; the user gains a shield granting temporary immunity to one physical damage type (Slashing, Piercing, or H2H). Remove it with a weapon skill from behind (on Fleetstalker, first proc a stagger with Water damage).

Sound Blast.name: Sound Blast
Sound Blast.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Sound Blast.description: Inflicts INT Down (-10 INT, decays, 3 min) on players around the monster.

Sound Vacuum.name: Sound Vacuum
Sound Vacuum.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. AREA DIFFERS BY FAMILY: the Cockatrice version is conical and silences for 1~2 min; the Worm version is single target (1P) for 30~90s, except Nightmare Worm, which is conical. The Nightmare Cockatrice inflicts Mute instead of Silence.

Sovereign's Edict.name: Sovereign's Edict
Sovereign's Edict.description: Grants a magic shield for 15 seconds and causes every other Velkk to use its one-hour ability.

Sparkstorm.name: Sparkstorm
Sparkstorm.description: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect centred on a player. Additional effects: Accuracy Down (-50), Magic Accuracy Down (-50) and TP reduction.

Spectral Barrier.name: Spectral Barrier
Spectral Barrier.description: Grants Magic Shield (immunity to magic damage) for 30-60 seconds.

Spectral Floe.name: Spectral Floe
Spectral Floe.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror.

Spider Web (Ability).name: Spider Web (Ability)
Spider Web (Ability).notes: Slow is equivalent to Slow II.
Spider Web (Ability).description: Entangles all targets in an area of effect.

Spike Flail.name: Spike Flail
Spike Flail.notes: Only uses this ability if the target with hate is out of reach of the wyrm's head, such as near its hind legs or directly behind it. If fafnir doesn't have enough TP, he will attack this target with normal attacks with his tail, instead. If the target still has hate when he readies a TP attack, he'll virtually always use the only TP attack solely associated with his tail, Spike Flail. Due to his high regain in combination with attacks made on him, he will likely be able to use this ability the moment a target outside the range of his head has taken hate. Damage can be reduced by Blink, Utsusemi, Stoneskin, PLD's Invincible and Sentinel. General damage is about 1600-2400.
Spike Flail.description: Deals extreme damage in a threefold attack to targets behind the user.

Spikeball.name: Spikeball
Spikeball.description: Throws a spiky projectile at a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Spin.name: Spin
Spin.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.
Spin.description: Spins in place for AoE damage with a knockback effect.

Spinal Cleave.name: Spinal Cleave
Spinal Cleave.notes: Only used hand-to-hand, once the primary weapon has broken. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Spinal Cleave.description: Damage to a single player. Can critical hit.

Spine Chiller.name: Spine Chiller
Spine Chiller.notes: Used only by Leonoyne during Campaign, and Trust: Leonoyne.
Spine Chiller.description: Terrorizes all enemies in range with a powerful -based attack.

Spinechiller.name: Spinechiller
Spinechiller.notes: Used only by Leonoyne during Campaign. Terror has a fairly long duration.
Spinechiller.description: Delivers an elemental attack. Additional effect: Terror

Spinning Attack.name: Spinning Attack
Spinning Attack.description: Frontal cone dealing damage with Knockback.

Spinning Attack (Magic Pot).name: Spinning Attack (Magic Pot)
Spinning Attack (Magic Pot).description: Spins into targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback

Spinning Claw.name: Spinning Claw
Spinning Claw.description: Slashes targets in an area of effect.

Spinning Fin.name: Spinning Fin
Spinning Fin.description: A spinning attack that damages targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Spinning Top.name: Spinning Top
Spinning Top.description: Deals damage in an area of effect.

Spiral Burst.name: Spiral Burst
Spiral Burst.notes: Used only by Skogs Fru during the Day.
Spiral Burst.description: Sacrifices HP for cone-shaped damage and erases all of the ladybug's own negative status effects.

Spiral Spin.name: Spiral Spin
Spiral Spin.description: Cone-shaped physical damage with Accuracy Down (~-40). Used only during daytime.

Spirit Absorption.name: Spirit Absorption
Spirit Absorption.description: Steals HP or a random buff from a single target.

Spirit Tap.name: Spirit Tap
Spirit Tap.notes: Can be any (positive) buff, including food. Will drain about 100HP if it can't take any buffs.
Spirit Tap.description: Absorbs one positive status effect from a single target, or otherwise drains HP.

Spirits Within.name: Spirits Within
Spirits Within.description: Sword weapon skill dealing damage based on the user’s remaining HP to a single target.

Splash Breath.name: Splash Breath
Splash Breath.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone (current HP x 10%, capped at 400 damage for non-NMs).

Spoil.name: Spoil
Spoil.notes: Initially applied as STR -10, and counts down by 1 (STR -10, STR -9, STR -8, ...) until wearing off completely.

Spore.name: Spore
Spore.notes: Does not wear off when changing jobs or entering Mog House
Spore.description: Cone-shaped spore cloud that inflicts Paralysis.

Sprout Smack.name: Sprout Smack
Sprout Smack.description: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Slow.

Stalking Prey.name: Stalking Prey
Stalking Prey.description: AoE hate reset. Additional effect: Terror.

Start from Scratch.name: Start from Scratch
Start from Scratch.description: Removes all status ailments from the caster.

Starward Yowl.name: Starward Yowl
Starward Yowl.description: AoE. Additional effects: Knockback and Bind.

Stasis.name: Stasis
Stasis.notes: Used only by Serket, Shaula and Nightmare Scorpions.

Static Prison.name: Static Prison
Static Prison.notes: Centred on the monster. Ongo's own table gates it to HP <50%. On Cailimh and Palila it is an aura-only move: Cailimh's dispels 1-2 buffs, Palila's dispels 2 and applies a potent Paralyze.
Static Prison.description: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effects: Paralyze, Shock (-20 HP/tick) and multiple buff dispel.

Stellar Burst.name: Stellar Burst
Stellar Burst.description: Inflicts damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Sticky Grenade.name: Sticky Grenade
Sticky Grenade.description: An area-of-effect attack that deals physical damage with an added Weight effect.

Sticky Situation.name: Sticky Situation
Sticky Situation.description: Magical damage to enemies in an area with additional Plague, Slow, and Silence.

Sticky Thread.name: Sticky Thread
Sticky Thread.notes: The slow effect is weaker than the White Magic spell Haste. The spell will overwrite Sticky Thread. If a player has Haste, Sticky Thread will have no effect.
Sticky Thread.description: Inflicts slow on targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Stifling Tantara.name: Stifling Tantara
Stifling Tantara.description: AoE magic damage that also inflicts Silence.

Stinger Volley.name: Stinger Volley
Stinger Volley.description: Deals wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Paralysis and Curse (Recovery Down / Zombie, ~5-10 sec).

Stinking Gas.name: Stinking Gas
Stinking Gas.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Stinking Gas.description: Inflicts VIT Down (-10 VIT, decaying 1 per 15 seconds) on players in an area of effect.

Stomping.name: Stomping
Stomping.description: Deals heavy damage to a single target.

Stone Throw.name: Stone Throw
Stone Throw.description: Throws a rock at a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis

Storm Wing.name: Storm Wing
Storm Wing.description: Threefold wind damage in a 15' frontal cone, with Silence (90~120s) and Knockback.

Stormwind.name: Stormwind
Stormwind.notes: Removes all shadows. NMs and Gaganas normally use Dread Wind instead, but Suzaku, Vedrfolnir, Zduhac and Picolaton keep it.
Stormwind.description: Threefold damage to players in an area of effect.

Strap Cutter.name: Strap Cutter
Strap Cutter.description: Removes and disables several (3-5) random equipment slots for a period of time.

Stun Cannon.name: Stun Cannon
Stun Cannon.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form). Ignores shadows.
Stun Cannon.description: Fires an energy cannon at players in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Stunbolt.name: Stunbolt
Stunbolt.notes: Used only in Bastion and Brenner.
Stunbolt.description: Deals lightning damage and Stun to a single target.

Stunning Blast.name: Stunning Blast
Stunning Blast.utsusemi: Bypasses but does not wipe shadows.
Stunning Blast.notes: Only used by Stun Tube, which despawn after using this ability.
Stunning Blast.description: Inflicts Stun to targets within Area of Effect

Stupor Spores.name: Stupor Spores
Stupor Spores.notes: Non-elemental. Bypasses shadows. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.

Stygian Cyclone.name: Stygian Cyclone
Stygian Cyclone.description: Deals magic damage and Silence to targets in an area of effect.

Stygian Release.name: Stygian Release
Stygian Release.description: Deals damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Knockback and Dispel (removes one status enhancement).

Stygian Sphere.name: Stygian Sphere
Stygian Sphere.notes: Iratham variants also gain a magic shield, Stoneskin, and a Magic Attack boost; magic damage removes the shield.
Stygian Sphere.description: Restores roughly 2,000 HP to the user and removes all enfeebling effects.

Stygian Vapor.name: Stygian Vapor
Stygian Vapor.description: Infernal fumes inflicts nearby targets with a plague.

Sub-zero Smash.name: Sub-zero Smash
Sub-zero Smash.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Sub-zero Smash.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Subduction.name: Subduction
Subduction.description: Deals damage based on the target’s remaining HP in an area of effect, with a very potent Gravity effect.

Subjugating Slash.name: Subjugating Slash
Subjugating Slash.description: Cone damage with Knockback that dispels up to 3 enhancements. On the ★ battlefield it instead resets enmity and deals a large % of Max HP.

Subsonics.name: Subsonics
Subsonics.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Subsonics.description: Inflicts Defense Down (-25%, 90~180s) on targets in an area of effect.

Suctorial Tentacle.name: Suctorial Tentacle
Suctorial Tentacle.notes: Bind lasts 30~90 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Suctorial Tentacle.description: Inflicts Poison and Bind on a single target.

Sudden Lunge.name: Sudden Lunge
Sudden Lunge.description: Sacrifices HP for single-target damage with Knockback and Stun. Used only at night.

Sulfurous Breath.name: Sulfurous Breath
