Sulfurous Breath.description: Deals physical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from the caster.

Summer Breeze.name: Summer Breeze
Summer Breeze.notes: If it has no debuffs to erase, the pixie gets Regain instead.
Summer Breeze.description: Erases negative status effects, or gains Regain.

Sundering Snip.name: Sundering Snip
Sundering Snip.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The damage IS reduced by Magic Damage Taken. On Marmorkrebs it is manageable with Sulpor Valiance, but Riptide Eupnea's Max HP Down followed by Sundering Snip is a guaranteed KO on the tank if the Max HP Down is not removed in time. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.
Sundering Snip.description: Water-based AoE damage dealing 60% of the target's maximum HP, and applies Magic Defense Down.

Supernova.name: Supernova
Supernova.notes: Unlocked at low HP (33%-). Used while its wings are down; not used on Very Easy or Easy. Any Doom still running is removed on leaving the battlefield.
Supernova.description: 20' AoE magical damage with a 10-count Doom.

Supersonics.name: Supersonics
Supersonics.notes: ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Supersonics.description: Inflicts Accuracy Down on targets in an area of effect.

Swath of Silence.name: Swath of Silence
Swath of Silence.notes: Signals a period of magic immunity on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Sweep.name: Sweep
Sweep.description: Damages enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Sweeping Flail.name: Sweeping Flail
Sweeping Flail.notes: Used whenever someone with hate is behind him.
Sweeping Flail.description: Spins around to deal physical damage to enemies behind user. Additional effect: Knockback

Sweeping Gouge.name: Sweeping Gouge
Sweeping Gouge.description: Delivers a twofold attack. Additional effect: Decreases defense.

Sweet Breath.name: Sweet Breath
Sweet Breath.description: Puts all targets in a fan-shaped area to sleep.

Swooping Frenzy.name: Swooping Frenzy
Swooping Frenzy.description: Damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Defense Down and Magic Defense Down, both 30~60 seconds (magnitudes unpublished).

Sylvan Slumber.name: Sylvan Slumber
Sylvan Slumber.notes: *Targets must be facing the caster for the spell to take effect. This includes targets behind and to the side of the caster.
Sylvan Slumber.description: Gaze that puts all targets in a 10' radius to sleep.

Synergism.name: Synergism
Synergism.notes: Any sleeping flan will be awoken by this ability. When only 1 flan is in range the flan using Synergism will absorb up to around 50% of the other Flans HP. (This is true for Ebony Puddings. It has not been tested whether or not flans in other zones drain different amount of HP.)
Synergism.description: Steals HP from any nearby flans.

Tabbiyaa Gambit.name: Tabbiyaa Gambit
Tabbiyaa Gambit.description: Restores roughly 2,000 HP to the user, removes all enfeebling effects, and may grant a variable damage-immunity shield with Stoneskin. A random damage type removes the shield.

Tachi: Fudo.name: Tachi: Fudo
Tachi: Fudo.description: Katana weapon skill dealing damage to a single target.

Tail Blow.name: Tail Blow
Tail Blow.description: Damages a single target with additional Stun.

Tail Crush.name: Tail Crush
Tail Crush.description: Smashes a single target with its tail. Additional effect: Poison

Tail Lash.name: Tail Lash
Tail Lash.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Condition: used when the player with hate is behind it.

Tail Roll.name: Tail Roll
Tail Roll.description: Deals damage to targets in a cone-shaped area originating from the user.

Tail Slap.name: Tail Slap
Tail Slap.description: Deals physical damage and Stun to targets in a fan-shaped area.

Tail Smash.name: Tail Smash
Tail Smash.notes: Weaker than Tail Swing in Monstrosity, despite being learned at a higher level.
Tail Smash.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Bind.

Tail Swing.name: Tail Swing
Tail Swing.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Tail Thrust.name: Tail Thrust
Tail Thrust.description: Strikes a single target with its tail.

Tail Thwack.name: Tail Thwack
Tail Thwack.description: Deals damage to enemies in an area with Defense Down (-50%) and Knockback.

Tainting Breath.name: Tainting Breath
Tainting Breath.description: Charm. Melancholic Moira gains access to it below 50% HP.

Target.name: Target
Target.description: Marks a player — the user's eyes glow — enabling Eleventh Dimension against them.

Target Analysis.name: Target Analysis
Target Analysis.description: Attempts to absorb all attributes from all players in range.

Tarichutoxin.name: Tarichutoxin
Tarichutoxin.description: Inflicts an unremovable Poison (~15 HP/tick) on a single target.

Tarsal Slam.name: Tarsal Slam
Tarsal Slam.description: Conal AoE that reduces its targets to 1 HP and resets enmity.

Tear Grenade.name: Tear Grenade
Tear Grenade.description: An area-of-effect attack that deals physical damage with added Silence and Blind effects.

Tearing Gust.name: Tearing Gust
Tearing Gust.description: Wind damage that inflicts Magic Defense Down and knockback.

Tebbad Wing.name: Tebbad Wing
Tebbad Wing.notes: Used only by Tiamat, Smok, Ildebrann and Azi Dahaka.
Tebbad Wing.description: A hot wind deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Plague

Tectonic Shift.name: Tectonic Shift
Tectonic Shift.description: Deals area damage, partially draws in those hit, and resets enmity. Additional effect: Encumbrance. Used only by Notorious Monsters.

Tegmina Buffet.name: Tegmina Buffet
Tegmina Buffet.description: A 3-hit physical AoE that inflicts Choke.

Telsonic Tempest.name: Telsonic Tempest
Telsonic Tempest.description: Inflicts Encumbrance on targets in range.

Temblor Blade.name: Temblor Blade
Temblor Blade.notes: Klara's signature move; used in both of her quest battles.
Temblor Blade.description: Area-of-effect sword weapon skill: heavy magic damage and Petrification. Also resets the user's hate.

Tempest Wing.name: Tempest Wing
Tempest Wing.description: Turbulence deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback

Tenebral Crush.name: Tenebral Crush
Tenebral Crush.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Defense Down.

Tenebrous Mist.name: Tenebrous Mist
Tenebrous Mist.description: AoE that resets the target's TP to 0.

Tentacle.name: Tentacle
Tentacle.description: Deals 1-hit damage to a single target. Can critical hit.

Tera Slash.name: Tera Slash
Tera Slash.notes: Sometimes inflicts Death. Ignores Utsusemi shadows.
Tera Slash.description: High conal physical damage that ignores Utsusemi.

Teraflare.name: Teraflare
Teraflare.notes: Used by Bahamut only when down to 10% health during The Wyrmking Descends BCNM.
Teraflare.description: Deals extreme damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Terminal Sting.name: Terminal Sting
Terminal Sting.notes: If Terminal Sting is used by Chasmic Hornet there will be no Experience Points or Cruor gained and will drop nothing but Stingers.
Terminal Sting.description: Delivers a Final Sting like attack that sacrifices the bee which can deal a great amount of damage. (Used by Chasmic Hornet).

Terra Wing.name: Terra Wing
Terra Wing.notes: Used by Dragua in Abyssea - Altepa.
Terra Wing.description: Deals damage to enemies within a 25' AoE and inflicts Petrification.

Terror Eye.name: Terror Eye
Terror Eye.notes: Only used while standing upright. Terror lasts for 30 seconds if successful.
Terror Eye.description: Earth-based gaze that inflicts Terror. Used only while standing.

Terror Touch.name: Terror Touch
Terror Touch.notes: Attack -70% for 30~90 seconds. Can critical hit. Consumes 1 shadow.
Terror Touch.description: Touches a single target. Additional effect: Attack Down

Testudo Tremor.name: Testudo Tremor
Testudo Tremor.notes: Used below 50% HP. Severe AoE Earth-based magical damage; also Stun + Weight (Gravity).

Thermal Pulse.name: Thermal Pulse
Thermal Pulse.description: AoE fire damage with Blind (used while extended).

Thornsong.name: Thornsong
Thornsong.notes: A song - not used while silenced.
Thornsong.description: The monster gains non-elemental damage spikes.

Thousand Spears.name: Thousand Spears
Thousand Spears.notes: Used by Eccentric Eve and Melancholic Moira.
Thousand Spears.description: Area-of-effect damage. Melancholic Moira's can deal 1,000 damage or more.

Thrashing Assault.name: Thrashing Assault
Thrashing Assault.description: A 5-hit physical attack on a single target with an added Defense Down effect.

Throat Stab.name: Throat Stab
Throat Stab.notes: Very short range, easily evaded by walking away from it.
Throat Stab.description: Deals damage to a single target reducing their HP to 5%. Resets enmity.

Thrust.name: Thrust
Thrust.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.
Thrust.description: Conal physical damage with a knockback effect.

Thunder Break.name: Thunder Break
Thunder Break.description: Deals lightning damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun (10-20s).

Thunder Breath.name: Thunder Breath
Thunder Breath.description: Deals lightning breath damage to players in a cone.

Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
Thunderbolt.description: Deals lightning damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Stun.

Thunderous Yowl.name: Thunderous Yowl
Thunderous Yowl.notes: Used only by the Seed Quadav.
Thunderous Yowl.description: Emits a booming cry, inflicting curse and plague

Thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
Thunderstorm.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A lightning-based attack that ignores shadows.

Thunderstrike.name: Thunderstrike
Thunderstrike.description: Deals Lightning damage and Stun to targets in an area.

Thundris Shriek.name: Thundris Shriek
Thundris Shriek.description: AoE Lightning damage with Terror; the Dvergr gains an intimidation effect afterward.

Tidal Guillotine.name: Tidal Guillotine
Tidal Guillotine.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone, or an instant KO if the damage dealt would be greater than 50% of the target's HP.

Tidal Slash.name: Tidal Slash
Tidal Slash.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a polearm.
Tidal Slash.description: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect.

Tidal Wave.name: Tidal Wave
Tidal Wave.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.
Tidal Wave.description: Blood Pact: Rage. Leviathan's ultimate water attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Timber.name: Timber
Timber.notes: Non-elemental (10,000 Needles style); used while aura is active.
Timber.description: 10,000 Needles-style move; damage scales with Max HP, characters present and enmity. Believed Non-Elemental.

Tongue Lash.name: Tongue Lash
Tongue Lash.range: Single target? AoE for Trust: Rongelouts.
Tongue Lash.notes: Used only by Rongelouts N Distaud during A Nation on the Brink and Trust: Rongelouts. Terror effect lasts a fair amount of time.
Tongue Lash.description: Reprimands the opponent with an attack, inflicting Terror.

Torment of Gu'Dha.name: Torment of Gu'Dha
Torment of Gu'Dha.notes: Used only by named Za'Dha Adamantking in the SCNM The Buried God
Torment of Gu'Dha.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback and Petrification

Tormentful Glare.name: Tormentful Glare
Tormentful Glare.notes: Used by Yagudo-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away. Remove Curse with Holy Water or Cursna.
Tormentful Glare.description: A cursing gaze at a player in front, cutting maximum HP by 10%.

Tornado Edge.name: Tornado Edge
Tornado Edge.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Wings of the Goddess areas.
Tornado Edge.description: Deals physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Max HP Down, Max MP Down, and Max TP Down

Torpefying Charge.name: Torpefying Charge
Torpefying Charge.description: Paralyzes players in an area with a gaze (~2 min).

Torpid Glare.name: Torpid Glare
Torpid Glare.notes: Used by Goblin-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away.
Torpid Glare.description: A sleep-inducing gaze at a player in front.

Torrent.name: Torrent
Torrent.notes: Used only by Merrow. Bypasses shadows. The equipment removal is water-based and may be resisted.
Torrent.description: Removes all equipment from a target.

Torrential Torment.name: Torrential Torment
Torrential Torment.description: AoE water damage that also strips all of the target’s equipment.

Tortoise Song.name: Tortoise Song
Tortoise Song.notes: This ability only dispels songs or rolls in effect on players. It has no effect on any other buffs, except in Nyzul Isle, where it takes up to 3 buffs from players.
Tortoise Song.description: Removes all song and roll effects in an area of effect.

Tortoise Stomp.name: Tortoise Stomp
Tortoise Stomp.description: Damages a single target with additional Defense Down.

Touchdown.name: Touchdown
Touchdown.notes: Used when a flying Wyrm lands; does not require TP.
Touchdown.description: A landing slam that resets the Wyrm’s own TP to 0.

Tourbillion.name: Tourbillion
Tourbillion.description: Deals damage with Defense Down and Knockback while its wings are raised.

Toxic Pick.name: Toxic Pick
Toxic Pick.description: Damage to a single player. Additional effects: Poison (-36 HP/tick, 3 min), Plague (-5 HP/tick, 1 min) and Gravity (-75% movement speed, 2 min).

Toxic Spit.name: Toxic Spit
Toxic Spit.notes: The Tartarus Eft variant deals 18 damage per 3 seconds and lasts 3 minutes (180 seconds) dealing 1080 damage if not cured.
Toxic Spit.description: Spews a toxic glob at a single target. Effect: Poison

TP Drainkiss.name: TP Drainkiss
TP Drainkiss.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
TP Drainkiss.description: Drains 50% of a single target's TP.

Train Fall.name: Train Fall
Train Fall.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NOT part of the standard family kit. Used by Tres Duendes in its second form.
Train Fall.description: Deals damage equal to six times base damage to a single player and drains HP for an equal amount.

Trample.name: Trample
Trample.notes: Ixion's version will deal high physical damage to anyone in its path (the move can also crit dealing close to 1000 dmg). It also has a aspir effect which depletes MP of the target it hits, however, it does not bind its target. Ixion's trample has no log warning adn it cannot be blinked.
Trample.description: Deals physical damage to enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback + Bind

Transmogrification.name: Transmogrification
Transmogrification.notes: All physical damage, including those from pets or physical Blue Magic, will heal the Mammet while this is in effect. Only used in "hand" form. Lasts around 30 seconds. Counter procs will NOT heal them.
Transmogrification.description: Absorbs all physical damage and converts it into restored HP for ~30 seconds. Used only in Hand Form.

Trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
Trebuchet.notes: Used only by Antaeus, Briareus, and Grandgousier. AoE damage is centered around the target. Randomly removes Sambas.
Trebuchet.description: Tosses a large boulder at a single target, dealing heavy damage in an area of effect.

Trembling.name: Trembling
Trembling.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Trembling.description: Deals physical damage in an area of effect and dispels one status enhancement.

Tremorous Tread.name: Tremorous Tread
Tremorous Tread.description: Deals area damage. Additional effect: Stun. Absorbed by Utsusemi. Usable in all forms.

Tremors.name: Tremors
Tremors.notes: Removes all shadows. Radial, centered on the worm.
Tremors.description: Area-of-effect damage and DEX Down (-10 DEX, 3 min).

Tribulation.name: Tribulation
Tribulation.notes: Bio effect can take away up to 39/tick.
Tribulation.description: AoE (10') that inflicts Blind (-100 Acc, ~2min) and Bio III (-30 to -39 HP/tick, ~2min).

Triclip.name: Triclip
Triclip.notes: DEX Down (~-20 DEX, 90s), varies with TP. Consumes 3 shadows.

Trinary Absorption.name: Trinary Absorption
Trinary Absorption.notes: Takes up to 300 HP. Used only by the Brooder, Wreaker, Ponderer, and Agonizer.
Trinary Absorption.description: Drains 300 HP from a single target.

Trinary Tap.name: Trinary Tap
Trinary Tap.notes: Absorbs up to three buffs (including food); drains up to 300 HP if it cannot take enough buffs. Goes through shadows.
Trinary Tap.description: Attempts to absorb three buffs from a single target, or otherwise steals HP.

Triple Attack.name: Triple Attack
Triple Attack.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. NMs and Gaganas use Giga Scream instead.
Triple Attack.description: Three-hit damage to a single player.

Triple Attack (Roc).name: Triple Attack (Roc)
Triple Attack (Roc).description: Delivers a threefold attack on a single target.

Triple Reversal.name: Triple Reversal
Triple Reversal.description: Drains HP from a single player.

Triumphant Roar.name: Triumphant Roar
Triumphant Roar.description: Self-buff that grants an Attack Bonus (~33%). Used only while standing.

Tropic Tenor.name: Tropic Tenor
Tropic Tenor.notes: Removes all shadows. NOT part of the standard kit.
Tropic Tenor.description: Substantial damage in a 15' area around the monster (~1k), plus All Stats Down, TP Reset and knockback.

Tsujikaze.name: Tsujikaze
Tsujikaze.description: AoE magical damage (~14.9′) with Silence, Defense Down, and Magic Defense Down. Used below 50% HP.

Turbine Cyclone.name: Turbine Cyclone
Turbine Cyclone.description: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect with knockback, and dispels 1-3 status enhancements.

Turbofan.name: Turbofan
Turbofan.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Turbofan.description: Turns on a powerful turbofan that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Silence

Turbulence.name: Turbulence
Turbulence.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Removes all shadows.
Turbulence.description: Damage to players in an area of effect centred on the monster.

Turtle Stomp.name: Turtle Stomp
Turtle Stomp.description: Deals damage to single target. Additional effect: Defense Down

Tusk.name: Tusk
Tusk.description: Damages a single target with additional Knockback.

Typhoean Rage.name: Typhoean Rage
Typhoean Rage.description: Damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Encumbrance and Muddle.

Typhonic Arrow.name: Typhonic Arrow
Typhonic Arrow.notes: Used only by General Najelith during Besieged, Counselor Najelith during Mercenary Camp BCNM, and the Najelith Alter Ego.
Typhonic Arrow.description: Fires a high velocity arrow to a single target.

Typhoon.name: Typhoon
Typhoon.description: Spins around dealing damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback, which occurs even if shadows absorb the damage.

Typhoon Wing.name: Typhoon Wing
Typhoon Wing.notes: Used by Ouryu (while on the ground) and Dragua.
Typhoon Wing.description: Deals darkness damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Blind

Tyrannical Blow.name: Tyrannical Blow
Tyrannical Blow.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with additional Plague.

Tyrant Tusk.name: Tyrant Tusk
Tyrant Tusk.description: Damages enemies in a cone-shaped area with additional Bio; can inflict instant Death if Bio is already active or the target is at low HP.

Tyrranic Blare.name: Tyrranic Blare
Tyrranic Blare.notes: Only used by Gulool Ja Ja.
Tyrranic Blare.description: Emits an overwhelming scream that damages nearby targets.

Ultimate Terror.name: Ultimate Terror
Ultimate Terror.description: Drains 2-4 of the target's stats by 22 and steals one beneficial effect from targets in range.

Ultrasonics.name: Ultrasonics
Ultrasonics.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Ultrasonics.description: Inflicts Evasion Down (-25, 120~180s) on targets in an area of effect.

Ululation.name: Ululation
Ululation.description: Paralyzes all enemies in an area of effect.

Umbra Smash.name: Umbra Smash
Umbra Smash.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Umbral Expunction.name: Umbral Expunction
Umbral Expunction.description: Magical damage to enemies in an area; damage increases with the number of active debuffs on the caster.

Unblest Armor.name: Unblest Armor
Unblest Armor.notes: Self Shell (reduces magic damage taken 50%, 3 min).

Unblest Jambiya.name: Unblest Jambiya
Unblest Jambiya.notes: Used only by notorious monsters, and only while the main weapon is unbroken. Removes all shadows.
Unblest Jambiya.description: Drains HP from players within 15 feet.

Unchivalrous Stab.name: Unchivalrous Stab
Unchivalrous Stab.description: Deals damage and inflicts Curse, Gravity, and reductions to all attributes and to max HP, MP, and TP on targets in an area of effect.

Undead Mold.name: Undead Mold
Undead Mold.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Undead Mold.description: Deals damage in a cone. Additional effect: Disease (no HP or MP recovery while resting, 11 minutes).

Undulating Shockwave.name: Undulating Shockwave
Undulating Shockwave.description: Lightning damage in an area of effect.

Unfaltering Bravado.name: Unfaltering Bravado
Unfaltering Bravado.notes: Used at 75/50/25/10% HP. The user then briefly gains an avoidance-down (no parry or shield block) and a Muddle aura.
Unfaltering Bravado.description: Deals 10,000 damage split among targets in a frontal cone; cannot be reduced by any form of Damage Taken reduction.

Unrelenting Brand.name: Unrelenting Brand
Unrelenting Brand.notes: Samursk's unique move, used below 50% HP; on Samursk it also inflicts Curse (Recovery Down). Easily stunnable, but the user gains Blaze Spikes even when the move is stunned.
Unrelenting Brand.description: AoE damage that resets the user's ability recasts and inflicts Zombie; the user gains Blaze Spikes.

Upgrowth.name: Upgrowth
Upgrowth.description: Turns a single target into a mandragora costume. Equipment stays on and the target keeps fighting as a mandragora until it wears off, but cannot use items.

Uproot.name: Uproot
Uproot.description: Reduces HP to critical, slows and resets hate; triggers the firefly aura.

Uranos Cascade.name: Uranos Cascade
Uranos Cascade.description: Inflicts damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Vacant Gaze.name: Vacant Gaze
Vacant Gaze.notes: Powered-up Blank Gaze; removes up to 3 buffs.

Vacuole Discharge.name: Vacuole Discharge
Vacuole Discharge.description: Inflicts damage and knocks back targets. Additional effect: Paralysis

Vacuous Osculation.name: Vacuous Osculation
Vacuous Osculation.notes: Vacuous osculation is simply another way of saying 'empty kiss', which is another move used by Weepers.
Vacuous Osculation.description: Single-target physical damage; inflicts Poison and Plague.

Valfodr.name: Valfodr
Valfodr.notes: Odin will say a random speech before using this move.
Valfodr.description: Deals damage with Curse and Silence.

Vampiric Lash.name: Vampiric Lash
Vampiric Lash.description: Single-target attack that absorbs HP. When used by Ameretat-type Morbols it also absorbs all beneficial status effects.

Vampiric Root.name: Vampiric Root
Vampiric Root.description: Single-target attack that absorbs HP and one beneficial status effect.

Vanity Strike.name: Vanity Strike
Vanity Strike.description: Deals physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun.

Vaskania.name: Vaskania
Vaskania.description: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts damage and Curse.

Veil of Chaos.name: Veil of Chaos
Veil of Chaos.description: Deals Light elemental damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback, Amnesia, and enmity reset

Velkkan Ambush.name: Velkkan Ambush
Velkkan Ambush.description: Four-hit attack that dispels one effect per hit. Absorbed by 4 shadows.

Velocious Blade.name: Velocious Blade
Velocious Blade.description: Delivers a five-fold attack for high damage. Used only in Sword Form.

Venom.name: Venom
Venom.notes: Additional effect can be removed with Poisona.
Venom.description: Deals damage in a fan shaped area. Additional effect: poison

Venom Breath.name: Venom Breath
Venom Breath.notes: Used by Serket and Nightmare Scorpions in place of Cold Breath & Numbing Breath.
Venom Breath.description: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Poison

Venom Shell.name: Venom Shell
Venom Shell.notes: Poison ticks for 16 HP and lasts 2 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. It uses Venom Shell to return into its shell and regenerate.
Venom Shell.description: Inflicts Poison in an area of effect centred on the user.

Venom Shower.name: Venom Shower
Venom Shower.notes: Removes all shadows. Depending on the NM the Poison is unremovable by any means except Chakra. Karkinos (at low HP), Krabakarpo, Krabimanjaro (below 50% HP, and it gains Regain), Krabkatoa. It can be evaded by a height difference like Astral Flow, it leaves a Plague aura, and 229 water resist fully resisted both the damage and the poison.
Venom Shower.description: Water-based damage to players in a large radius. Additional effects: Poison (-40 HP/tick, 1 min) and Defense Down (-25%).

Venom Spray.name: Venom Spray
Venom Spray.notes: Poison is generally 15/tick, but may be more (c.f. Nightmare Antlion).
Venom Spray.description: Inflicts Poison on players in a cone-shaped area. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).

Venom Sting.name: Venom Sting
Venom Sting.notes: Stronger version of Poison Sting, used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, and Nightmare Scorpions.
Venom Sting.description: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Venom Storm.name: Venom Storm
Venom Storm.notes: Used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, Calchas and Nightmare Scorpions. Poison effect can deal as much as 20-30/tick.
Venom Storm.description: Inflicts deadly venom to targets within a massive area of effect.

Venomous Vapor.name: Venomous Vapor
Venomous Vapor.notes: Used by Yecuex and Sortie Acuex.
Venomous Vapor.description: Area-of-effect damage plus All Attributes Down. Gains a poison aura.

Vermilion Wind.name: Vermilion Wind
Vermilion Wind.description: Medium wind damage in a 20' area of effect (~800-1000 on normal players).

Vertical Cleave.name: Vertical Cleave
Vertical Cleave.notes: +25% Attack (self). Bypasses shadows. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.
Vertical Cleave.description: Single-target physical damage. Can critical strike.

Vertical Slash.name: Vertical Slash
Vertical Slash.description: Vertically slashes a single target. Additional effect: Accuracy Down

Vespine Hurricane.name: Vespine Hurricane
Vespine Hurricane.description: Deals wind damage with Knockback to enemies in an area, with additional Magic Defense Down and Attack Down.

Vicious Kick.name: Vicious Kick
Vicious Kick.description: A kick attack dealing physical damage to a single target.

Vicious Rake.name: Vicious Rake
Vicious Rake.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Knockback.

Victory Beacon.name: Victory Beacon
Victory Beacon.notes: Used only by General Rughadjeen during Besieged, Counselor Rughadjeen during Mercenary Camp. and Trust: Rughadjeen when the other serpent general alter egos are in the party.
Victory Beacon.description: Deals damage and greatly lowers accuracy for a brief time to enemies within area of effect .

View Sync.name: View Sync
View Sync.description: Draws in all targets and deals area damage. Additional effect: Bind.

Vile Belch.name: Vile Belch
Vile Belch.description: Belches noxious fumes at targets in an area of effect, inflicting Silence (30~60s) and Plague (100 TP & 6 MP per tick, 15~45s).

Villainous Rebuke.name: Villainous Rebuke
Villainous Rebuke.description: Deals significant damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback.

Violent Rupture.name: Violent Rupture
Violent Rupture.description: AoE damage with Knockback and Weight.

Virulent Haze.name: Virulent Haze
Virulent Haze.notes: Amphitrite (the family's Limascabra) counters with it after absorbing damage, and its Addle lands even on a player in i119 gear with high magic evasion. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The element icon measures (173,118,50) against the Fire reference gem (166,111,48).
Virulent Haze.description: Inflicts Burn and Addle on monsters in a frontal cone.

Viscid Nectar.name: Viscid Nectar
Viscid Nectar.notes: Bypasses shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Viscid Secretion.name: Viscid Secretion
Viscid Secretion.description: Inflicts Slow and Weight on players in a cone-shaped area.

Viscid Spindrift.name: Viscid Spindrift
Viscid Spindrift.notes: Removes all shadows. Area/Target: conal, centred on the monster.
Viscid Spindrift.description: Conal water-based damage. Additional effects: Attack Down (-33%), Magic Atk Down and Gravity.

Viscous Deluge.name: Viscous Deluge
Viscous Deluge.description: Applies Bio and various debuffs to enemies.

Vitriolic Barrage.name: Vitriolic Barrage
Vitriolic Barrage.notes: Damage is 1000 divided by all targets, like 1,000 Needles. Poison can take 20/tick.
Vitriolic Barrage.description: Bombards nearby targets with acid, dealing fixed damage. Additional effect: Poison

Vitriolic Shower.name: Vitriolic Shower
Vitriolic Shower.description: AoE fire damage with a powerful Burn (used while extended).

Vitriolic Spray.name: Vitriolic Spray
Vitriolic Spray.notes: Burn effect can be anywhere from 10 to 30 per tick.
Vitriolic Spray.description: Cone-shaped fire breath damage with Burn (used while extended).

Vivisection.name: Vivisection
Vivisection.description: AoE damage and a full Dispel. Used when it levels up.

Void of Repentance.name: Void of Repentance
Void of Repentance.notes: Used after any skillchain is performed.
Void of Repentance.description: Inflicts Stun, Accuracy Down (-100), and Magic Accuracy Down.

Voidsong.name: Voidsong
Voidsong.notes: A song - not used while silenced. Removes all shadows.
Voidsong.description: Dispels all status effects from players (including food) and removes status ailments from itself.

Volant Angon.name: Volant Angon
Volant Angon.notes: Used only by Yrvaulair S Cousseraux during Campaign.
Volant Angon.description: Impales enemies with a powerful throwing spear.

Volcanic Stasis.name: Volcanic Stasis
Volcanic Stasis.description: Deals fire damage to a target with additional Stun and a full Dispel.

Volcanic Wrath.name: Volcanic Wrath
Volcanic Wrath.description: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Burn and Max HP Down. Used only by red golems.

Voracious Trunk.name: Voracious Trunk
Voracious Trunk.description: Absorbs one positive status effect from the target. Ignores shadows.

Vorpal Blade.name: Vorpal Blade
Vorpal Blade.notes: Used by BLU Mamool Ja; also by Ghrah in Humanoid form.
Vorpal Blade.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Vorpal Blade (Ghrah).name: Vorpal Blade (Ghrah)
Vorpal Blade (Ghrah).description: Delivers a fourfold attack on a single target.

Vorpal Wheel.name: Vorpal Wheel
Vorpal Wheel.notes: Only used by Gulool Ja Ja, and will use it as a counterattack to any spells cast on him. Damage increases as his health drops. Can be Shield Blocked.
Vorpal Wheel.description: Throws a slicing wheel at a single target.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.description: Inflicts damage and resets hate to enemies in an area of effect.

Vorticose Sands.name: Vorticose Sands
Vorticose Sands.notes: Used by Tzee Xicu the Manifest in A Malicious Manifest and Manifest Destiny.
Vorticose Sands.description: Unleashes a whirlwind upon players, inflicting heavy damage. Additional effect: Silence + strip equipment

Vulcan Shot.name: Vulcan Shot
Vulcan Shot.notes: Only used by the Ashu Talif Captain during the battle for TOAU15: The Black Coffin. Damage can reach up to 700.
Vulcan Shot.description: Fires an explosive bullet at targets in an area of effect.

Vulcanian Impact.name: Vulcanian Impact
Vulcanian Impact.notes: Used only in CoP and ToAU areas. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Vulcanian Impact.description: Deals damage to a single target.

Waning Vigor.name: Waning Vigor
Waning Vigor.description: AoE damage scaled by the damage absorbed during Primordial Surge; applies Weakness (15s) to the primary target.

Wanion.name: Wanion
Wanion.description: Transfers the user's negative status effects onto targets in an area of effect.

Warden of Terror.name: Warden of Terror
Warden of Terror.notes: Used only by Duskraven during Campaign.
Warden of Terror.description: Inprisons enemies within their own fears.

Warm-Up.name: Warm-Up
Warm-Up.description: The user gains Accuracy Boost and Evasion Boost.

Warped Wail.name: Warped Wail
Warped Wail.description: Wind damage in a 20' area of effect, with severe Max HP Down and Max MP Down.

Washtub.name: Washtub
Washtub.description: Drops a washtub on foes within area of effect. Additonal Effect: Amnesia and Stun

Water Blade.name: Water Blade
Water Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enwater aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Water Bomb.name: Water Bomb
Water Bomb.description: Deals Water elemental damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence

Water Shield.name: Water Shield
Water Shield.description: Gains Evasion Bonus (+25, 120~600s). Duration varies with TP.

Water Wall.name: Water Wall
Water Wall.notes: Doubles Pugil Defense probably. Aura Stealing this ability causes it to double Thief defense.
Water Wall.description: Gains Defense Bonus (Defense x2, 60~180s). Duration varies with TP.

Weighted Flux.name: Weighted Flux
Weighted Flux.notes: Palila only, and only while the Crashing Thunder aura is up.
Weighted Flux.description: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Gravity.

Wheel of Impregnability.name: Wheel of Impregnability
Wheel of Impregnability.notes: Ring beneath the boss glows red while the physical shield is up.
Wheel of Impregnability.description: Grants the caster Invincible, nullifying physical damage.

Whip Tongue.name: Whip Tongue
Whip Tongue.description: Whiplashes a single player with its tongue. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback. Can land a critical hit.

Whirl Claws.name: Whirl Claws
Whirl Claws.notes: ~15 yalm range; absorbed by 2 shadows. NM versions reset hate on each target hit.
Whirl Claws.description: Deals damage in an area of effect.

Whirl of Rage.name: Whirl of Rage
Whirl of Rage.description: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect.

Whirling Edge.name: Whirling Edge
Whirling Edge.description: Lilisette performs a unique weapon skill.
Whirling Edge.notes: Used only by Lilisette, Trust: Lilisette and Trust: Lilisette II.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.description: Deals wind damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: VIT Down (-10, decays).

Whispers of Ire.name: Whispers of Ire
Whispers of Ire.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.
Whispers of Ire.description: Randomly absorbs 2 to 5 attributes from target.

Whistle.name: Whistle
Whistle.notes: When used by the Nightmare Dhalmel in Dynamis - Buburimu, it grants an Evasion Boost instead.

White Out.name: White Out
White Out.notes: Removes all shadows. Isarukitsck's version also resets Little Wingman hate onto its current target.
White Out.description: Damage in a 20' area of effect, with Zombie and Sleep.

White Wind.name: White Wind
White Wind.notes: Used by Peapuks (one time only) and by Notorious Monsters (at will).
White Wind.description: Recovers HP based on the caster’s maximum HP.

Wild Horn.name: Wild Horn
Wild Horn.description: Deals damage in a frontal cone.

Wild Oats.name: Wild Oats
Wild Oats.description: Single-target damage. Additional effect: VIT Down.

Wild Rage.name: Wild Rage
Wild Rage.notes: Has additional effect of Poison when used by King Vinegarroon.
Wild Rage.description: Deals physical damage to enemies within area of effect.

Wildwood Indignation.name: Wildwood Indignation
Wildwood Indignation.notes: Haughty Tulittia's version copies one of its own debuffs onto every party member in range each time it is used — dangerous if you have applied Paralyze or a Helix.

Wind Blade.name: Wind Blade
Wind Blade.description: Blood Pact: Rage. A wind-based ranged attack that ignores shadows.

Wind Blade (Kam'lanaut).name: Wind Blade (Kam'lanaut)
Wind Blade (Kam'lanaut).notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enaero aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Wind Breath.name: Wind Breath
Wind Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Wind Breath.description: Deals wind breath damage to players in a cone. Damage ~ Current HP x 1/10 (cap 400).

Wind Shear.name: Wind Shear
Wind Shear.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Vulpangue uses an enhanced version that inflicts Weight.
Wind Shear.description: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback. Damage varies with TP; knockback fails if fully resisted.

Wind Wall.name: Wind Wall
Wind Wall.description: Invokes a protective wind barrier for increased evasion.

Winds of Oblivion.name: Winds of Oblivion
Winds of Oblivion.notes: Only used during his second form.
Winds of Oblivion.description: AoE Amnesia lasting up to 75 seconds.

Winds of Promyvion.name: Winds of Promyvion
Winds of Promyvion.notes: Used when the user has an active status ailment.
Winds of Promyvion.description: Erases a negative status effect from the user.

Wing Cutter.name: Wing Cutter
Wing Cutter.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Wing Cutter.description: Damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Wing Slap.name: Wing Slap
Wing Slap.description: Slaps a single player four times with its wings. Damage with Stun.

Wing Whirl.name: Wing Whirl
Wing Whirl.description: Strikes all targets within an area of effect with its wings.

Wings of Agony.name: Wings of Agony
Wings of Agony.description: High damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Paralyze and Sleep.

Wings of Gehenna.name: Wings of Gehenna
Wings of Gehenna.description: Damage to players in range. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback.

Wings of Woe.name: Wings of Woe
Wings of Woe.notes: None of the three effects can be removed.
Wings of Woe.description: High damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence, Plague and Bind.

Winter Breeze.name: Winter Breeze
Winter Breeze.notes: This also has a stun effect that lasts about 2 seconds

Wirecutter.name: Wirecutter
Wirecutter.notes: Can be absorbed by shadows or Third Eye. Consumes two shadows.
Wirecutter.description: Slashes a single player for high physical damage.

Wisecrack.name: Wisecrack
Wisecrack.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. NOT part of the standard kit. Chamrosh can use it once; Yalungur gains it under 50% HP (10' AoE, up to 2 minutes — Stun is recommended, and it despawns if everyone is charmed).
Wisecrack.description: Charms players in an area around the monster.

Wrath of Gu'Dha.name: Wrath of Gu'Dha
Wrath of Gu'Dha.notes: Used only by named Dynamis Quadav NM's and Wings of the Goddess NMs. Knockback effect can send players back considerable distances. Occasionally inflicts a potent but short lasting Gravity effect, even if the attack is evaded. This attack can either be Conal or Radial AoE.
Wrath of Gu'Dha.description: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback and Weight

Wrath of Zeus.name: Wrath of Zeus
Wrath of Zeus.description: Heavy thunder damage to nearby targets. Additional effect: Silence. Damage increases when charging animations precede it.

Xenoglossia.name: Xenoglossia
Xenoglossia.description: Prepares next spell for instant casting.

Yaegasumi.name: Yaegasumi
Yaegasumi.notes: A Samurai one-hour ability the NM borrows; used by Tenzen and Bumba (lasts 45 seconds for Bumba).

Yaksha Stance.name: Yaksha Stance
Yaksha Stance.notes: Dispels up to three status enhancements from players. Not every Naraka gains the damage reduction. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.
Yaksha Stance.description: The monster enters Yaksha Stance, gaining -50% physical damage taken and erasing its own status ailments. Unlocks the Yaksha TP moves.

Yaksha: Bliss.name: Yaksha: Bliss
Yaksha: Bliss.notes: Requires Yaksha Stance. Attack -25%. Absorbed by shadows.
Yaksha: Bliss.description: Conal physical damage. Additional effect: Attack Down and Magic Attack Down.

Yaksha: Damnation.name: Yaksha: Damnation
Yaksha: Damnation.description: Conal physical damage. Additional effect: Magic Defense Down and Defense Down.

Yaksha: Oblivion.name: Yaksha: Oblivion
Yaksha: Oblivion.notes: Requires Yaksha Stance. All attributes -110. Resets enmity.
Yaksha: Oblivion.description: Heavy physical damage to players in a wide area of effect, with a hate reset.

Yama's Judgment.name: Yama's Judgment
Yama's Judgment.notes: Used only by Kalasutrax and Vinipata. The Doom is blocked by a Fanatic's Drink. Removes all shadows.
Yama's Judgment.description: Damage to players in an area of effect, and inflicts a five-count Doom.

Yawn.name: Yawn
Yawn.notes: A GAZE attack — bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Apkallu start with Yawn as their only TP move; as zone-wide Apkallu Hate rises they upgrade to more aggressive moves, and by the time they use Wing Slap they no longer use Yawn.
Yawn.description: Puts targets who see it to sleep.

Yggr.name: Yggr
Yggr.notes: Goes into effect after Zantetsuken (ability); also resummons the 9 fomors.
Yggr.description: Grants Odin an intimidation and attack boost effect.

Zantetsuken (ability).name: Zantetsuken (ability)
Zantetsuken (ability).notes: Odin uses this ability at 10%, as an Astral Flow-style attack. Players in range can use /kneel or /heal to avoid instant K.O. Before using this ability, Odin gives a warning monologue:

Zantetsuken Kai.name: Zantetsuken Kai
Zantetsuken Kai.range: Undetermined range in front of Odin.

Zantetsuken X.name: Zantetsuken X
Zantetsuken X.description: Instantly K.O.s any target in a 20' area when Odin's attack exceeds a set ratio over their defense.

Zap.name: Zap
Zap.description: Lightning ability that inflicts Plague and Amnesia. On the Sortie NMs it copies a debuff from the caster to all party members in range.

Zarraqa.name: Zarraqa
Zarraqa.notes: Used by RNG trolls as a standard ranged attack.
Zarraqa.description: Performs a ranged attack with cannon.

Zealous Snort.name: Zealous Snort
Zealous Snort.description: Grants the user Haste, enhances magic defense, and raises the likelihood of Countering and Guarding.

Zephyr Mantle.name: Zephyr Mantle
Zephyr Mantle.notes: 4 shadows for ordinary Puks; up to 10 for Notorious Monsters.

Zero Hour.name: Zero Hour
Zero Hour.description: Deals AoE magic-based damage, resets enmity, and inflicts a 60-second Inhibit TP.
